tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /zin bris kyi rim pa sna tshogs pa'i skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yon tan bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /zin bris kyi rim pa sna tshogs pa'i skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yon tan bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zin bris kyi rim pa sna tshogs pa'i skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa yon tan bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

'phags ma sgrol ljang maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i zin tho ut+pal mā la bi ha ra tisma/ swa sti/ thugs rje che mnga' byams mgon 'phags pa mchog /gnyis med sprul sgyur bcom ldan rje btsun ma// tshe dbang dpal ster rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum// gang gis tshe rabs kun tu skyong gyur cig /'phags ma sgrol ljang maṇ+ḍal gyi// mchod chog zin tho ut+pal phreng*// spel bgyi skal ldan mgul pa'i rgyan// mdzes pa'i dpyid du rol par gyis// de yang bshams bkod rim pa la// dmigs rten tā re'i sku brnyan ni// byin rlabs ldan pa mañdzi'i khar// bzhugs su gsol zhing bsdus pa na// maṇ+ḍal tshom bur brten kyang rung*// phyogs bzhir mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal bzhi// tshom bu bdun bkod re re la'ang*// mchod pa rnam lnga ci bder bshams// yang na maṇ+ḍal gcig rim bzhin// 'don pa dang bstun dbul kyang 'thus// mchod pa'ang brje'am kha gso bya// de dag gang 'byor 'dam ga'o// mchod pa'i 'das gtor mtho bar bshams// gsum po phreng tshar bshams byas la// bsang chu 'bru dkar la sogs pa// mkho ba'i yo byad mchod rdzas rnams// legs par 'du byas gtsang sbra dang*// ldan pas bde ba'i stan la 'dug /dang po rang gi mdun gyi mkhar// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// 'phags ma sgrol ljang gsal btab la// mtha' skor dkon mchog rtsa gsum rnams// sprin phung gtibs bzhin bzhugs pa'i drung*// rang dang sems can thams cad kyis// skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed bya// de nas rang nyid skad cig gis// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dkar// phyag g.yas mchod sbyin pad+ma 'dzin// g.yon pas thugs kar pad+ma bsnams// zhal 'dzum spyan gsum rin chen dar// rgyan mdzes ri dwags lpags pa yis// phrag g.yon bkab cing zhabs g.yas brkyang*// g.yon bskum pad zla'i gdan bzhugs bskyed// bsang chu khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil// byin rlabs rang bzhin mos ku sha'i// 'thor g.yab sems ma rdo rje ma'i// rgyas bzung mthong ba brgyud ltar bya// de nas gnas khang mchod pa'i rdzas// yo byad thams cad ye shes kyi// ngo bor byin dbab tshig don dang*// mtshungs pa'i gzhung ltar mthar chags dang*// mdun bskyed sgrol ma mngon rtogs ltar// ji bzhin bskyed la dam tshig par// ye shes bskyed bstim dbang bskur dang*// rgyas gdab la sogs dkyus ltar ro// rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥ

/mdun bskyed thugs ka'i trām̐ las kyang*// 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras 'khor bcas// tshogs zhing rten du spyan drangs la// phyi 'brang bgegs bskrad gdan bzhugs bsam// de nas dkon mchog yon tan rnams// rjes su dran bzhin sgo gsum gyi// mos 'dun dang bcas mdo bklag nas// phyag 'tshal skabs su rang dang ni// sbyin bdag sogs kyi lus rdul snyed// du mar sprul nas 'dud pa dang*// gzhan yang ma gyur thams cad kyis// gus pas sgo gsum dad phyag dmigs// bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa brjod// rang gzhan kun gyis phyag 'tshal mos// mchod rdzas rab 'byams khams bkang 'bul// nyes gyur 'gyod bshags sdom pa bzung*// rgyal ba'i mdzad par rjes yi rang*// chos 'khor bskor bar bskul gsol 'debs// dus gsum dge kun byang chen bsngo// de nas sems bskyed bzung ba ni// sngon gyi 'phags pa rnams kyis ni// bdag med stong nyid rang bzhin du// thugs bskyed ji ltar bdag gzhan gyis// byang chub dam par sems bskyed mos// de nas mchod 'bul rin chen sems// sogs kyis 'jig rten khams dpal 'byor// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa dngos su 'byor pa dang*// yid sprul ting 'dzin ngang nas phul// maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus sngags bcas bton// lus dang longs spyod dge rtsa 'bul// me tog byin brlabs sngags brjod cing*// byang sems shis brjod slar yang ni// mthu bskyed ā li kā li dang*// yig brgya rten snying sbrel mar brjod// me tog byin brlabs kha gso bya// 'greng bzhin 'dod gsol gzhung ltar gyi// rdo rje'i gsung rnams tshig don dang*// yid la 'dres pa'i 'dun pa yi// nges shes brtan cing shis pa brjod// de dag cho ga dang po'o// de nas gnyis pa rje btsun mar// bye brag mchod cing gsol gdab ni// mchod zhing rgyal ba thams cad la// thal sbyar 'dud bcas snyan gsan phab// de dag thams cad 'phags mar bstim// de nyid dkon mchog 'dus pa'i skur// ye nas yid bzhin mos gus kyi// snang ba zab mos rgyud bskul nas// phyag 'tshal dmigs pa gong ltar dang*// slar yang mchod pa mthu bskyed gzungs// bton cing mchod yon phal cher gyis// mchod 'bul sngags bcas yan lag bdun// tshigs bcad dang ni rgyun chags gnyis// gang bde maṇ+ḍal la sogs 'bul// rje btsun bcom ldan 'das sogs kyis// 'dod don gsol btab smon shis brjod// sngags kyis me tog byin brlabs la// byang sems shis brjod me tog 'bul// de nas bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa rnams// gzhung ltar ji bzhin gsal gdab la// sangs rgyas kun 'dus 'phags ma la// rtse gcig dad mos shugs phyung gis// mthar thug mchog stsol gnas skabs su// thun mong yid bzhin dngos grub kyi// 'dod don 'grub par gsol ba btab// rtsa sngags brgya rtsa gnyis bzla zhing*// tshe sham sbyar ba brgya rtsa bzla// gzhan yang kha bsgyur skabs thob sbyar// las thams cad pa'i rigs sngags kyang*// bzlas mthar kha skong dang bcas brjod// de nas bdag gzhan sems can dang*// 'byung ba bzhi dang de dag gi

/cha shas rdul phran rnams las kyang*// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig rang sgra sgrog /mos bzhin lan gnyis phan yon tshar// gcig bcas slar yang phan yon gyi// mthu bskyed sum sbrel gzungs sngags bzla// me tog byin brlabs 'dod gsol gyi// tshig don blo dang mthun par bya// shis brjod dang bcas gnyis pa'o// de nas gsum par phyag 'tshal sogs// bzlas pa'i bar du gong ltar khyab// rtsa sngags brgya rtsa gsum tshe sham// brgya dang lnga bcu kha bsgyur rnams// skabs thob las thams cad pa'i sngags// gang 'os bzlas mthar kha skong bya// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig lan gsum dang*// phan yon tshar gcig 'dod gsol dang*// bkra shis dang bcas gsum pa'o// de nas bzhi par phyag 'tshal ba// bsnyen pa'i bar du gong bzhin la// rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bdun tshe sham// phyed dang bzhi brgya kha bsgyur rnams// gang 'os las sngags skabs thob bzla// sum sbrel kha skong dang bcas bton// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig tshar bdun dang*// phan yon dang bcas sgrol mtshan brgya// 'dod gsol shis brjod bzhi pa'o// de nas rjes kyi cho ga'i rim// gtor 'bul so sor rim bzhin phul// mchod gzungs bzlas la mchod byin brlabs// mchod bstod bya zhing dge ba bsngo// chad lhag kha skong bzod par gsol// mdun bskyed sku las sku 'phros nas// rang gi dpral thim gnyis med par// byin brlabs 'du 'bral med par mos// ye shes dbyings su gshegs pa'am// rten la bzhugs su gsol byas na// rab tu gnas pa'i mchog gyur gsungs// 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas gshegs// de nas smon lam rgyas gdab dang*// bkra shis mtha' rgyas rjes bsdu sogs// gzhung gsal bzhin gyis 'grub par 'gyur// de ltar bkod pa'i bsod nams kyi// dge tshogs rgya mtsho bsgrub pa'i mthus// 'gro kun nyer 'tshe'i dgos 'byung dbang*// bla ma'i zhabs brtan bdag gzhan rnams// legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs// nongs gyur dag tshangs dngos grub stsol// dad gsum 'byor pa dang ldan pas// bskul ba'i g.yar ngos si tu pa// pad+ma nyin byed dbang gis spel// bstan 'gror phan bde'i dpal du shog

/sarba mad+ga lam̐/// / ༈ so thar sdom rgyun gyi zin bris nor bu'i phreng mdzes zhes pa bzhugs so// na maḥshākya rā dza ye/ tshad med yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs nas// mtha' yas zab don bslab gsum nor bu mchog /ji snyed brjod bral thugs rje'i gter chen po// bder gshegs shākya'i rgyal pos rtag tu skyongs// rnam dag rgya chen sde snod skyed tshal dbus// zla med tshul khrims bsung zhim 'dab rgyas pa// thub bstan rgyan mchog puṇ+ḍā ri ka yi// phreng mdzes bka' brgyud bla mar gus pas 'dud// rlabs chen byang chub spyod pa dpag bsam gyi// yongs 'du sa brtol ljon dbang ji bzhin par// grub gnyis char gyis 'gro ba'i gdung sel gnyen// bdud 'dul rdo rjer byang chub bar du 'dud// de ltar ched du brjod pas mdun bsus te// 'di na so so thar pa'i sdom pa yi// srol 'dzin byung tshul zin thor spel ba la// de yang 'phags pa'i yul du nyan thos kyi// sde pa bco brgyad grags shing bod 'dir ni// rtsa ba'i sde bzhi'i nang nas gzhi thams cad// yod par smra ba'i sde ste sdom pa'i rgyun// za hor mkhan po zhi 'tsho nas brgyud pa'i// bstan pa snga dar ring la tshang ma dang*// de nyid rim gyis phyi dar bla chen pa// dgongs pa rab gsal las brgyud sdom rgyun ni// khams nas yar dar smad 'dul zhes par grags// yang ni 'phags yul yod smra'i bik+ṣu ni/ / gu ṇa ma ti'i sdom rgyun rgyal shes rab// mon gro 'dul 'dzin nas brgyud mnga' ris nas// bar dar stod 'dul zhes grags karma pa// chos kyi bla ma yan chad bod ljongs kyi// skyes mchog kun kyang sdom rgyun gnyis ka yi// khongs su 'dus shing mnyam med 'jig rten mgon// bgrang bya 'phel ba'i skabs dang sa paṇa chen// nar son tsam dang khro lo byams pa dpal// la sogs mkhas grub sa steng khyab pa'i skabs// kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī zhes// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas rab gsal rnam par 'phrul// yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan 'dzin pa chen po de/

ljongs 'dir spyan drangs chos rje sa paṇa dang*// byang rdor rnam gnyis la sogs bod yul gyi// dge 'dun sde rnams bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod// dam chos nyin byed snang ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// de phyin 'jam mgon paṇa chen sdom rgyun dar// lho brag byang chub dpal ba nas brgyud de// dge 'dun sgang dang chos lung mkhan po sogs// brgyud cing gzhan yang dbus pa rdo rje dpal// brgyud nas tshegs rtse las 'phros bye rdzings pa'i// mkhan rim brgyud par byung 'dis phyogs kun khyab// dran pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs 'phrog mthong bas ni// yang dag thar pa'i go 'phang sbyin nus pa'i// rgyal ba gnyis pa brjod par dka' ba'i mtshan// don slad smos na rje btsun karma pa// dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyin byed 'chi med grub pa'i khyu mchog phrin las rgyas pa'i sde// zhes pa'i drung nas nod pa'i sdom rgyun ni// bcom ldan sangs rgyas rnam 'dren bzhi pa mchog /shes rab thogs med 'phags pa shā ri'i bu// gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin dang brah+ma// rā hu la ste slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs// yon tan blo gros rin chen bshes gnyen dang*// chos kyi bzang po yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs// chos kyi phreng ba blo gros 'byung gnas sbas// paṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra yan// rgya gar las 'byon bod kyi 'dul 'dzin pa// byang chub dpal dang gtsang pa dbang phyug grags// gzhon nu byang chub yon tan rgyal ba dang*// mkhan chen yon tan blo gros sed+ge dpal// rab 'byor sed+ge chos grub sed+ge sogs// dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan rim las brgyud nas// rgyal dbang brgyad pa rdo rje dga' ba'i dbyangs// gar dbang lnga pa dkon mchog shākya'i gtso// dbang phyug rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// grub dbang bdud rtsi karma rnam rol pa// gar dbang brgyad pa chos kyi don grub zhabs// bstan pa'i nyin byed gtsug lag chos snang ba// snyigs dus 'dren pa phyag na pad+mo can// rgyal mchog bcu gsum mthon mthing cod pan 'chang*// rje btsun bdud las rnam par rgyal de yi// zhabs kyi pad+ma mchog la gus btud nas// sdom gsum nor bu'i phreng ba bdag lta bu// so skye las kyang so skyer gyur mod kyang*// sngon goms tshogs gnyis rmad byung smin pa'i mthus// bstan ba'i snying por gyur pa kaṃ tshang gi

/ring lugs sgor zhugs ma nor yongs 'dzin gyi// dam pas rjes bzung bslab gsum sdom pa yi// tshul khrims rgyan bzang bdag ltas nod pa'i dges// rgyal bstan snying por gyur pa gang yin pa// de 'dzin skyes mchog zhabs brtan phrin las rgyas// lung rtogs yon tan mdzod 'dzin rig pa dang*// grol ba'i sar gnas dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs// kun kyang byams dang snying rjes rgyud brlan cing*// chos spyod bcu dang 'khor lo rnam gnyis sogs// rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ra byed par smon// 'jig rten khams su'ang sems can thams cad bde// lha klu gnod sbyin mi ma yin rnams kyang*// dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mel tshe sgrub bzhin du// sdang ba'i sems kyi 'tshe dang bral bar shog /khyad par bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs gang*// dri med rnam dag nges gsang snying po'i bstan// nyams med yun gnas ma 'ongs rnam par 'dren// byams mgon bdud rtsi brnyes par gyur gyi bar// shāka thub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho ba// mi nub srid mthar spel bar gcig tu smon// de ltar smon pa'i bden tshig bslu med pa// bden pa'i bdag nyid bla med dkon mchog gsum// byin rlabs stobs kyis ji ltar smon pa rnams// bden pa dam pas deng 'dir bden 'grub shog /de ltar tshul 'dir mos pa'i dang ba can// sde snod 'dzin pa karma don dam gyis// 'dul pa'i mkhan brgyud zin tho rab gsal ba// spel zhes bris 'dir 'khrul pa'i cha gang dang*// tshe rabs sgrib dang chabs cig mthol lo bshags// dge gang bsags des 'gro ba'i ma rig ba'i// dug lnga'i mun bcom yang dag ye shes kyi// nyi ma chen pos snang ba'i gsos 'gyur shog / ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos nag zla'i rgyal ba gnyis par spel ba kun tu dza ya/// / ༈ 'pho ba gsang mchog ma'i dmigs rim la/ rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar nang dmar ba rag dung kha gyen bstan/

mar sna lte mtshams phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ snying khar pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i steng du rnam shes ngo bo sogs gzhung bzhin gsal gdab bo// yang thig le spar skabs las dang po pas thugs kar/ de nas zhabs la reg pas chog /lan nyer gcig tsam bya/ 'pho ba 'byongs rtags su yar spar dus shes pa cung mi gsal zhing mar phab dus rgyun par las rig pa dwangs na yin/ bla ma 'od dpag med 'od du zhu nas rang lus la thim pas lus bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la tshe gzungs 'don/ las la sbyor tshe/ bla ma spyi bo nas yar 'dom gang tsam bskyed/ de'i thugs kar thig le spar/ mar mi phab gsar du re re bskyed de spar ba lan nyer gcig tsam bya'o/// / ༈ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te sogs 'di'i ming la gzi brjid tshad med zer/ dzaṃ ser nag gnyis rgyab yol la thim par bsgom/ de nas chu gtor/ de nas bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs sogs sh+tsau ka bzhi brjod/ yig brgya brjod/ de rjes oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs gzhung bzhin brjod do// 'pho ba dang gtor ma'i brjed tho 'di kun khyab lugs yin/// / ༈ karma pa'i rlung sems gnad kyi gdams pa las/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i rnam rtog gang shar ba'i skabs rlung phyir 'bud na 'gal rkyen sel lo// de nas snying khar bla ma bsgom dgos/ mos gus dang*/ snying rje/ bskyed rdzogs/ bde gsal mi rtog pa sogs 'char dus rlung nang du bsdus na dngos grub thob/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug thams cad rlung sems kyi rten 'brel yin gsungs so// mdor na rlung sems ngan pa thams cad phyir phud/ bzang po thams cad nang du bsdu'o// thams cad dbyer med ro gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /

bstan pa'i nyin byed mchog gis bka' bstsal pa// zab lam mthar thug nā ro chos drug ni// nyin par mnyam gzhag gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang*// rjes thob sgyu lus mtshan mo'i mnyam gzhag tu// 'od gsal rjes thob rmi lam lam du khyer// mdor na lus kyi byed bcing ngag rlung gnad// mi shigs thig ler sems kyi gnad bcings pas// gzung 'dzin 'khrul tshogs rang bzhin dbyings su dag /'pho med bde ba chen po'i tshogs rdzogs pas// rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen po la// dgyes rol sku bzhi'i rgyal sa thob par 'gyur// zhes so/// / ༈ btags grol mthong chog 'khor lo'i lo rgyus phan yon bzhugs/ sprul pa'i sku gang nas thugs res rgyur/ de phyogs yul sde spyi la thar pa'i lam bzang ston pa'i thabs zab mo dam pa rigs brgya 'dus pa'i btags grol tsakra 'di nyid la dgos bya'i rdzas tshang zhing*/ man ngag thams cad gzhung mthun du bstar ba'i sgrub pa rab gnas sogs tshad ldan gang 'brel don ldan du bgyis yod par/ grong tshan mig mthong rer chos mthun ya rabs kyi sbyin bdag re'i khang thog tu zangs sam rdza'i ga'ur bcug te char chus mi gos par lha tho lta bur bcos pa'i nang du bzhugs su gsol/ bzhag mkhan kyang bla ma sprul sku 'am/ dge slong sdom ldan re'i phyag bstar las mi mang lag brgyud mi rung*/ zla ba gang rung gi tshes brgyad la bsang dang*/ ri khyim la khrus/ phyogs der 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams kyis dge chos gang nus dang*/ lhag par srog bslu gang 'grub re khas len byed dgos pa'i dril bsgrags/ las 'bras kyi chos kyang ston nas dge la sbyor ba sogs rnam par dkar ba'i bsam sbyor dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di nyid kyi phan yon zhib rgyas smos su mi langs kyang*/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas btags grol rgyud kyi las mtha' nas 'di ltar gsungs te/

grong khyer gcig la 'di yod na: :grong khyer nang gi sems can rnams: :grol ba thob par the tshom med:: rten mchog rlung phog des gzhan phog: :sdig sgrib dag nas grol bar 'gyur: zhes gsungs pa'i lo rgyus dang ba 'dren phyir 'chad nas/ sems can la sman pa'i sems bskyed go cha g.yel med kyi 'gan bzhes smon bzang ci nas 'tshal/ dpal spungs yang dben nas tā'i si tus spel/// / ༈ grong khyer sgrol 'khor chen mo'i phan yon lo rgyus yod/ 'gro phan gyi cha rkyen grong khyer sgrol ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ sngon jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdo phyogs man ngag thams cad kyi nying khu tsakra'i tshul du mdzad pa skur bcangs 'bral med gnang nas/ phyis sku gshegs khar 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la bstsal te/ 'di las zab pa'i gdams ngag bod na med pas khyod kyis 'gro don gyis shig ces gsungs par brten/ de nas rim par da lta'i bar brgyud pa ma chad cing*/ phyag bzhes kyi rgyun ma nor ba dang*/ dgos bya'i rdzas tshang la/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas sgrub pa thems shing*/ rab tu gnas pa kho bos bgyis pa yin pas/ spyir phan yon dpag tu med kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ rten mchog 'di nyid zangs sam/ rin po che'i ga'ur dar tshon gyis bsgril te bcug /char chus mi gos par byas te/ bud med dang*/ mi mang lag brgyud 'dzem/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs par brtsi ba'i yar tshes la dge slong sdom ldan bzhi sdes lha bsang btang*/ rdo rje rnam 'joms sgo nas ri khrus dang*/ khyim khrus bya/ bkra shis brtsegs mdo bklag /sems can srog bslu tshe thar gang mang zhig byas te khang steng rgyal mtshan gyi rtser bzhugs su gsol te rab gnas dang*/ bkra shis brjod/ sems can thams cad bde skyid 'byung ba'i don du snying thag pa nas bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor byas na/ yul der gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams kyi mchod rten du 'gyur bas/

gnas skabs lha srung ngo so mtho zhing dgyes pa bskangs pas lo legs zhing*/ char chu dus su 'bebs/ nad yams dang dus 'khrugs zhi/ lo zla'i skag rigs las grol ba dang*/ mthar thug rten de mthong dang rlung rdzis phog pa'i gzugs can gzugs med sems can thams cad ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las grol te mngon mtho'i lam bzang rnyed/ rim par nges legs kyi go 'phang la gzhol nus pa ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' yis nam yang mi bslu bas mos gus kyi rten du gces spras su 'dzin 'tshal/ zhes si tu pas chos sbyin du spel ba dge// / ༈ 'khor lo lus la 'chang ba'i phan yon dang lo rgyus yod/ 'gro phan gyi cha rkyen grong khyer sgrol ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ sngon jo bo rje dpal mar me mdzad kyis mdo phyogs man ngag thams cad kyi snying khu tsakra'i tshul du mdzad nas 'bral med skur bcang gnang*/ phyis sku gshegs khar 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la bstsal te// 'di las zab pa'i gdams ngag bod du med pas khyod kyis 'gro don gyis shig gsungs par brten/ de nas rim bzhin da lta'i bar brgyud pa ma chad cing*/ phyag bzhes kyi rgyun ma nor ba dang*/ dgos bya'i rdzas tshang la 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas sgrub pa thems shing*/ rab tu gnas pa kho bos bgyis pa yin pas 'di nyid dar tshon gyis bsgril te/ mi nyams pa'i phyir bu har gyis g.yogs/ bud med dang mi mang lag brgyud 'dzem/ zhag bdun sha chang spangs zhing*/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge bar rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus zhu zhing*/ sems can gyi srog bslu tshe thar nges shig byas te dge pa'i 'dun pa bzang po'i mtshams sbyor dang bcas rang gzhan gyi mgul du 'chang na/ spyir phan yon dpag tu med kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ gnas skabs su lo zla'i skag rigs las grol zhing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun thub pa dang*/ mthar thug ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo chod cing*/

rim par mngon mtho dang*/ nges legs kyi sar 'jog cing*/ 'chang ba po de mthong ba dang*/ yod pa'i phyogs kyi sems can thams cad ngan 'gro las sgrol nus pa ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang*/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i lung gis nam yang mi bslu bas som nyi spangs te dad pa dang mos gus kyi rten du gces spras su 'dzin 'tshal/ zhes si tu pas chos sbyin du spel ba dge// / ༈ sa lug lor sgrub sde sgrub brgyud sangs rgyas gling du dpal ma hā kā la'i rten gtor sgrub pa'i lag len ni/ dang po rnam rgyal 'joms/ tshig 'dun gsol 'debs/ bsam pa lhun grub/ bar chad lam sel/ karma pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs gsar 'dzud de dang*/ mgon po'i brgyud 'debs bcas/ phag mo'i bdag bskyed sogs dgu gtor ltar gsal bar gyur bar nas srung 'khor bsnyen pa/ rang gi thugs kar/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa/ oṃ shri ma hā sogs/ lha tshogs rnams sogs/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā sogs/ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la sogs/ rgyas par mdzod bar/ de nas rten gtor yig chung nang ltar/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭo sogs nas/ stong par gyur pa'i sogs nas/ khaṃ las brag steng*/ rigs mthun 'khor gyis bskor/ phyogs bzhi'i rwa dang pad+ma la sogs/ gshegs par gyur nas spyan 'dren rol chen dbyangs dang bcas te sngon gyi thugs dam/ bskal me ma/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i/ byang shar chos dbyings/ dad pa dang/ gshegs su gsol/ oṃ ma hā kā li traka rak+ṣa thun bh+yo sa ma ya ma hā kā la de wa rak+ṣa sogs nyer gcig /gtum po 'jigs rung*/ dbang bskur/ rten gtor nang gi rgyas btab sbyar nas/ tshogs ltem/ mnyam med ma/ bskal mang mchod pa byin rlabs/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ sman rag gnyis/ tshogs byin rlabs/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs gsang sngags nang gtor/ 'grub mdzod nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ la sogs/ bla med mchod pa/ gzhong pa rnam dag sngags ring bcas/ dam zhing a phyi/

tshe ring ma/ brag btsan/ thang lha/ mkha' 'gro gzhi bdag spyi gtor bcas/ bstod pa gang drin/ rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ thugs rje chen po/ gar gyi dbang phyug srin gzugs/ hūm̐ skyes 'bar ba/ las rnams/ rlung 'tshub/ sems nyid ma/ nag po/ bcom ldan 'das/ bstod par 'os/ lus dang grib ma bzhin sogs/ mdun bskyed mgon po sogs/ bsnyen pa ring thung rnams dang*/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs kyi rten bzhugs/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha nas tshogs grol/ yar 'tshogs gsol ka rgyas pa gcig /bsdu ma gnyis/ phyag bzhi pa'i gsol ka gsum lha mo'i gsol ka gsum/ dam zhing gsol ka re re/ skong ring*/ skong 'bring*/ skong thung gsum/ byang shar chos dbyings sogs lha mo'i skong ba/ 'khrugs skong bcas/ tshe ring ma'i skong ba/ bdag sgrub ma/ dus gsum ma/ tshogs ltem/ yang lus dang grib ma bzhin sogs nas/ mdun bskyed mgon po sogs sngags bsnyen/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha bar tshogs grol/ yar 'tshogs la rten gtor nang daṃṣ+ṭoṭ+kaṭa sogs nas/ stong par gyur pa'i nas/ khaṃ las brag steng sogs/ rigs mthun 'khor gyis bskor bar/ phyogs bzhi'i ra dang pad+ma la gnas/ gshegs par gyur bar spyan 'dren rnams bsdu zhing trak+ṣa ting laṃ nyer gcig nas/ bstod pa gnyis bsdu ma/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po'i me tog sogs/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ sman raka gnyis dang*/ gsang sngags nang gtor/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ sogs/ bla med mchod pa/ gzhong pa rnam dag sngags ring dang*/ mchod pa'i sngags bsdu ma rnams grub nas/ bstod pa mtshal ma bsdus pa bzhin par bgyi bar/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du mi 'bral bar sogs/ rol mo/ mdun bskyed mgon po sogs nas bsnyen pa sngags ring thung rnams bya/ de nas 'gugs gzhug bsdus pa gcig dang rbad sngags bcas/ gang zhig ma/ trika khrom sogs dang*/ chos dbyings ma/

smin mtshams sogs/ āḥhūm̐/ tshogs rol/ zhabs brtan sogs bton/ phud dang lhag ma'i sogs/ mdzod bar nas/ khrag gi rgya mtsho ma/ ḍā ki bye ba/ don dam ma/ rlung nag /oṃ sa ma sogs tshar gsum re/ ma 'ongs pa na sogs/ bdag ni mngon/ bdag dang 'gro la/ rten gtor nang gi/ dpal ldan mgon sogs/ ye dhar dang su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ sngon tshe bcom ldan sogs/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs smon lam bya'o// grol nyin bstod pa byas pa'i mtshams spyi byer gyi gsol skong sogs grub nas/ dus gsum kun tu ma bsgribs bar/ de nas bsnyen sngags rnams bzla zhing*/ 'gug gzhug man dkyus dang 'dra/ nyi shar sngon 'tshogs nas nyin gung bar gseng*/ 'phral 'tshogs nas/ phyed yol yol pa bar gseng*/ nyi thal nas dgong chen bar/ de nas gnyid log cing grol nyin nam gyi srod thun brda' las snga tsam yin lags/ ces zla 2pa'i tshes 7la dbu brtsams te zla tshes 14la legs par grub pa'i zin tho rnams si tu pad+ma'i ming gis sug bris su bstar pa/ bstan pa'i snying po gang zhe na// karma bka' brgyud bstan pa ste// rgyu skar dbus su ri bong can// ji bzhin yongs su gsal byed shog /mad+ga laṃ shrī mastu/// / ༈ thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sgo nas skye bdun bum sgrub kyi zin bris dri med pad+ma'i rgya bkrol thabs mchog snying rje'i lde mig bzhugs so// na mo lo kī shwa ra ya/ 'dir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i las tshogs skye bdun ril bu sgrub pa'i thabs ni sna sel gyi 'don bya dge chos sogs sgrub chen spyi 'gre sngon du grub par byas la/ de las kyang thog ma nyid nas/ dang po rgyud las bshad pa'i skye bdun dam rdzas dang*/ gu ru rin po che'i gter kha las byon pa'i 'khrul med a rgya ma sogs la gzhi byas te/ myong bas grol nus kyi tai lo nā ro nas bzung bka' brgyud gong ma rnams dang*/

rnying ma'i gter chen gang zag lung zin rnams kyi byin rlabs rten sel med kyi rigs rnams gang 'dzoms dang*/ dzā ti/ sug smel/ ka ko la/ cu gang*/ li shi/ gur gum/ gla rtsi/ dbang lag /rtag du/ a bar skyur gsum rnams phye mar btul ba 'bras phye dang sbyar nas ril bur dril la/ mtshal gyis kha dog bsgyur/ bum par blugs/ ril chags legs par grub nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sa bslang sogs spro na der bstun/ 'don bya rnams gzhung gsal ltar dang de min ras bris bkram pa'i steng du bkod/ de'i steng thod pa mtshan ldan dang me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs mthong rgyun ltar bshams pa ni sta gon no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil chog ltar bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas brtsams te lha dgu'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du btang*/ bum bskyed kyang gzhung ltar kha bsgyur la/ rdo rje'i chu rgyun bum pa'i rdzas kyis gang bar gyur pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang du myong grol dam rdzas kyi ril bu dang*/ dbyer med par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sogs/ bskyed bstim mchod bstod rnams zin nas bzlas pa'i skabs su slob dpon gyis gzungs thag 'dzin la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ dhā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sid+dhi pha la a be sha ya hūm̐ hrī: zhes pa stong phrag re'i mtshams su/ e ma ho: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag: rang byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ting 'dzin rtog med rang byung grol: dri med tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis mchod: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che: nga rgyal phrag don ye shes lnga: dbyings kyi dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes: stong tshigs mchod 'bul dbyings su bzhes: zhes thugs dam bskul lo// de ltar bdag bskyed dang*/ bum bskyed mdun bskyed bcas kyi bsnyen mthar rje rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed ltar sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di'ang lan nyer gcig re bzla dgos pas de'ang yig bcu'i gsham du/

ā+oṃ pad+ma tshin+dha ma ṇi dz+wa la hūm̐ hrīḥdzaḥ bi pu la gar+bhe ma ṇi pra bhe/ ta thā ga ta ni/ ti ri gi ni/ ma ṇi ma ṇi su pra bi ma le/ sa ga ra gam+bhi ra hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bud+dha bi lo ki bid+ya gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā/ pad+ma dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā/ bsgom dang bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang*// sgrib pa kun sel tshogs gnyis rdzogs// zhes gsungs pas shin tu byin che/ 'di skabs tshogs mang gzhung bsrang rnams nas bum bskyed kyi bsnyen pa'i mthar yig bcu'i sham bur sngags kyi skye bdun 'di'ang stong phrag re 'gro nges dgos/ thun bzung rnams nas thog mar yig bcu brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas thun ma grol bar yig bcu'i sham bur skye bdun sngags 'di btags te bzla'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ a ra pa tsa mi ta hri da ya swā hā/ ril bu dam rdzas ye shes gnyis su med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ngo bor mos pa de las bum lha 'od zhu mi dgos zhing*/ de nas las bum rta mgrin bskyed pa sogs gzhung gsal ltar bton la sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mgrin gyis sogs/ phrin bcol bya/ de ltar thun gsum mam bzhir bum bskyed slar bskyar zhing 'don/ thun rjes mar mdun bskyed dang mchod bzhi bstod bzhi/ tshogs gtor bsngos nas bkra shis brjod pa'i bar mthar chags su btang*/ bdag 'jug dbang len rgyu grol nyin bar bskyur/ dang po nyin bdag bskyed bsnyen ba'i nang nas thun pa rnams kyis rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung gis thun bzung sngags yig bcu dang*/ slar sham bu can kho nar 'bad/ zhag lnga tsam song nas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i snying po sku lnga ye shes lnga ru sbyor ba dang*/ phung po'i bdud bcom nas tshe'i rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i snying po 'di yang brgya re tsam bzla dgos pas/

ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ swa hā/ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañtsa ā+oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā puṇ+ye tiṣ+ṭha ā+oṃḥ mthar stod tshigs kyi mchod 'bul sogs gong bzhin bya/ de nas gsum pa dngos grub len pa ni/ grol nyin thun pa mang mas mdun bskyed bsnyen pa'i skabs nas sngags rgyun bzhag /dpon slob tshang mas dkyil chog gzhung ltar dbang rgyas par blangs nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po sgrubs shig ces pa'i mtshams su thal mo sbyar la/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: dri med shel mdog ces tshig bsgyur bas bshags pa bya ste ru dra'i smre bshags dang don gcig go// ho: dgongs shig rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: brtse ba'i thugs mnga' 'gro ba'i skyabs: sa bcu'i dbang phyug thugs rje can: ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: gus pas gsol ba rgya mtsho 'debs: phrin las rgya mtsho 'grub pa dang: 'khor ba rgya mtsho las sgrol nas: yon tan rgya mtsho rab rdzogs te: sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'grub bar shog: ces lan gsum brjod la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ zhes brjod bzhin rdo rje slob dpon gyis ril bu'i bum pa gnas bzhir gtug /tshogs pa la'ang bskur cing ril bu gsum re sbyin/ bum chu phul/ yig drug sogs dge rtsa rlabs chen khas len byed du bcug /de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dbang gi mtha' bsdu zhing tshogs 'khor btang ba dang*/ skabs 'dir gzhan don phrin las kyi ched du khrom dbang byed par spro na/ gong gi bdag 'jug ci lta bar dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs mthar chags su bskur/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// sogs bton skabs khrom rnams phyag 'tshal du bcug /de nas/ hoḥ dgongs shig sogs kyis thugs rje lan gsum bskul zhing*/

de nas sngags bzla bzhin par ril bu'i bum pas dbang bskur/ myong grol dam rdzas kyang bkye/ mthar 'brel thogs de dag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la bkod phyir dge rtsa gang 'grub kyi bskul ma gdab nas grol/ slar sgrub khang nas rjes kyi bya ba lhag gtor btang ba dang*/ mchod bstod dang*/ lhag chad bskang zhing*/ de nas rdul tshon nam ras bris bsdu rim dang*/ bkra shis brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam mtha' rgyas spel legs bya'o// yang 'dir sgrub chen gzhan dang phyogs mtshungs kyi/ thog mar sta gon skabs nyin nas gegs bsal ba'i ched du/ gter rnying gang rung las 'byung ba'i rta mgrin dmar po'am/ nag po'i sgo nas sgrub zlog zur du tshad ldan bca' ba'am/ yang na rje dgu pa'i yi dam drag phreng las 'byung ba'i rta mgrin gyi sgom bzlas gtor bsngos/ bsnyen pa gang 'gro byas pas kyang don gcig tu 'bab pas des kyang 'thus so// zhes zin bris 'di ltar sngon chad med phyir kho bos rang bzo byas so snyam na/ karma chags med zhabs kyis rgyal brgya mtsho'i 'grel chen las/ skye bdun bum sgrub rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyis khog phub nas bsgrub rgyu gsungs pa dang*/ mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma dang spo ru byams chos pa sogs kyis kyang thugs rje chen po'i bum sgrub kyi yig cha ka dpe ma kho nar ma ltos par skye bdun sgrub tshul dang*/ rang re gsar ma rnams la'ang bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs shing*/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje la o rgyan rin po ches skye bdun sgrub lugs gnam chos dag snang ma stsal pa la'ang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i las byang gang rung la brten nas sgrubs shig ces rdo rje'i tshig gis rjes su gnang zhing*/ khyad par rat+na gling pa'i thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho gnyis lha sngags gcig cing*/ chos kyi bdag po rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho la bka' babs pas dbang lung chu bo gcig 'dres su byung ba yin mod de lta na'ang 'di ni rung mthun tsam du byas pa ma yin te rat+na gling pa'i gter byon thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs dri med pad+ma'i rgya can sku gsung thugs kyi gzer lung sum brgya dang bcas pa 'di'i lha sngags thams cad rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu rang yin bzhin de yi sngags kyi sham bu dang dngos grub bskul ba'i tshigs bcad tsam zhig lhan thabs su sbyar ba las gzhan bcos bsgyur byas pa med la/

yang kha cig gis rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi ril bu nyid bsgrub pas 'thus so snyam na/ de ni dbang sdud kyi rdzas gtso bor mdzad pa'i ril bu yin pas rdzas kyang dka' la skye 'gro thun mong ba la sbyin rgyu'i phan yon yang ma bshad pa dang*/ skul ba po'i re ba bskang phyir du zin bris 'di byas kyi/ de'i yig cha ma mthong pa'am/ rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa ma lon pa ni ma yin pas/ chos kyi gnad ma go bar tshig tsam lhur len nas dpyod ldan chen por snyems shing bla ma'i bka' ras su bor ba'i deng dus kyi mkhas rlom dag gi ca co la skal ldan rnams rna ba ma gtod cig /ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis/ nye char dpon bsam gtan sprul ba'i sku dang*/ ring mo nas 'jang drung pa'i sprul sku'i bzhed ngor phyogs med kyi 'gro don rgya cher 'byung ba'i phyir du gsal bar bkod pa 'di'ang dge zhing shis par gyur cig /mad+ga lam̐/// / ༈ thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi sgo nas bum sgrub chen mo'i phyag len rnams zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so// na mo lo kī shwa ra ya/ 'dir sprul pa'i gter chen rat+na gling pa'i zab chos thugs rje gsang 'dus kyi sgrub chen skabs su nyer mkho'i phyag len go bde bar bkod pa la/ nyin dang por/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs mthar rol mo byin rlabs ched du brgya brdung byas la mthar rol mo bzhag /spyi gtsug pad sdong 'don snang yang dmigs pa gsal 'debs nyid du nges pa'i yig rnying rnams la'ang yig chung gras bkod ltar 'don par mi bya'o// thal mo sbyar la/ na mo bla ma dkon mchog sogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams lan gsum re/ de nas gsar bsgrigs nang gi/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rta mgrin sogs dang*/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs bsnyen pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de tshe mchod bshams pas stegs bu'i dbus su sa lha'i tshom bu bkod/

mdun du zlum gtor chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas skor bshams bya/ cha gsum gtor ma bshams/ sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dang po thal mo khong stong gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs gsum/ ral gri'i rgyas/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum/ rdor thal gyen bstan rgyas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsum/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung lug rgyud kyi nang du sbrel/ lhag ma rnams sbrengs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs gsum/ lag gnyis rgyab bsnol 'khor lo'i rgyas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs gsum/ mchog sbyin pa'i rgyas/ na maḥsarba sogs gsum/ zhes pas byin brlabs nas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten sogs la rgyun gdangs kyis 'geb tshig bzhi'i mtshams dril gsil kun la rigs 'gre dgos/ shab+da'i bar mchod rol sum 'phar kun la 'gre'o// dbang po rdo rje nas/ mchis par mdzod mthar mchod rol/ lha dang lha min dang*/ shab+da'i mthar mchod rol/ 'byung po gang dag sogs mchod rol/ skad cig gis rang nyid rta mchog sogs dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa zhes kha bsgyur ba 'di phyin dgug gzhug rnams la'ang 'gre'o// shab+da'i mthar mchod rol/ gang zhig ma'i oṃ chen po'i skabs sam gang bder slob dpon dbu zhwa chos gos rdor dril bcas bzhengs nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du phyogs la/ gats+tsha nas mchod rol bya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī hrīḥ sogs/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la brdeg /hūm̐ ji ltar sngon gyi sogs 'di rigs gong 'og la dril gsil dgos/ sngags mthar mchod rol bya/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon yang bcom ldan sogs/ mthar mchod rol zlum gtor dang mchod pa rnams bsdu/ khyod ni shākya sogs thim par gyur/ tshom bu'ang bsdu/ slob dpon g.yas skor gyis shar du bzhengs/ zhal shar la phyogs pas/ bdag nyid dbang chen sogs nas/

re rer gyur bar/ de nas dpyid gsum lho/ dbyar gsum nub/ ston gsum byang*/ dgun gsum shar te/ de dag dang mtshungs pa'i zhal phyogs la/ ha ha hūm̐ gi mthar rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol/ 'byung po rkang pa'i mes sogs/ zhi bar gyur bar/ g.yas bskor gyis shar lho nas/ hūm̐ nga ni dbang chen sogs/ mthar rdo rje gsor zhing dril gsil bcas/ nub tu byon la shar du phyogs pas/ las rdor gyis spro na/ snod kyi nang dbang mchog phur pas gtsos phur pa bcu bkod/ bsdu na gcig gis chog /slob dpon gyis gtso phur 'dzin bzhin/ bdag gis thugs ka nas sogs/ phyogs bcur bsgril ba'i stangs stabs bcas/ oṃ gha gha sogs kyi skabs stegs bu'i dbus su gsungs kyang shar la gdab/ phur pa bcu yod na las rdor rnams kyis phyogs dang mtshams su dus gcig gdab dgos/ phur bu las sogs 'don/ sa sbyong ba ni/ 'o ma rtsi sman rnams ku sha'i chun pos stegs bu la 'thor/ bdag dbang chen sogs kyi mthar/ tshogs thengs bya/ dal brel skabs bstun gyis/ ser sbrengs chas bsgrig /rgyal tho bzhi'i mchod pa/ mchod yon me tog zhal zas sogs dang*/ zlum gtor/ chu bum/ 'thor g.yab/ phyag nas/ tho byang rnams rim pas sngon du bskur la/ mchod bshams pa gnyis kyis res mos byed la bshams/ ser sbrengs la dang po spos sna dang rgya gling*/ rag dung*/ de nas yo byad rnams dang rnga pa kha shas/ rol mo ba/ spos 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rgyal po/ dbu gdugs pa/ rgyal thebs bzhi/ yang rnga pa kha shas bcas/ de yang dang po rol mo 'bebs kyi mthar sum brdung kho nas phyi rol la gshar zhing*/ shar tho'i rtsa bar slebs nas rol mo 'bebs mthar bzhag /go rim sngon ltar gyis 'greng bzhin zlum skor lta bu byas la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ bdag nyid sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe sogs rang gdangs dang*/

hūm̐/ ri rab chen po yang sbrel/ mthar rol tshig gong ltar gyis bzhag /sngags lan gsum/ sngags mthar ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe sogs sbyar ba'i mthar dril gsil dang*/ gtor sngags lan gsum/ sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs rgyal po sogs gdangs mthar sum brdung dang 'bebs kyis zhabs/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod la me tog 'thor zhing*/ sngar ltar rol mo dang bcas lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang sogs la'ang de ltar rigs 'gre'o// 'di'i sngon tsam lcags ri'i sgo 'gram nas gom gsum mam bdun gyi mtshams dong gru gsum gting zab pa brko bcug /der shog ling bzhag /gser skyems chas 'bru sna chang phud/ phud phor dar btags pa dang g.yab dar/ rkang gling*/ zangs lcags/ rdo phye/ yungs kar sogs thun rdzas rnams dang*/ skyer phur/ gu gul/ rlung g.yab/ me/ chu/ sa/ dur rdo la rdo rje rgya gram steng ri rab bris pa sogs 'du byas la/ ser sbreng de gar slebs bstun rol mo 'bebs mthar bzhag /slob dpon nam las rdor gyis gser skyems 'dzin bzhin/ hūm̐ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs gdangs thung byed la bskul mtshams rnams su/ rol mo 'bebs sngon mar mchod cing*/ 'bebs rjes mar skyems phud blugs pa bcas mthar rol mo bzhag /oṃ hrīḥ pad+ma ta krita sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung*/ gsang 'dus le brgyad ltar/ na mo rje btsun sogs nas kha bsgyur ni/ khyad par du'ang thugs rje chen po sogs nas/ mthar sgrub pa zab mo la sogs khug cig gi bar/ rol mo drag 'bebs/ g.yab dar g.yab/ bshug pa bcas de ltar lan gsum/ rjes ma'i mthar bdun brdung 'theng po gnyis mthar/ dam sri bya ba'i sogs gnubs gdangs/ da ni khro bo'i skabs tshigs rnga mtshams rgyag byed la skyer phur yang gdab/ thun rdzas rnams kyang brdeg /gu gul bdug /ri rab brjid pa'i skabs mtshams rgyag mthar gong ltar bdun brdung gnyis mthar 'ur brdung tshe/ rlung*/ me/ chu/ sa rnams kyis mnan/

dur rdos bkab la dong kha bsdoms/ de tshe rol chen gang rung zhig brdung mthar rol mo bzhag /rta bro'i gdangs thung gis/ hūm̐ gcig ni brjod med sogs 'don skabs/ mnan pa'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la de tshe mchod g.yog rnams kyis rnga rol rnams bsdus nas bro ra'i gzhung du bzhag /oṃ sum+bha ni brjod tshe bro ra zlum po mchod dpon gyis legs par bsgrigs/ de'ang lag gnyis bsnol la/ zhi bar mdzub mo/ rgyas par gung mo/ dbang la srin lag /drag por mthe'u chung ste de dag gi go rim ma nor bas phreng ba 'dzin la sbrel zhing*/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'bar ba'i sogs gdangs bcas mthar/ sum+bha ni brjod skabs bro ra gru bzhi/ zla gam/ zur gsum bcas bcad kha nang bstan bya/ de tshe sgrub khang sgo byang phyi nang gi mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ rta bro'i mthar ser sbrengs rol mo sngar ltar bcas sgrub khang sgo drung nas rol mo bzhag la sgo byang bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs nas sa ma dzaḥ'i mthar dril gsil dang sngags lan bdun/ gtor sngags lan gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs mthar dril gsil dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ gsang 'dus mchog sogs/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyi zhabs sngags skabs me tog 'thor/ rol mo sngar ltar bcas/ sgo byang nang mar yang rol tshig gdangs sogs sngar ltar mthar rol mo bzhag nas/ ser sbrengs chas bsdu/ tshogs thengs bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor byang shar ngos su ma ṭaṃ gi mgo lho nub bstan la bzhag /dkyil 'khor dbus su slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin bzhin khri'u khar bzhugs gsungs kyang gang bder 'khod la/ nye skor du g.yab dar yungs kar dang ral gri bzhag /gsar bsgrigs nang gi/ oṃ pad+ma ta krita sogs dang*/ ma ṭaṃ ka ru tshar bdun dang*/ de nas dgug gzhug sngar ltar kha bsgyur bcas bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rnam pa ma ṭaṃ ru dra sogs nas sngags dang bcas rol mo drag 'bebs/ de ltar lan gsum bya/

hūm̐ ṭa ki rā dza sogs nyer gcig brjod cing yungs kar sngags ral gri la gtor/ oṃ badz+ra kī li sogs gsum/ de tshe rdo rjes bsgral tshul dang*/ mthar rol mo 'ur brdung dang nyis brdung gis/ gzugs phung sogs la rol mo mtshams rgyag gis 'don bzhin/ bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na lan brgyad/ de skabs ral gris lhu phral ba'i/ snying shar/ mgo bo lho/ nang khrol nub/ mtshan ma byang*/ lag g.yas shar lho/ g.yon lho nub/ rkang g.yon nub byang*/ g.yas byang shar/ khog pa dkyil 'khor 'og tu bcug /mthar rol mo 'bebs kyi rjes bdun brdung 'theng po lan gnyis kyis/ hūm̐ ma ṭaṃ bya ba'i sogs gnubs gdangs gyer/ mtha'i tshig la mtshams rgyag dang 'bebs mthar bzhag /de tshe slob dpon mdun 'bru'i khar khro bcu'i phur pa rnams phyogs mtshams ma 'khrul bar bzhag cing phur gdan bcu dang dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams la bkod/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka sogs dang*/ gzhal yas khang du gyur bar/ hūm̐/ gu gul byin skyed sogs kyi tshe/ mchod dpon pas gu gul bdug /yungs kar brab/ rak+ta dpal la bran/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita kyis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ phur bu mi dmigs pa sogs nas/ mthar rol mo 'bebs dang dgu brdung 'theng po thog mtha' dzab gnyis bcas zlog gdangs khug ma/ hūm̐/ steng gi phyogs sogs/ slob dpon la phur pa phul/ dkyil 'khor shar phyi g.yas ngos su gdab/ mtha'i tshig cig ring bar byed nas mtshams rgyag zhabs sngags rnams 'don mthar gong bzhin dgu brdung 'theng po sngon ltar gyis shar la sogs par rgyas bkab pa'i phur pa shar rang la gdab/ de nas shar lho/ lho/ lho nub/ nub/ nub byang*/ byang*/ byang shar/ 'og gi phur pa nub kyi g.yon du gdab par bya'o// rol mo sngar ltar/ hūm̐ khro chen 'bar ba sogs sngags kyi mthar dgu brdung 'theng po dang 'bebs kyis bzhag /de nas chag chag gdab pa ni/ rgyun gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ bla med gsang ba sogs/

las rdor gyis nang mchod 'dzin/ slob dpon gyis 'thor zhing mchod bshams pa rnams kyis byugs/ mthar zhi rol bya/ tshogs grol/ gung gseng/ de tshe lha sta gon ni/ slob dpon nam las rdor gyis dri bzang chus mu khyud phyi nang rim pa lnga bskor ba'i dbus su dri'i thig le gnyis/ de phyir bzhi/ de phyir bcu drug /de phyir drug /de phyir stong rtsa/ de phyir bzhi/ de rnams kyi steng du'ang tshom bu'ang so sor bkod/ mchod pa dang sman gtor rak+ta yang bshams/ de nas las byang gi brda' bsgo/ hūm̐ thugs rje'i rang rtsal nas/ byin 'bebs/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ mchod 'bul/ bstod pa yongs rdzogs lha'i mthar rol mo 'bebs bcas bzhag gsar bsgrigs nang gi/ ho dus gsum bla ma sogs thal mo sbyar la rgyun gdangs bcas mthar/ slob dpon gyis se gol gsum btab la sta gon gyi lha rnams nam mkhar btegs/ tshom bu dang mchod pa'ang bsal/ tshogs mang grol/ de nas thig gdab ni/ dang po tshangs thig slob dpon dkyil 'khor nub nas shar du phyogs/ las rdor shar nas nub du phyogs la/ slob dpon gyis/ hūm̐ bcom ldan bkra shis sogs 'don bzhin thig sna gtad/ sngags mthar gnam thig gdab/ hūm̐ stong nyid nam mkha' sogs dang*/ sngags mthar sa thig gdab/ slar yang slob dpon g.yas bskor gyis lho dang*/ las rdor byang du gnas pas gnam thig dang sa thig gdab bo// de nas zur thig la/ slob dpon shar lho/ las rdor nub byang du gnas par gnam thig dang sa thig gdab/ yang slob dpon lho nub/ las rdor byang shar 'khod bas gnam thig dang sa thig gdab la/ ras bris dkyil 'khor yang legs par bkram/ ril bu'i bum pa dgu'am lnga gang 'dzoms la dar phyogs mdog gi mgul chings sam bum gos ci bde dang*/ khar dbu rgyan bcings la zur zhig tu nangs bar bshams bde'i phyir bkod/ de nas gtor bsngos sogs skabs bstun gyis 'tshogs/ nyin gnyis par 'don bya rnams snga ma ltar la skyabs sems mthar/

hrīḥpad+man sogs sngon 'gro dang*/ hūm̐ nyon cig sogs dang*/ mtshams gcod nas las byang gzhung bsrang*/ 'di skabs rgyan bkod rnams stegs zur pa zhig la bshams bkod/ bsnyen pa sngags ring bzla skabs/ slob dpon gyis dbu zhwa chos gos bcas/ sku gzugs/ yig 'bru/ shel rdo/ sgro mdongs/ me long*/ mar me/ dbang gtor dang bum pa/ mchod bshams pa rnams kyis rtse zhwa bcas/ sman gtor rak+ta spos phor bcas 'dzin bzhin/ ye shes lha tshogs mthar zhi rol ring ba byed nas/ de tshe dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas mthar rol mo bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor mdun du phyogs bzhin pas gsar bsgrigs nang gi/ hūm̐/ bla med gsang ba sogs rgyun gdangs kyi tshe rten rnams zin par dgos pa'i/ dang po lding khri gong mar sku gzugs// yig 'bru/ shel rdo me long rma bya'i mdongs/ mar me/ rgya gram/ tsakli/ kā pa la bdud rtsis bkang ba chos sman dang mngar gsum btab pa/ dbang gi dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba can/ gtso bum dang las bum mgul chings dmar po can bum rdzas dang chu gtsang gis bkang ba rgyan dang bcas pa/ tshe gtor bum bzang khar rta mgos mtshan pa rtse rgyan can/ tshe ril chang*/ tshe mda' dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan bcas pa/ sangs rgyas stong dbang spro na de'i tsakli dang dgos chas rnams gzhung ltar bkod/ bshams bkod bde ba'i phyir/ lding khri 'og mar sngon du dkyil thang bkram pa'i steng gi mtha' skor gyi phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma dang*/ byang shar du chad tho dang*/ sngags srung ma/ brtan ma/ shar lhor smyo kha/ kun thub rgyal mo/ mkha' ri lcam dral/ lho nub ngas nus ma/ dam can/ lung btsan lcam dral/ nub byang a pa ra tsit+ta/ ye shes grags/ nor snyags sogs kyi gtor ma bzhag /so sor rang mdog gi gtor gdugs btsugs/ de'i steng thog 'geb bkod pa'i lding khri bar ma'i steng ril bu'i bum ba rnams dbus dang phyogs mtshams la bkod/

gtso bum g.yas su rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi thod pa dar sna lnga'i thum can/ g.yon du rak+ta dam rdzas kyi thod pa dar dmar gyi thum can bshams/ bum pa rnams kyi khar gzungs rdor re re bzhag pa'i gzungs thag rnams gtso bum la sbrel pa'i sne ring ba gsum byas pa'i rdor rgyal 'dzin rgyu dang*/ thun dpon bla mas 'dzin rgyu bcas lding khri kha nas phan tshun drang dgos/ gcig yig bdun tshogs pa'i dbur bzhugs kyis 'dzin rgyu rgyang ring bar stabs gang bdes 'then/ de phyir sgab skor nang mar yod na bskor/ dkyil 'khor mtha' skor la me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas bcas/ de rnams phyogs rer nyer bdun re bkod pa'i brgya rtsa brgyad re/ de'i phyi rol la'ang sgab skor gyis bskor/ 'gram gyi phyogs bzhir phur pa bzhi/ mar me bzhi/ mtshams bzhir ral gri bzhi/ mda' dar phyogs mdog bzhi/ steng gi phyogs bzhi ru dar bzhi/ mtshams bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi/ de rnams kyi g.yas g.yon 'phan re re ste khyon brgyad/ dbus su gdugs dkar po zhig phub/ dkyil 'khor mdun nam shar gang bder sman gtor rak+ta so sor sgron thur bcas dang*/ chu gnyis nyer bdun bcas phreng tshar bshams/ bka' srung spyi'i dmar gtor dang*/ dkar gtor/ chad tho/ brtan ma/ tshogs kyi yo byad sogs kyang bshams zin pa dang bstun/ sngags kyi 'don pa'i tshig mthar sngags bcas zhi rol bya/ 'dir tshogs thengs/ de nas gral bshams/ mnga' gsol 'os pa rnams 'khod nas/ las rdor zhig gis thod chang dang sgron thur bcas 'dzin bzhin/ tshogs pas zhwa bcas/ gzhung du las rdor gyis 'don gsungs kyang*/ slob dpon gyis 'don srol zhig kyang snang bas ci bder 'greng bzhin du/ hūm̐ rdo rje rgyal po sogs tshig rkang re bskul nas/ tshogs mang gis rjes zlos lta bu tshar re bskul zhing*/ bstan pa'i sgron me'i skabs/ slob dpon la bdud rtsi drangs/

dbu zhwa phud nas chang la zhugs tsam byed/ de rjes rgyal thebs slob dpon skabs de ltar drangs/ kun bzang yum gyi skabs/ thig sna 'dzin pa'i las rdor la/ rdo rje mtshams pa'i skabs/ kun thub 'chams pa bzhi/ rdo rje ging chen skabs/ ging dang ḍā ki/ rdo rje spyan ma'i skabs/ rgyal tho bzhi/ ging gi phyag tshang skabs/ chos khrims pa dang*/ mchod bshams pa rnams la'o// rdo rje byan mo'i skabs/ mdzod pa/ gnyer/ gsol dpon rnams dang ma chen la'o// gsal dag dza pra mkhas skabs/ tshogs mang la mchod bshams pa gnyis kyis drangs/ rdul phyags skyes bu'i skabs/ 'gag pa/ sgo srung pa/ thal sdud sogs so// rdo rje theg mchog skabs/ yon bdag rje 'bangs rnams yongs rdzogs la 'dren/ mthar zhi rol bcas rang gnas su btang*/ de nas dngos sta bsre ba ni/ slob dpon rnams bzhengs zhwa bcas/ sbub chol 'bebs chen ltar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ rang bzhin lhun grub sogs dang*/ mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ stong gsum phyogs bcu sogs/ byin 'bebs kyi mthar 'ur brdung zhabs slob dpon rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas/ mthar rol mo bzhag /tshogs grol/ gung gseng*/ de nas long skabs bstun pa'i slar yang*/ brda' bsgo nas las byang ltar mthar chags 'don pa'i/ chos dbyings rol pa'i mthar tshogs thengs/ de nas bsnyen pa dang*/ tshogs mchod nas bkra shis kyi bar dang tshogs thengs/ gtor bsngos sogs skabs dang bstun/ yang na tshogs mchod phyin chad nas bkra shis kyi bar bton pas 'thus/ ༈ de nas nyin bstar chags kyi 'don sgrig la/ nyin dang po dang gnyis pa'i skabs kyang 'di ltar phyogs mtshungs rgyu'i/ dang po tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ de nas na mo gu ru sogs brgyud 'debs rang gdangs ltar/ lho brag gnam skas nas thung du btang*/ snyigs ma lnga bdo nas slar yang thung zhing mthar rol mo brgya brdung gis bzhag /thal mo sbyar la/

na mo bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ kye ma bdag gis sogs gsum/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs nas/ thams cad kyis 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya gong 'og kun la rigs mtshungs dgos/ na mo rje btsun sogs nas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po zhes kha bsgyur zhing mthar dril gsil/ mchod sngags rnams la phyag rgya dang mthar zhi rol/ rdor thal kha gyen pas/ na maḥsarba sogs gsum/ gang dag dkyil 'khor sogs/ mtshams su dril gsil dang*/ mthar sbub chol nyis brdung dal bas/ hūm̐/ nyon cig sogs mthar sngags rnams mtshams rgyag zhabs su bton pa kun la rigs 'gre dgos shing*/ mthar gsang 'dus le brgyad dam gro lod bgegs bskrad rol chen res mos sum brdung mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ nga ni thugs rje'i sogs/ tshogs par gu gul spos 'grim byed/ mthar mtshams rgyag zhabs sngags mthar 'ur brdung gis bzhag /hūm̐ thugs rje'i rang rtsal sogs/ gzhan rnams la'ang bskul mtshams bcas sgo dbye'i rgya dang*/ thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐ 'khor 'das sogs dang*/ hūm̐ thugs rje'i sogs mthar ḍā dril dang*/ rol chen 'bebs bcas mthar sum brdung gis/ rnam dag spros dang sogs byin 'bebs/ 'di skabs dang spyan 'dren rnams la las rdor gyis zhwa bcas spos phor thogs bzhin tshogs par spos skor dang*/ de nas dkyil 'khor shar ngos su g.yab dar dang bcas 'greng bzhin/ slob dpon rnams kyis mtshams su dril gsil dang g.yab dar g.yab/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /thal mo sbyar la/ hrīḥ gsang 'dus thugs rje sogs mthar zhi rol/ byin rlabs sngags bzhi po lan gsum re/ thal sbyar bcas/ hūm̐ bla ma gsang 'dus sogs lan gsum/ shud+dhe a nas rol mo sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ spros med chos sogs/ gdangs kyi skabs sngags rnams mtshams rgyag zhabs 'don/ de min tshig rnga byed dgos/ sa ma ti hūm̐ mthar bskul mtshams kyis/ hūm̐/ e las stong gsal sogs dang*/

sngags mthar bskul mtshams kyis/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dal bus hrīḥsogs gdangs kyi tshe/ 'dab bzhi 'ja' 'od nas thung du btang nas mthar sum brdung bcas/ yi ge drug gi nas hrug 'don byed/ sngags rnams mthar ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs chen dang*/ mthar nyis brdung gis spyan 'dren/ hrīḥ rnam dag bde chen sogs/ mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /hrīḥ dam tshig gsang ba'i sogs dang*/ gdan 'bul gyi rgyan sngags dang bcas/ bskul mtshams dang thal sbyar gyis/ hrīḥ thugs rje'i rang rtsal sogs dang*/ bskul mtshams kyis/ hrīḥ snang stong zung 'jug sogs/ phyi mchod gdangs byas na/ hrīḥ thugs rje sogs phyag rgya'i 'grigs mthong rgyun ltar dang*/ de min kyang thal sbyar dgos/ mchod sngags mthar zhi rol bcas bzhag /nang mchod gdangs byed na sbub chol sum brdung byed/ de min mi dgos/ hrīḥ thugs rje sogs tshig rnga bcas nas bskul mtshams kyis/ hrīḥ thabs shes sogs mthar rol mo bzhag /nang mchod bdud rtsi bkye/ hrīḥ rang byung gdod nas sogs dang*/ hrīḥ rtsa brgyad sogs gnyis ka'i sngags mthar bdud rtsi 'thor/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas sogs bdud rtsi 'thor bzhin/ gdangs kyi tshe rgyal sras nas thung du btang*/ mchod dpon pas g.yas kyis thod chang thogs/ g.yon sgron thur gyis mchod cing*/ 'og gi rak+ta sogs kyang tshig dang mthun par mchod dgos/ mthar rol mo nyis brdung gis/ hrīḥ snang stong bde chen sogs nas/ mchod pa rnams mthar chags su bton pa'i sngags mthar rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ bder gshegs sogs gdangs kyi tshe/ thugs srog ye shes nas thung du btang mthar 'bebs dang nyis brdung gis/ hūm̐ chos dbyings rol pa'i mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /tshogs thengs/ hrīḥ gsang 'dus sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag 'dzin la bsnyen pa yig bdun phreng skor gsum gyi mtshams/ rgyal tho dang sgo byang gso bar btang*/

de nas bsnyen pa stong tsho lnga tsam bzla zhing sngags ring nyer gcig bcas/ 'di skabs rgyal thebs zhig gis sngags chas spras/ tshogs par zhwa gtad/ nyu le'i chas gral mdor bkod/ slar zhag bzhi lnga'i mtshams yig bdun la sngags shams sbyar rgyu de'ang nyer gcig tsam bzla'o// mthar thal mo sbyar la dril gsil bcas dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya tshar gsum dang*/ hūm̐ ye shes lha tshogs mthar zhi rol/ spos sna bcas/ rgyal thebs byon nas tshogs 'dabs khri'u khar bzhugs/ tshogs pa rnams zhwa bzhes la/ e yaṃ sogs nas dgug gzhug gsum la rol mo drag 'bebs bcas mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ chos dbyings sogs/ phrin las mdzod nas dril gsil dang mtshams rgyag gis phur pa 'dzin bzhin/ hūm̐/ nga ni pad+ma sogs nas mtshams rgyag zhabs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā sogs dril gsil bcas mthar phur pa gdab/ rol mo 'bebs mthar dgu brdung 'theng po thog mar dzab gnyis bcas lan gnyis kyis/ hūm̐ shar phyogs sogs/ 'di skabs chab bkye/ sa ma ya'i bar mtshams rgyag zhabs/ nyu le bskrad sngags rnams bton mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /de 'phral slob dpon rnams zhwa/ chos gos/ rdor dril/ g.yab dar/ spos sna bcas/ tshogs mang yang bzhengs la dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas rol chen 'bebs mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ stong gsum phyogs bcu sogs gdangs kyi skabs/ khro tshogs hūm̐ sgra nas thung zhing mthar/ sku gsung thugs nas ring du btang zhing mthar sum brdung dang 'bebs/ slob dpon rnams kyis bskor ba gsum gyi tshe sum brdung kho na byed mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /tshogs gung gseng*/ yar 'tshogs la brda' bsgo/ hūm̐/ thugs rje'i rang rtsal nas thun ltar gyis las byang gzhung bsrang*/ tshogs thengs yang sngar bzhin/ dzab bsnyen phreng skor gsum gyi mtshams/ cha gsum 'don bar btang*/ 'di skabs thun dang po'i dbu 'dzugs bum 'dzin bla ma dang*/ thun pa rnams kyis rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/

na mo/ bla ma sogs nas dbang 'dus bsam/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /yig bdun bsnyen zhing*/ dgongs thun skabs dregs pa tshar gcod kyang bton la bsnyen pa'i mthar phaṭa sbyar ba phreng skor tsam bton dgos/ tshogs mang gis bsnyen pa stong tsho lnga dang sngags ring nyer gcig /sngags sham 'don skabs nyer gcig bcas sngar ltar dgos shing*/ tshogs thengs/ stag lpags steng du tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la/ yar 'tshogs 'phral las rdor gyis phyag gsum bcas thal mo sbyar la/ ho dgongs su gsol lo sogs kyis snyan gsan dbab/ slob dpon 'dus pa bcas kyis/ e ma ho/ sogs nas mthar sil snyan 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ rdo rje lta bu sogs tshig dang bstun pa'i me/ rlung*/ chus bsang zhing gdangs kyi tshe sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ rdo rje lta bu sogs nang mchod bdud rtsi bran/ sngags mthar rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ chos sku skye med sogs/ gdangs kyi tshe 'di nas sna tshogs ri nas thung ngu btang*/ 'di skabs tshogs phud sman gtor drung du phul/ bdud rtsis bran/ mtha'i tshig gcig ring bar byed nas sum brdung dang 'bebs mthar bzhag /mchod dpon pas tshogs dang po zhu/ hrīḥgasang ba mchog gi mthar zhi rol gyis bzhag /tshogs bar pa zhu/ tshogs bar pa sman gtor drung du phul/ bdud rtsis bran/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs dang*/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ rigs kyi bdag po sogs gdangs kyi tshe/ khyad par dbang gi nas thung du btang*/ bka' srung gter srung nas ring du btang mthar sum brdung dang*/ spyan gyi dbang po sogs nas hrug 'don mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /thal mo sbyar la smre bshags/ thugs rje chen po nas rgyal ba'i lha bar las phur/ g.yab dar/ tshogs tha ma khrag rgod bran pa bcas slob dpon mdun du bzhag /hrīḥ bla ma yi dam nas sngags mthar zhi rol gyis bzhag /tshogs tha ma zhu/

sbub chol 'bebs bcas bdun brdung 'theng po thog mthar 'dzag gnyis can gyis zlog gdangs khug mas/ hrīḥ stong gsum 'jig rten sogs dang*/ mtha'i tshig gcig ring zhing*/ rol tshigs sngon ltar 'bebs kyis bzhag /oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita dang*/ dgug gzhug tshar gcig /mthar drag 'bebs bcas dgu brdung mthar 'dzag gnyis bcas/ hūm̐ nga ni rab 'jigs sogs/ phur skor bcas dril gsil dang*/ mthar mtshams rgyag zhabs sngags mthar 'bebs dang*/ phur pa gdab/ slar bdun brdung 'dzag med gnyis kyis/ hūm̐/ phyes shig sogs dang*/ tshogs tha ma sman gtor drung dang*/ bka' srung 'bul gtor gnyis la gso bran byas/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyi zhabs gtor ma gnyis/ a kā ros byin rlabs dang sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐/ sgrub pa lung gi sogs so sor gdangs gang 'os sngags rnams tshig rnga dang bcas mthar bskul mtshams/ bh+yoḥ 'og min sogs mthar bskul mtshams/ kyai/ dzaṃ gling nyi ma sogs sngags tshig rnga dang bcas/ hūm̐/ dam can skyes bu sogs sngags rnams tshig rnga bcas/ hūm̐ dam can sogs nas bskul mtshams/ hūm̐ yang cig bzhengs sogs mthar bskul mtshams/ kyai/ ya ki sogs sngags tshig rnga bcas dmar gtor phul zhing rol mo 'bebs mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ gling bzhi byang phyogs sogs bskul mtshams/ bh+yoḥ bsil ba tshal sogs nas sngags mthar dkar gtor phul zhing*/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /las rdor gyis/ kyai dpa' chen po sogs dang*/ slob dpon 'dus pa bcas pas/ a la la sogs tshogs la rol/ thal mo sbyar la/ hrīḥ bla ma yi dam sogs le tshan gnyis dang*/ de nas zhabs brtan 'don/ gral mdor stag lpags bting*/ de steng 'bru'i tshom bu bkod pa'i steng mang lhag bzhag /de steng rkang gsum khar gtsang lhag bshams pa'i khar sman gtor nas skyu gu gcig phab la der bkod/ bdud rtsis bran/ hrīḥ dbang chen sogs/ sngags mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/

hrīḥ dang po la sogs nas/ tha ma gcig tu zer skabs/ gtsang lhag nas cung zad mang lhag tu bsre/ yar yang cung zad du bsre/ de nas gtsang lhag mang lhag tu btab la/ las rdor gyis g.yas sgron thur gyis bdud rtsi dang g.yon lhag ma btegs la slob dpon drung du 'gro ba'i lhag ma kha chus zer skabs/ slob dpon gyis mkha' gsang rgyas bdud rtsi lhag mar blugs la sngar ltar phyir bzhag /gdangs kyi tshe sum brdung dang dgu brdung 'dzag bcas kyis/ dpal gyi bka' nyan sogs lhag gtor dkyil 'khor 'og byang shar du zangs snod du bsags la bzhag /rol mo dgu brdung 'dzag bcas kyis mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos gdangs gyi tshe/ 'gro 'dul nas bskul mtshams gdangs thung du btang mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /chad tho'i rgyun gtor la dgug gzhug rol mo drag 'bebs dang sum brdung dal ba bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon tshe sogs/ gdangs rnams skabs bstun rol mo de ltar dang*/ mthar 'bebs dang rol chen gang rung*/ gtor ma phul la bshal chu brtan ma'i gtor mar blug cing dgu brdung 'theng po 'dzag med bcas kyi mthar/ hrīḥ dgung sngon sogs mthar dgu brdung gong ltar 'bebs bcas gtor ma bshal chu phul/ rol mo bzhag /gtor snod sbub la rdo rjes mnan/ dgug gzhug la gtor gzhong ri rab sogs 'don pa bsgyur/ rol mo drag 'bebs mthar bzhag /hrīḥ thugs rje 'gro 'dul sogs/ gtor gzhong rnams kha gyen pas rnal 'byor sogs dang*/ mthar me tog 'thor/ thal sbyar dril gsil bcas/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya sbrel ma lan gsum/ hrīḥ bdag nyid sgyu ma sogs dang*/ bskul mtshams dang thal mo sbyar la bla ma dkyil 'khor sogs me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis/ dngos grub kun gyi sogs dril gsil bcas/ rjes kyi ser sbrengs ched 'di skabs tshogs par zhwa bkye mthar zhi rol bcas bzhag /rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor sogs dang*/

tshogs gung gseng skabs bstun bya'o// 'di skabs mchod dpon pa rnams kyis phyi khyams la nyul le'i liṅga ham khung du bcug pa dang*/ rdo thun dang*/ las phur bzhi/ phur gdan bcas khri'u lnga sogs bkod cing*/ ser sbrengs kyi chas rnams kyang bsgrig /kun thub bzhi/ ging gnyis/ ḍā ki gnyis bcas kyi 'chams chas bsgrig /rgyal thebs bzhis kyang phod ka zhwa nag gsol/ rdor dril g.yab dar bcas/ tshogs pa 'dus la zhwa bcas rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung kho nas ser sbrengs gshar la rdo ra 'khor ba dang rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /slob dpon rnams khri'u khar bzhugs/ liṅga chus bran/ e yaṃ dz+wa la sogs nas dgug gzhug rol mo drag brdung lan gsum rjes ma'i mthar 'bebs dal ran gyis 'chams pa rnams zim 'gros sum brdung kho nas rdo ra 'khor ba 'bebs kyi mthar bdun brgyad ma lan gsum dang sum brdung gcig dang lnga brdung gis/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings las sogs/ dbyangs kyi skabs dur khrod chen po nas sum brdung gcig dang lnga brdung gis/ shin tu mi bzad nas/ phrin las mdzod bar sum brdung gcig dang lnga brdung*/ hūm̐ nga ni pad+ma sogs/ dus la babs nas sum brdung gcig dang lnga brdung*/ g.yas kyi phyag na/ rdul du rlog sum brdung gcig lnga brdung bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā sogs hūm̐ phaṭa nas 'bebs dal ba'i tshe 'chams pa rnams kyis liṅga bsgral/ thun rdeg /de nas rgyal thabs rnams kyis phur pas lid+ga bsgral/ thun brdeg /de tshe 'chams pa rnams rdo ra 'khor ba dang bstun bdun brdung lan gsum dang*/ dgu brdung dal ba gcig dang*/ slar yang dgu brdung brel tsam re res 'chams bsdu/ mthar 'bebs dang dgu brdung 'theng po lan gnyis kyis/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs dkar po dbyangs dang lan phran can nas dgu brdung 'theng po gnyis/ spyan rtsa dmar zlum nas/ go skabs 'byed/ yang dgu brdung 'theng po gnyis bu yug thog 'bebs phyin zlog gdangs 'khyil ma bya/
dpal gyi pho nya'i skabs tshig rkang

mtshams rgyag / 'chams dpon pas 'dob mchong gcig bya/ sa ma yāḥ dgu brdung 'theng po gnyis mthar 'bebs kyi skabs 'chams pa rnams lam 'gros sum brdung gis rdo ra 'khor ba dang de rjes rgyal thebs rnams kyang 'byon la sgrub khang dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gcig /nyul le bskrad sngags 'don zhing rdo thun brabs/ phyir 'khor ba dang*/ rgyal thebs rnams rang gnas dang*/ 'chams pa rnams rdo ra 'khor bstun rol mo 'bebs dang bdun brdung lan gsum bzhi brdung dal ran bzhi/ dgu brdung dal ba gcig /slar yang bzhi brdung brel tsam bzhi dang*/ dgu brdung res 'chams bsdu thon nas 'bebs dang sum brdung gis ser sbrengs sgrub khang la 'byon/ 'bebs dal ran dang sum brdung gis byin 'bebs bton/ mthar slob dpon rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum/ mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /chas rnams bsdu/ tshogs grol/ yar 'tshogs chos skyong skong gsol bton la grol/ dgong mor rgya gling dang rag dung sum bsgrigs/ 'di skabs mtshan thun dang po bya/ nam gung thun gnyis pa/ tho rangs thun gsum pa bcas/ skya rengs shar skabs dung gling sum bsgrigs btang*/ ri rtser nyi shar la 'tshogs/ nyin thun dang po/ de bzhin tshogs thengs re dang thun bar bcas la thun pa rnams brje dgos/ grol nyin mtshan thun gnyis pa'i phyed tsam zin dus 'tshogs la/ nyin ltar gyi las byang bton zhing bsnyen pa'i mthar tshogs dang bka' srung bton mthar rol mo bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor shar du stegs bu'i khar dngos grub kyi rdzas 'brang rgyas la dkar gsum mngar gsum zas snas bskor ba mched lcam grangs mnyam la dar mthing nag dang dmar po bkab/ mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zan ril dang*/ bse phor du bur chang*/ gzhan yang zas sna bcas bshams la/ sum+bha ni gsum gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul bdug /yungs kar brab/ rdzas kyi steng gzungs thag bzhag la slob dpon gyis 'dzin/

bdag nyid yi dam sogs nas thim par gyur bar/ thams cad kyis lag g.yon mtheb srin sbyar/ gung mdzub gnyis bsgreng la rta mgo'i tshul dang*/ g.yos phreng ba 'dren la yig bdun dang*/ kā ya sid+dhi sogs nyer gcig gi mtshams/ slob dpon bzhengs la/ hūm̐/ bder gshegs ma lus sogs/ slob dpon rang gi spyi bor lha sku bzhag la dbang len/ sngags bsgrigs 'don gyis tshogs la'ang 'grim/ de ltar 'don pa'i go rim ltar bar gyi sngags rnams bton la/ sngags byang mgrin par/ shel rdo me long snying khar/ rgya gram lte ba bcas la bzhag par bya'o// de 'phral tshogs drangs shing zhabs brtan sogs bton la/ slob dpon gyis las bum bskyed bzlas gnang*/ tshogs grol/ skabs 'dir slob mar smin byed dbang bskur bya ste/ slob ma rnams 'tshogs zin nas/ dang po slob dpon 'dus pa bcas kyis/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita sogs sngon 'gro gzhung ltar/ nyon cig ma sogs bgegs bskrad mthar gu gul spos skor dang*/ mtshams gcod bcas rnga rol nyin ltar bya/ khrus chab btang*/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu/ slob dpon gyis dbang bshad gsungs mtshams maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab rjes gnang rnams dang dam chu bcas/ slob dpon dbang 'grim skabs rgya gling btang*/ byin 'bebs skabs spos 'grim rol chen bcas/ rnam dag spros bral dbyangs dang mthar rol mo 'bebs bcas bzhag /gtor dbang rnams so sor bskur mthar/ ril bu bum chen gyis dbang bskur/ de tshe sngags ring dpon slob rnams kyis mnyam 'don bya/ rgyal thebs zhig gis ril bu gsum re gnang zhing*/ las rdor gyis rnam rgyal bum chu bkye/ de tshe spro na ril bu'i phan yon bshad/ de nas thod pa'i dbang yang bskur zhing*/ dmangs la las rdor gyis bdud rtsi bkye/ shel rdo me long sngags byang sgro mdongs dbang dang*/ rig pa'i rtsal dbang*/ slar yang gtor dbang bcas bskur mthar sngags ring mnyam 'don bya/

bzlas lung dang dam tshig khas len/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs mthar/ tshogs pa rnams thal mo sbyar la/ hūm̐/ byams mgon thugs rje sogs rgyun gdangs dang*/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang sogs bde spyod kyis bkab la/ rin chen gter gyi nas bskul mtshams thung du btang bas 'di skabs/ dngos grub rdzas rdor rgyal 'dus pa bcas la drangs zhing*/ slob ma'i gtso bo rnams dang*/ dmangs bcas la'ang*/ dngos grub rdzas dang tshogs rdzas kyang bkye ba dang bstun rgyun gdangs kyis/ dgongs shig thugs rje sogs tshar gsum mam lnga bdun bskyar zhing 'don mthar sngags dang bcas zhi rol ldir/ slob ma grol/ tshogs thengs bya/ yar 'tshogs la ging pa gnyis chas spras nas dkyil 'khor rgyab ngos su 'dug la/ sngon dkyil 'khor 'og tu bsags pa'i lhag ma gral mdor bshams la/ lhag gtor btang mthar rol mo 'bebs ring tsam dang bshug pa bcas/ de tshe ging pas gar dang bcas phyi rol rgyang ring por lhag ma bskyal/ de nas bskul dang dgug gzhug chad tho brtan skyong gtor bro mthar tshogs grol/ yar 'tshogs la/ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra sogs sngags rnams nyer gcig re bzlas la/ de tshe slob ma rnams gral 'khod grub pa dang*/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po sogs gdangs dang 'don bya bstun pa'i bskul mtshams bya/ slob dpon gyis mda' dar g.yab/ dril gsil dang bcas/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe nyer gcig dang*/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas sogs sngar ltar/ oṃ tra tra shag 'don tshe mda' dar spyi bor 'grim la/ hūm̐ stong nyid brtan par sogs/ sngags dang bstun pa'i/ tshe gtor spyi bor/ dpral bar/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag par/ rna ltag g.yon bcas la bzhag cing 'grim/ rgyal thebs kyis tshe chang drangs/ las rdor gyis tshe ril bkye/ gral la 'khod nas/ hūm̐ de ltar tshe bskul sogs mda' dar g.yab/ sku yi sku sogs me tog 'thor zhing mthar zhi rol bya/

sbyin pa btang zhing sogs/ slob ma grol/ de nas rjes chog /hrīḥ chos sku skye med sogs dang*/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya sbrel ba tshar gsum/ ye shes lha tshogs gnas 'dir sogs mthar rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya dang*/ hrīḥ bdag nyid sgyu ma sogs/ tshogs grol/ de nas rgyal tho bsdu chas zlum gtor dang*/ mchod pa sogs las rdor gnyis kyis res mos byed la rol mo dang bcas ser sbrengs gshar mthar rol mo bzhag /ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang 'bru gsum lan gsum/ sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐ rgyal po chen po sogs gdangs dang mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /gtor sngags tshar gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ mthar dril gsil/ sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ shar phyogs rgyal po sogs/ sum brdung zhabs badz+raḥmuḥbarjod/ mchod gtor bsdu/ tho len/ de nas 'bebs bcas ser sbrengs rol mo len pa sogs sngar ltar 'gre'o// de nas sgo byang phyi nang bsdu ba la rol mo sngar ltar/ 'bru gsum mthar gtor sngags tshar gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs mthar dril gsil sum brdung gis/ bgegs kyi gnyen po sogs badz+ra muḥ rol zhabs bton/ sgo byang len/ mchod gtor bsdu ba bcas rol mo sngar ltar/ nang gi sgo byang bsdus mthar rol mo bzhag /tshogs pa gral la 'khod/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor nub tu gnas pas/ skam pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la sogs 'og gi phur pa len/ ru ru s+phu ru'i skabs las rdor gyis 'o ma rnga yab kyis phur pa'i dbal las 'thor ba dang phur gdan la 'thor ba bcas bya/ de nas byang shar/ nub byang*/ lho nub/ shar lho/ byang*/ nub/ lho/ shar/ steng bcas kyi phur pa gong ltar len mthar/ zhi rol bcas/ a kā ro tshar gsum/ de tshe slob dpon dkyil 'khor la g.yas bskor bcas dkyil thang*/ mthar rol mo bzhag /de nas slob dpon khrir bzhugs/ slob ma'i tshogs pa rnams kyi lus longs spyod phul ba'i dod bgrang phreng rnams mdun du spungs la/

phyag gsum 'tshal/ slob dpon la bdud rtsi drangs/ thal mo sbyar la rgyun gdangs kyis/ hoḥ bdag cag rdo rje mched dang sogs mthar tshogs grol/ de nas slob ma rnams dang tshogs pa bcas kyis g.yas mar me re dang*/ g.yon spos kyi ring bu re thogs te dkyil 'khor mtha' skor la phreng ba lu gu rgyud du byas te mar me smon lam zhi khro ltar dbyangs ring thung gang bdes/ ho bla med gsang ba sogs gyer/ mthar yig bdun bzla bzhin/ dang po slob ma rnams g.yas skor lan gsum byed bcug la grol/ de nas slob dpon 'dus pa bcas kyis kyang bskor ba gsum gral la 'khod/ lus srung ba/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs brjod/ las byang gi smon lam/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha sogs dang*/ me tog 'thor la bkra shis mthar zhi rol/ rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du sogs dang*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs nas/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs/ bden grub ma bton mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sogs/ bkra shis dpal 'bar sogs/ tshogs grol/ 'di mtshams bar dbang spro na gnas gang bder stegs kyi khar khebs dang maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa/ de steng mañdza'i khar dbang gtor/ g.yas gtso bum/ g.yon las bum/ bhan+dha bdud rtsi ril bus bkang pa dar thum can dang*/ shel rdo me long rma bya'i mdongs dang sngags byang rnams bkod/ dung chos nang dam chu dang*/ mdun ngos su sman gtor rak+ta/ mchod pa phreng tshar bcas bshams zin pa dang*/ seng sbrengs dang bcas 'byon nas/ slob dpon rnams gral la 'khod/ dang po tshig bdun ma dang*/ de nas rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ las byang bsdus pa'i/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang sogs la/ spros med chos gdangs 'geb dang*/ 'di mtshams dge slong bzhi sdes ma ṇi dge bskul btang*/ sems bskyed do// bar lan gsum mtshams rgyag bcas/ hūm̐ nyon cig sogs nas/ mdzod mthar sum brdung dang 'bebs/ yang sum brdung gis/

tshe sgrub gzhung gdangs kyis/ rang rig sogs nas bshags pa mtshams rgyag bcas/ hūm̐ spros med sogs nas/ 'ja' ltar gsal mthar/ sum brdung dang 'bebs chen/ yang sum brdung gis/ dal bus hrīḥ gdangs kyis/ hūm̐/ rnam dag bde chen sogs nas/ phyag bgyi'o// mthar sum brdung gis/ tshig rnga mtshams rgyag dang bcas/ te te nas pū dzaḥ ho/ mthar/ 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hrīḥ bder gshegs sogs 'bebs mthar gyis bzhag /yig bdun stong rtsa gcig bsnyen ba'i tshe/ sngon gyi las bum chu 'dres pa'i chu bum mang tsam thogs nas gral phyi nang thams cad la khrus chab btang*/ yun mi 'gor bar byed/ zur du chu snod che tsam gnyis bzhag la kha gsab dgos na byed/ de nas sngags sham rnams sbrel mar bzla'o// slar las bum bskyed bzlas nyer gcig bya/ de nas sngon 'gro sogs nang dbang ji bzhin la/ gong 'og gi spos 'grim gral nang skor tsam gyis 'thus/ khrus chab kyang gral nang skor tsam la btang*/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu tsam bya/ byin 'bebs dbyangs dang*/ ril bu'i phan yon bzhag kyang chog /dbang rdzas rnams rgyang nas bstan pa tsam gyis khyab/ ril bu'i bum dbang tshab rnam rgyal bum pa 'dzin pas chog /gtor dbang sngags mtha'i sid+dhi hūm̐ bar/ de nas bzhengs la/ khrom gral gyi g.yas g.yon la rgya gling pa cha gnyis sdod nas res mos kyis btang*/ rnga rol mi dgos/ gzhan yo byad thams cad kyi ser sbrengs dang ldan pas mdun bdar la/ bum pa do li'i khar btegs pa'i phyogs mtshams su rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'phan dang*/ steng du gdugs 'khor ba/ logs su dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis bklubs pa mi bzhis drangs pa'i/ bum mgul la dar sna lnga btags pa de slob dpon gyis rdo dril dang bcas 'dzin pa'i mdun du/ spos sna ba/ rgyab tu dbu gdugs pa/ rgyal thebs bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang srung zlog bca' sgrub bla ma rnams kyis kyang dbang rdzas re re 'dzin cing*/

bum chu'ang bkye ba'i kha gsab chu snod yang 'ga' re thogs la/ ston 'khor thams cad kyis sngags ring sgrig 'don bcas dbang 'grim la 'byon/ ril bu bkye/ de nas yar 'khor ba dang*/ cung zhig ngal gsos la/ bzlas lung phyin gyi rjes rnams grub nas/ dmigs med kyi ngang du bzhag par bya'o// de nas ser sbrengs bcas sgrub khang la 'byon/ skabs dang bstun pa'i 'di mtshams khrom chen la dbang bskur gyi bshams bkod dang*/ ser sbrengs sogs bar dbang ci bzhin pa'i dbang sgrub dang dge bskul bya/ gral nang ma gang che gras nye skor rnams la maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu tsam re byas/ de nas dbang gi sngon 'gro sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ las rdor gyis me long la khrom tshogs 'char bar byas la/ mchod g.yog pas khrus snod bzed la/ las bum gyis khrus gsol bya/ dbang gzhung rdzogs mtshams ser sbrengs bcas dbang 'grim pa yang bar dbang bzhin la bum pa mgor 'jog /bum chu bkye mi dgos/ ril bu 'gyed la/ dbang gi rjes rim rnams bcas grub nas/ slar yang ser sbrengs dang bcas sgrub khang la 'byon bar bya'o// smras pa/ de ltar rgyal rnams thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'phrul// mdzad pa rmad byung rnam mang phrin las kyi/ sgo 'phar yangs por phye ba'i gsang sngags chos// nye lam mthar thug 'brel tshad don ldan phyir// myong grol sgrub chen thugs gsang gzhung phyag len// gtsor bton gsung rgyun slar yang go bde zhing*// gsal bar bkral 'di bstan 'gror phan bde'i ched// pad+ma nyin byed dbang gis spel ba dge// sarba thā mad+ga lam/ sngar gsung 'di nyid la gzhir byas nas phyis dgon 'dir bum sgrub gsar 'dzugs skabs 'jam mgon rin po ches zhib rgyas su bris mdzad pa zur du yod pa deng sang lag len tu bstar bzhin pa'o/// / ༈ sgrub chen grol khar dus 'das 'brel thogs rnams thugs sgrub sgo nas stabs bde'i ched gnas 'dren zhig byed srol la/

de'ang las byang gzhung bsrang tshogs mang dang mnyam sngon du bton zin par byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho'i phyogs sam/ yang na gang bder rdor rgyal lam rgyal thebs zhig gis gtsos ba'i bzhi sde tsam gyis thog mar stegs kyi dbus/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu 'dab brgyad bkod steng mañdzi'i khar/ rnam rgyal bum pa dung chos dang gzungs rdor ldan pa/ gang bder las bum/ mthar nyer spyod mchod pa dang sngon gnyis kyang bshams/ gzhan yang gnas 'dren 'don cha la gsal pa'i tsakli rnams dang gtor ma la sogs dgos chas rigs gang yod chad lhag med par 'du byas la/ slad kyi dus byang phyag 'tshal mkhan zhig la'ang brda' btang dgos/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed btang*/ mtshams gcod sogs las byang ltar la rnga rol yang nyin ltar bzhin bya/ rang nyid rdor sems bskyed la/ las bum sngags a mṛ ta nyer gcig /na mo/ dkon mchog sogs mthar zhi rol bcas gtor ma phul/ rnam rgyal bum par lhar bskyed kyi dmigs pa gzhung gsal bzhin rtse gcig pas/ yig brgya nyer gcig yang snying brgya brgyad bzla'o// slob dpon mdun gnas 'dren chas rnams bshams bkod byas la/ byang bu'ang bzhag /'gugs pa'i rgyas/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog mthu sogs nas/ a la la bar lan gsum zhi khro'i gzhung gdangs ring thung gang bdes 'di'i rigs rnams la bkab dgos/ mtshams su dril gsil yang gong 'og kun la 'gre'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis glud gtor byin brlabs la/ rnga sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ nga ni dbang chen sogs/ badz+ra kro dha dang*/ sum+bha ni gsum/ rol mo 'bebs mthar bzhag /yungs kar brab/ gu gul bdug /de nas 'don bya dang*/ lag len/ dmigs pa rnams gzhung ji lta bar ma 'khrul bar phyag len ldan pas/ hūm̐ nga ni bla ma sogs kyis gnas nas drang zhing*/ tshig so so dang mtshungs pa'i byang phyag kyang phul bcug pa sogs rigs 'gre zhing*/ mthar byang bu dbang stegs khar bzhag la/ dmigs pa spro bsdu dang bcas/

yig brgya nyer gcig dang*/ yang snying brgya brgyad/ kam̐ ka ni nyer gcig bzla'o// 'dod yon rnams dang*/ sngar nyin tshogs skal zhig bzhag dgos pa'ang 'dir bsham/ stabs bde'i 'gal med tsam du las sngags kyis bsang*/ a kā ros lan gsum byin brlabs la/ kha dog ma bton mthar/ 'dod yon nam mkha' dang*/ kha zas bstab pa sogs brjod/ hūm̐ bum pa bzang sogs/ rnam rgyal bum dbang yang bskur/ de nas sgrub khang la 'gro zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo'i phyogs nas byang phyag gsum 'tshal bcug /'di skabs las byang gi sgo dbye 'don/ dar ram ras dkar gyi lam sne gzhi steng brkyang ba der byang bu bzhag /hūm̐/ nyon cig sogs lam bstan rnams dang*/ ho/ lha dang bla ma sogs bsngo ba dang*/ hūm̐/ dug gsum rnam dag sogs/ rdor rgyal lam rgyal thebs kyis ming byang bsreg /nyams len lta ba'i ngang du bzhag /mthar/ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo smon gang 'os bya/ byang thal sāts+tsha gdab par bya'o// de nas tshogs chen dang skabs bstun pa'i/ tshogs dang bka' srung sogs da nang gi 'don bya'i 'phros rnams la 'jug par bya'o// 'gal 'khrul mchis na sku gsum klong du bshags// dge bas 'gro rnams sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /shu bham/// / ༈ pad+ma badz+ra gyi sgo nas skye bdun ril bu bsgrub pa'i zin bris bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ pad+ma badz+ra grub thob rgya mtsho'i sgo nas myang grol ril bu bsgrub pa'i skabs thog mar sgrub chen gzhan dang khog mtshungs kyi/ sāts+tsha btab pa/ chu gtor brgya rtsa dang*/ rgyal po mdo bcu bklag par gsungs pas/ shes rab snying po gcig /'da' ka ye shes gnyis/ bzang po spyod pa gsum/ rdo rje rnam 'joms bzhi/ byang chub ltung bshags lnga/ gtsug gtor dkar mo drug /gos sngon can gyi mdo bdun/ tshe mdo brgyad/ nor rgyun ma dgu/ yi ge gcig ma bcu sogs bton/ bsang brngan rgyas pa/

sde brgyad cha snyoms/ glud 'byung bzhi cha gsum/ sprang po la sbyin pa/ tshe thar srog bslu/ byis pa la ston mo sogs mdor na dkar po dge ba'i las spyod cing*/ de nas dang po dkyil khor bdun brtsegs kyi bshams bkod gzhung nas gsungs pa ltar mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len zin bris rgyas pa ci lta ba las/ dmigs bsal snga nas tshags su tshud par dgos rgyu'i dam rdzas khyad 'phags kar rnying gi byin rlabs rten sel med/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung skye bdun dam rdzas sogs myong bas grol ba'i rigs rnams gang dag gtso bor gyur ba gzhir byas la/ cu gang*/ gi'u waṃ/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ru ra/ li shi/ dza ti/ sman sna/ gur gum/ da li sogs sman gyi rigs dang*/ rgya sran/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ yungs dkar nag /la phug gi sa bon/ til dkar nag /so ba/ rgun 'bru/ se 'bru sogs 'bru sna tshogs/ gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags/ mu men/ baiḍūr+ya/ bye ru/ g.yu/ rdo rje pha lam/ mu tig /sbur len sogs rin po che sna tshogs/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ni rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi chos sman tshad ldan nang 'thus shing*/ ga bur dang*/ rgya tshwa/ cong zhi dkar dmar sogs rdzas rnams zhib par btul la dar tshags la drangs te phye mar gro zan dang 'bras zan gang rung gis sbrus te ril bur dril la/ lhung bzed dam dkar yol gyi nang du ril chags mthong rgyun bzhin byas la mtshal dang shel kar bsres la rtsi btang ba bum pa'i nang du blugs/ kha rgyan dang sna tshogs dar gyi mgul chings gzungs rdor dang bcas bkod/ de'i steng du thod pa mtshan ldan kyang ril bus bkang ba dang*/ gsung dkyil sogs bshams bkod sngon du 'gro bas/ gnyis pa las byang gi gzhung bsrang thig gdab nas brtsams bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed kyi bsnyen pa bcas dang*/ de nas thun grangs ka gang byed pa'i bum bskyed kho nar 'don la/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag 'dzin bzhin/
