bsnyen pa rnams skabs bstun gyis bsags la mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya bcas tshar gsum re dang*/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs mchod bstod bshags pa rnying ma spyi'i lugs 'di skabs thun re bcad pa'i mthar bton dgos shing*/ thun snga ma'i bdag bskyed bsnyen pa'i skabs sngags rgyun pa rnams sdod nas tshogs thengs re re'am gnyis re la brje len sogs ci bder nyin mtshan la rgyun mi chad par gal che'o// de'ang bdag bskyed bsnyen pa ma zin gyi bar du thun pa rnams kyis tshigs bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ bsam pa lhun 'grub gang tshar bton/ thun bzung dus/ dang po skyabs 'gro/ dkon mchog gsum dang pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: lan gsum/ bdag bskyed dang*/ bum pa'i ril bu la yang chabs cig dmigs te pad+ma badz+ra sbas gsang gi sgom bzlas nyung bsdus/ a haṃ āḥ swa bhā wa ho: snang srid rab 'byams khyab pa'i ban+dha'i dbus: :pad+ma nyi zla sogs/ oṃ pad+ma badz+ra hūm̐: zhes 'bru drug kho nas thun rgyun ring bzung bya/ thun brje mtshams su/ gsar sdod/ thun rjes mas bsnyen pa len dus thun pa sngon ma rnams kyis dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya tshar gsum re'i mthar/ ye shes lha tshogs kyi bshags pa bya'o// de lta bu'i sgrub pa zhag bdun sogs ci rigs par zhag grangs tshang nyin der gsung dkyil gyi bsnyen ba'i mthar sngags rgyun thun pa rnams kyis phyag gsum bcas dkyil 'khor drung du 'greng ste thal mo sbyar ba'i bar spos kyi reng bu 'dzin bzhin dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya sogs gsum/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs brjod nas grol chog /de nas skong bshags sogs tshar mtshams/ bla ma rig 'dzin sogs brjod bzhin slob dpon dang tshogs pas/ dngos grub kyi dbang len/ de'i skabs bum pa/ pusta ka /tsakli rnams dang*/ ril bu yang dngos grub kyi tshul du zhu/ 'di mtshams khrom dbang sogs dgos na'ang mthong rgyun bzhin/

sgo dbye sngon gtor btang nas/ snying thig dbang mo che gzhung ltar la/ bum dbang skabs ril bu'i bum pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ ril bu'ang de skabs bkye dgos shing*/ de phyin gzhung ltar mtha' rgyas bya bas 'grub pa'o// dge bskul phan yon thob nges can yang nges par byed bcug go /de nas bka' srung gtor 'bul rnams dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyod/ lhag ma btang ba dang*/ sku gsum bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: sogs dang*/ rten dang gtor ma'i sogs/ rjes rim rnams dang*/ gzhung gi 'gros dang*/ bden grub ma'ang brjod par bya'o// yang 'di skabs gnas 'dren spro na sgrub pa zhag lnga'am drug tsam gyi dus skabs babs gang bder 'don lugs zin bris rgyas pa'i nang gsal ba des khyab/ de'ang bzhi sde tsam gyis 'don pa'am tshogs chen gyis gsung pa ci bder bya/ de nas gsum pa sgrub chen gegs sel gzhan dang khog mtshungs dgos bzhin/ 'dir ni 'di nyid kyi cha lag lnga po yang 'don dgos shing*/ rang dang gzhan gyi don du yang 'don par spro na zin bris rgyas pa'i nang gsal pad+ma badz+ra dkyil 'khor 'bring po'i 'don lugs bdag mdun gnyis kyi gzhung bsrang bsnyen pa tshar nas/ gur drag /seng gdong ma/ rta mgrin/ dzaṃ nag /ma ning bcas kyi las byang rnams bsnyen pa'i bar du 'don/ de nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye nas rnam dag sogs nas lhag ma bkra shis bar brjod/ so so'i sgrub gtor ni las byang la gsal ba de ltar dang*/ 'bul gtor rnams dmar gtor bzhi re dang*/ gser skyems/ dzaṃ nag la dkar gtor bcas de rnams bstod pa'i mthar phul/ dzaṃ nag 'bul gtor gzhi mdun phul dgos/ grol nyin gur drag dang ma ning gnyis kyi mtha'i bskul/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ ma hā ka la sogs 'don nas rten gtor phul/ gzhan rnams kyi sgrub gtor rnams phul srol med/ ces pa'ang*/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos/

'jang drung ba sprul sku karma bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi bzhed ngor ched du spel ba dge'o// de ltar sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad 'byung gi /bka' gsang dri med yang snying 'dus pa'i bcud// gang de'i sgo nas 'gro rnams byang chub lam// bkod phyir bum pa'i sgrub chen myong grol gyi// mthong thos dran reg smin cing grol byed 'di// gzhan phan 'brel tshad don ldan sar bkod pa// 'di ka gzhung dang mthun par bsdebs pa las// rgyal bka' bslad pa'i gzu lum ras chod kyis// nam yang ma gos dge 'dis 'gro ba'i don// rlabs chen phrin las rgyas pa'i dpyid 'gyur zhing*// nges don bstan pa mtha' rgyas yun tu gnas// rnam kun dge legs snang bas khyab gyur cig /ces dpal spungs chos 'khor gyi sgrub grwa'i yang dben nas spel ba yi ge pa ni phun tshogs sprul sku'o// dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba mad+ga lam/// / ༈ zab chos rdo rje gro lod kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi tshul dmigs rim gsung rgyun bsgrigs chags nor bu 'od ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo pad+ma ka ra ye/ chos dbyings 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i klong*// rtsal snang ma 'gags cha las he ru ka /'bar ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod// rang rig dbyer med ngo bo phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces ched du brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ 'dir o rgyan rdo rje'i bka' las byung ba'i zab chos bla ma drag po'i skor gyi dmigs rim gsung rgyun bsgrigs chags go bde zin thor bkod pa la rtsa gsum lha yis bkas gnang ba thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol*/ de la dang po bca' bshams 'don sgrig gi rim pa zin bris zur gsal ltar la/ bsnyen sgrub/ zlog pa/ mdos chen rnams kyi bca' 'don dang*/ dmigs pa'i 'phrul bcas so so'i dbye ba nges par byas la/ de yang bdag mdun thams cad las byang dang mthun pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba dang*/

bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing dam tshig la gnas pa/ rang lus yi dam du gsal bas snang srid thams cad lhar shes pa dang*/ chos skyong grogs su brten cing bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba dang*/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i sgrub pa brtson 'grus thang lhod med par/ lta sgom spyod pa la gnas na mchog thun dngos grub thob par nges so// de'ang 'don pa dal brel ran pa/ gdangs dbyangs gsung rgyun dang ldan pa/ rol cha sogs kyang skad thon pa khungs dang 'brel bar/ dal brel ran pa byin chags par byas la/ thog mar rang nyid pad+ma badz+rar gsal bas/ sngon gtor byin rlabs/ gnas bdag la gtor ma/ gser skyems dang*/ bgegs la glud gtor bsngo/ hūm̐/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i sogs rtsa gsum bden pa'i byin rlabs mthu stobs kyis gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i cha las byung ba'i gnod byed gdon bgegs rnams bskrad/ stong nyid lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa'i ngang nas mtshams bcad pa dang*/ rang nyid lha yi sku gsum las khro bo dang khro mo/ thig le thig phran/ rdo rje me ri'i gur khang dang bcas snang srid lhar gsal gyi srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma sku gsum lha tshogs gsal ba'i drung du skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ sems bskyed yan lag bdun 'bul mthar/ skyabs yul rnams rang la bstim zhing*/ sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag nas/ rang rig gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngo bor bskyang bar bya'o// de nas byin 'bebs pa'i skabs su rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin gtibs pa ltar byon nas snod bcud thams cad ye shes lha yi dkyil 'khor du bsgyur nas gsang gsum rdo rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub rnams rang la thim nas dbyer med du gyur pa dang*/ sman raka gtor gsum gyis mtshon pa'i mchod rdzas rnams zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab/

de nas phyi sgrub kun bzang gi las byang bton la/ snang srid thams cad lha'i rol par gsal ba'i ngang nas/ bdag bskyed stong ra kun bzang yab yum kyi rtsa 'khor gnas lha rnams gsal btab/ ye shes spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med la mchod bstod bya/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ dbu ma'i nang snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta'i sngags phreng mthing ka g.yas bskor gyis 'od zer spro bsdus rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dngos grub thob par mos la khyer sog sum ldan gyi ngang nas dang po spyan 'dren sngags dang*/ de nas rgyun bsnyen bcas bzla'o// de nas rigs lnga so sor gnas 'gyur gyi bsgom pa'i sa bon sngags 'khor bskyed bzlas rnams bya'o// de nas nang sgrub bla ma'i las byang gzhi rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ yang dag don sogs ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum dang*/ lam bskyed rim la/ mkha' dbyings ye shes klong yangs sogs bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba la/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kar sa bon sngags 'khor dang bcas/ sku gsum bla ma mtho brtsegs dang*/ 'khor du mkha' 'gro sde lnga bskyed pa'i bdag mdun thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dzaḥyig lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dang*/ khyad par dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas sku gsum bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar bkra gsal lam me byon par dmigs la/ spyan 'dren sngon bskal ma lan gsum dang*/ gdan 'bul/ phyag 'tshal/ phyi nang gsang mchod/ skong bshags/ bstod pa bcas de nas lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'bru gsum 'phros/ bdag mdun dam tshig par thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sku bzhi mngon du gyur nas lha tshogs rnams kyang dbyer med chu la chu bzhag pa ltar mos la/ bdag mdun thugs kar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng mthing ka g.yas su 'khor ba'i rang sgra'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam/

dpa' po/ mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong rnams mchod cing dgyes/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar dmigs nas/ dang po spyan 'dren gyi sngags bzlas la/ sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo sku dang*/ yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan rnams char babs pa bzhin rang la thim pas gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs thob par bsgom/ de nas rgyun bsnyen bzlas la/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyi snod lha'i gzhal yas/ nang bcud 'gro ba rigs drug /gzugs can gzugs med dregs pa lha srin rnams kyang lha yi rol par bsgyur nas sngags kyi sgra gdangs kyis 'jig rten thams cad shig shig yom yom g.yo zhing*/ de rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gdug sems zhi/ mthu stobs gzi brjid/ tshe bsod/ dpal 'byor snyan grags dbang thang rnams mtsho la char babs pa ltar rang la thim par mos la sngags bzla'o// de nas shog phran tshe sgrub rang nyid pad 'byung yum can gsal ba'i dran rdzogs kyi 'od zer spro bsdu dang bsnyen dmigs rnams gzhung gsal ltar sngags bzla/ mthar dmigs gtad mtshan bral blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang du bzhag nas la bzla'o// gsang sgrub ni/ rang nyid bla ma drag por bskyed pa dang*/ mdun bskyed zhi ba'i g.yas su gu ru drag po bdag mdun mnyam rdzogs su gsal gdab pa'i 'khor du sde brgyad kyis bskor ba bskyed la gtso bo'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/ khyad par thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis bskul ba'i zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs spyan drangs/ dam ye dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang nas mchod bstod sogs bya/ bdag mdun thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar artsig mthing ka g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis rtsa gsum lha tshogs ye shes kyi khro rgyal rnams mchod cing dgyes pa bskyed/ 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong bar mos la/ dang po spyan 'dren sngags shrīḥhe ru sogs bzla bzhin/

drag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa sku dang*/ yig 'bru/ phyag mtshan rnams rang la thim pas stobs bcu'i nus rtsal thob par dmigs/ yang sngags phreng gi rang sgra dang 'od zer las bskal pa'i me yi tsha tsha 'phros/ snang srid thams cad drag po'i skur bsgyur nas/ gzugs can gzugs med kyi dgra bgegs thams cad me yis bsreg cing la la brgyal/ la la'i snying bton pa sogs nyam thag pa'i ngang nas dbang med du bka' dang dam la gnas par mos la rgyun bsnyen artsig bzla/ de nas phrin las bzhi sgrub dmigs pa snga dror lha dang sngags phreng dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus rang dang dmigs bya'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi nas 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par bsgom pa dang*/ nyin gung lha sngags ser po'i spro bsdus tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par dmigs/ dgong kar lha sngags dmar po'i 'phro 'dus snang srid dbang du sdud par mos/ srod la lha sngags mthing nag gi tsha zer gyis gnod byed byad phur thams cad bsreg cing thal bar brlag par bsam la sngags bzla'o// de nas sngags sham 'dogs skabs/ drag sngags sgra 'od rngam zer gyi spro bsdus sde brgyad rnams la phog pas dam tshig rjes su dran pas srog gi snying po phul/ bka' nyan bran du 'khol nas phrin las ched du bsgrub par dmigs la sngags sham bzla'o// de nas dgongs gsol dang bcas drag po'i lha tshogs thugs dam gnad bskul gyis phrin bcol ched du gtor ma 'bul/ yang 'khor rnams bskul la gtor ma gser skyems dgra phyogs su 'bul/ phyi nang gsang gsum bzlog pa'i mthar yang dmar gtor 'bul la/ dar nag lan dgur brdeg /'byung lnga steng 'og bsgyur bas dgra bo thal bar brlag par dmigs la stong nyid kyi ngang du bzhag /de nas mkha' 'gro'i bskyed rim stong pa'i rang mdangs kyi rtsal de nyid las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gur khyim dbus su/ bdag bskyed gnas 'gyur gyi mtsho rgyal ma dang*/

mdun bskyed bla ma'i g.yon du mkha' 'gro bskyed pa'i gnas lha rnams dang bcas gsal btab pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i sa bon 'od kyis bskul ba'i rang 'dra ye shes pa rnams o rgyan mkha' spyod gnas nas spyan drangs bdag mdun la thim par dmigs la/ de nas phyi rim 'khor tshogs rnams kyang bskyed la thugs srog gi 'od zer 'phro 'dus dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams spyan 'dren bskyed rim dang*/ gdan 'bul/ mchod bskang*/ bshags pa/ bstod pa bcas/ bsnyen dmigs gzhung ltar gnas lha sngags lha lnga'i byin rlabs thugs rgyud rim bzhin bskul nas/ snying kha'i gu ru'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthar mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen sngags g.yon bskor du dmigs la/ 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs snod bcud dag pa gsum ldan ngang nas sngags bzla'o// mthar sngags phreng rang sgra dang bcas gnas lha rnams bsdu rim gzhung ltar mthar mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag la/ zung 'jug gi lha skur ldang nas tshogs las bam bsgral gyi tha tshig brjod cing*/ srung ma rnams la bka' bsgo/ dgug gzhug lan gsum/ rang lha'i nga rgyal ldan bzhin bam bsgral nas/ skye med kyi ngang du bstim pa sogs bya/ zhal bstab cha lnga dang*/ gtsang lhag bcas drug bshams la rim par bstabs/ rnal 'byor pa rnams gsal ba gsum ldan gyis tshogs la rol/ spyang zhon mar lhag gtor btang la gtsang gnas su bskyal/ phrin bcol drag tu bya'o// de nas yang gsang las mgon bsgrub pa la rang nyid gsang bdag gsal ba'i spyi bor pad 'byung bskyed la/ rang gi thugs kar sngags phreng dmigs pa gzhung ltar bzlas pa dang*/ bsdu rim zung 'jug skur ldang ba'i/ mdun bskyed bla ma'i drung du las gzhung ltar bdud mgon trak+shad la yum bzhi/ bdud po brgyad/ ru 'dren bdun sogs 'khor dang yang 'khor mang pos bskor ba bskyed la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs dang*/

mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/ khyad par thugs ka'i hūm̐ ha khog nang du duḥyig /de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ rang rang gi gnas yul rnams nas mgon po 'khor bcas spyan drangs te dam ye gnyis med gyur pa la phyag 'tshal/ gdan 'bul dang*/ dam bzhag skabs dmigs pa gzhung ltar gyis khyab cing mchod bstod dang bcas/ mgon po'i thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ ha khog nang duḥyig /de'i mthar rtsa sngags dang spyi dril sngags bcas de rnams mthing nag 'od kyi gzi mdangs ldan pa g.yas su 'khor zhing*/ yum bzhi'i thugs kar maḥ 'khor rnams la duḥyig re bcas thams cad kha dog nag po 'od dang ldan pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i gtso 'khor dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed la thim par dmigs la spyan 'dren gyi sngags bzla/ de nas rang yi dam gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer sngon po spos reng gi dud pa ltar zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor gyi zhal du zhugs/ sngags 'khor la phog /mchod pas mnyes/ slar yang sngags phreng 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas dpal mgon dang dbyer med pa'i mthu stobs dang ldan par mos pa dang*/ yang bdag mdun bar sngags phreng de nyid mgal me ltar 'khor bzhin pa'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed gtso 'khor gyi thugs rgyud bskul bas sprul pa yang sprul grangs med 'phros nas dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad tshar bcad pa'i phrin las thogs med bsgrub par dmigs la rtsa sngags dang spyi dril bzla'o// rtsub nyams byung na mthar dam bzhag gi sngags dmigs gzhung ltar bcas la/ gtor 'bul dang phrin bcol rtsa gsum lha tshogs la skong rdzas dngos 'byor yid kyi longs spyod/ yid sprul mchod sprin rab 'byams rgya mtsho blo yis blangs te tshig don ltar dmigs nas 'bul/ de nas nor sgrub la/ rang nyid pad 'byung gsal ba'i/

mdun bskyed bla ma'i drung du dzam lha yab yum rigs bdag dang bcas gsal gdab la thugs kar rin po che'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ yig mthar sngags phreng gser mdog g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bskul ba'i lcang lo can nas dzam lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas mdun bskyed la bstims shing*/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer 'phro 'dus lha mi klu yi longs spyod thams cad char bzhin babs nas bdag mdun la thim par dmigs nas sngags bzla'o// mthar mchod bstod bya/ de nas zab gnad yang gsang snyan brgyud zangs sbub ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa/ lha bskyed/ sngags bzlas/ rdzogs chen la phab pa ste/ dang po tha mal gyi zhen 'dzin rnams stong nyid kyi ngang du sbyangs nas/ rang mdangs ma 'gags rig ba'i rang rtsal las snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas/ phyi stong rang nyid rdo rje gro lod dang*/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khril sbyor can du bsgom pa'i/ rigs bdag phyag mtshan gyi gnas lha rnams gsal gdab/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i gnas lha rnams kyang bskyed la/ dang po thugs ka'i gu ru yab yum kyi sa bon hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor bar dmigs la/ de las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod/ 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas mchog thun dngos grub thob par mos la sngags bzla/ de nas dung khang gi snang mtha' yab yum gyi sa bon hrīḥdang sngags 'khor las 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyang gong bzhin byas la bzla'o// mgrin 'khor 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs gzhan rnams la'ang*/ de'i rigs 'gres dmigs pas khyab/ de nas rim pas phyi snod dang*/ nang bcud/ 'khor 'das snang srid/ 'gro ba rigs drug rnams ye shes lha'i rol par bsgyur nas sngags bzla'o// de nas tshig don ltar/ gang shar thams cad blo 'das brjod med lhan skyes kun tu bzang po'i klong du shar grol dus mnyam gyi nyams len bskyang la/

drag dmigs kyi skabs lha tshogs rnams lhag par khros rngam zil dang ldan pa bskyed la/ sngar ltar thugs ka'i gu ru'i sa bon mthar drag sngags gnyis kyis bskor ba de'i rang sgra dang 'od zer gyis gzugs can gzugs med thams can rang la bstim/ drag po chen po'i mthu rtsal nus stobs thams cad rdzogs par mos la sngags bzla/ gnas lha rnams kyang khro bor gnas 'gyur gyi so sor sngags 'khor spro bsdu sogs gong ltar byas la sngags bzla'o// mthar phyag mtshan rnams spro bsdus gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gyi phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub par bsam/ de nas zab chos rnams kyi rno mtshon yas zor chen mo srid gsum brlag byed kyi dmigs pa'i bsgyur kha rnams ni gzhung nyid du gsal ba de yis khyab par gda'/ 'di'i skabs zhi drag gi las byang bsnyen sngags rnams kyi mthar sngags sham 'dogs skabs/ lag g.yas zla ba g.yon nyi ma'i mthil du gnod byed thams cad thal mo brdab pas rjes med song bar mos/ mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag pa sogs rigs 'gre'o// de nas srid gsum gting zlog skabs/ mdun bskyed 'byung ba rim brtsegs steng du drag po la lha tshogs rnams tshig don ji ltar bskyed la/ sbas gsang gi khro tshogs rnams bzhengs bskul dang*/ mnga' gsol sman raka gtor mchod sbreng ba dang*/ bsgral las skabs/ bdag mdun gyi bar lcags khang nang dgra bgegs 'gugs gzhug drag tu bya zhing*/ phur bskyed gnas lha dang bcas dmigs nas/ lha dbye zhing*/ phur pas bsgral la/ dug lnga ye shes kyi ngo bor bsgyur nas zhal bstab drag po'i las bskul bton/ bzlog pa'i phrin bcol skabs gtor 'bul rnams dang*/ trak+shad dgra chos gtor zad kyi drag bskul bcas bya/ rigs lnga'i zlog pa ni/ de kho na nyid kyi zlog pa zab mo ste stong nyid lta ba'i gdeng dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bya'o// de nas tshe sgrub 'chi med btsan rdzong skabs/

rang lhar gsal ba'i rigs bdag dang*/ gnas lha tshe dpag rigs lnga yab yum bcas bskyed bstim gzhung ltar dang*/ bsnyen pa'i skabs thugs srog 'od zer spro bsdus rang gi bla tshe yar ba/ 'thor ba sogs dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs bcud/ skye 'gro'i tshe bsod/ rgyal ba'i byin rlabs rnams bsdus nas rang la thim par bsgom zhing sngags bzla'o// mthar dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs bton/ 'dir mchod bstod bshags pa sogs don tshang ba nyid do// de nas lus snang lha sku sogs bsdu rim dang dmigs med gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag la/ slar zung 'jug gi skur ldang nas/ kun bzang nang gi bkra shis brjod cing rgyun spyod bya'o// de nas gtor rgyag skabs 'don cha rnams nyin ltar la gting zlog gi phrin bcol tshar 'phral rtsa gsum dang*/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la lam sel gyi ched du rin chen gser skyems 'bul nas mdos dang zor gyi lam phyes par bcol te/ bskang ba'i tha tshig brjod la skong rdzas gtor ma snang srid kyi 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod bzhin 'bul bas gang bcol phrin las mdzad pa dam bcas par mos la/ zor skabs mdos kyi sgo dbye dang*/ de min yi dam chos skyong bskul gyi skabs bzlog gtor gnyis bskul tsam gyis 'thus pas/ 'bod do zhes trak+shad zhal chems las 'gyed dang*/ bskul lo rbad do zhes yi dam bskul bcas bton mthar/ mdos zor rnams rim bzhin btegs nas/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu gyur pa dmigs te phul bas dgyes par rol zhing rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs dpung gnyen sdong grogs lhag par mdzad ba'i mthu rtsal nus pa thogs med bstan pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ lhag ma nad mtshon/ dug rlangs/ me dpung*/ dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs/

mi bsrun pa'i dmag dpung du gyur cing steng 'og bar gsum sprin chen rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du sngon du las mgon 'khor bcas dang*/ de nas gu ru drag po khro chen rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs thams cad mngon spyod kyi las la myur mgyogs bzod dka'i gzi byin 'bar ba dang ldan pas khams gsum g.yo ba dang bcas te dgra yul du chas par dmigs la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams lha'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin drag sngags bzla zhing ser 'phreng rngam brjid dang bcas phyi rol gom pa'am/ yang na 'dom nyer lnga'i sar dpag nas zor chas rnams bkod/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams kyis gzung par mdzad nas legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin/ dam tshig gi rjes gcod pa'i phyir khong nas yus pa'i gdung ba drag po'i nga ro dang bcas te slob dpon gyis bzhes mdzod/ de nas drag po'i lha tshogs rnams mngon spyod kyi las la dgongs pa'i khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i skur bzhengs pa dang bcas phrin las mdzad par mos la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal bcas/ zlog pa rkyang pa'i skabs rang bzo mngon spyod zor las dgos shing*/ de min mdos chen dang zlog pa 'brel skabs yas zor nang ltar zor 'phen nas/ rbad sngags 'don bzhin par rim gyis lid+ga la brdeg /de nas las mgon rbad bskul/ ma hā kā la sogs kyi mthar mdos chen dang*/ bzlog gtor 'phang*/ yi dam drag bskul/ rdo rje dregs 'joms sogs dang*/ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bzlog mthar drag po'i zlog gtor brdeg la bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar pa'i klong nas nad mtshon dug gi sprin phung gtib bzhin pa'i ngang*/ 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor yang steng 'og bsgyur cing dregs byed kyi dmag tshogs rnams kyis gang la dmigs pa'i dgra bo sa gzhi yul mkhar dang bcas ming rus rjes shul tsam yang med par thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag par dmigs/ de nas rigs lnga'i gtor zlog 'don zhing*/

bsgral bya sgrol byed thams cad dmigs med stong chen kun bzang klong du mnyam par bzhag de nas rang lhar gsal ba'i sku las khro bo khro mo rdo rje mtshon cha me ri'i rwa gur gyis srung 'khor bsgom la phyi mig mi lta bar tho btsugs nas phyi lam bcad/ gdon bgegs rnams bskal pa'i bar du mi ldang bar gtor bro brdung la mnan/ snod kha gyen du bstan la me tog 'thor/ sgrub khang nang du phyin la rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bstan dgra bsgral nas/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mi nub srid rtser bsgreng pa'i phrin las yid bzhin 'grub pa'i thugs dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyi mdangs bstan/ gsung dgyes pa'i gad mo'i dbyangs sgrog /sku dgyes pa'i gar dgu'i rol stabs dang bcas sngar bzhin rten la bzhugs pa'i drung du rgyal dbyangs gyer zhing me tog 'thor la/ dgra sod phye mar phul skabs 'dir spro na las bzhi'i me tog blugs pa sogs skabs dang bstun/ tshe 'gugs dang*/ dngos grub rdzas la rol/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs dang*/ dngos grub dbang blang gi dmigs pa bla ma zhi ba ltar 'don bsgom dang*/ rten gtor byin rlabs zhu zhing*/ rten dang gtor ma'i lha tshogs sogs mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor pa rang la bstim/ lus snang lha sku sogs rdzogs rim ka dag spros bral gyi ngang du bzhag /slar yang zung 'jug gi skur ldang nas/ bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor ba sogs bsngo ba smon lam sogs bya zhing rgyun spyod la 'jug nas/ gtang rag tu lha bsang btang pa sogs bya'o// smras pa/ de ltar yang gsang thugs tig zab mo yi// snying po'i yang snying bla med bskyed rdzogs lam// gsal byed gnad kyi man ngag bka' rgya can// gter chen mchog dang chos bdag brgyud bcas kyi// zhal gdams gsung rgyun kun gyi bcud bsdus pa// 'khrul med phyogs gcig bkod pa'i dge gang des// bstan pa mi nub rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*// bstan 'dzin phrin las rgyas pa'i dpal thob cing*// gsang sngags sbas 'os gsal byas nongs pa'i tshogs// dag tshangs gsol zhing dus bab zab chos kyis// 'gro don mthar phyin mkha' khyab lus can rnams// kun tu bzang po'i sa la reg gyur cig

/ces pa'ang gu ru pad+ma'i mtshan gyi byin rlabs cha tsam thob pa si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa ste/ skal ldan rnams la spel zhing*/ dam med log lta can la gsang rgya dgos pa ste/ srung ma rnams kyis mel tshe ma g.yel cig /sa ma ya rak+ṣa/// / ༈ yongs dge mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal gyi zab gter khro rgyal rdo rje gro lod rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i zhal phye'i skabs bca' thabs dang 'don 'grigs kyi rim pa mthong bas don rtogs rab gsal phan bde'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ka rto ra badz+ra ya/ 'dir rtsa gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa dam tshig ldan zhing*/ bstan pa dang bla mar gus pa/ sems can la brtse ba dag gis drag po'i las brtsam par bya ste/ dang po/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs bris 'bur gyi rten bshams pa'i drung du/ mchod rten bang rim gsum byas la/ gong mar za 'og gi stan kheb khar/ dbus su dar dkar po kha gang steng*/ bla ma zhi ba la/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad la/ 'bru dkar dgu tshom bkod/ g.yas su dar dmar kha gang steng*/ yi dam drag po la/ 'bru dmar po'i dgu tshom dang*/ de'i g.yas ngos su dzaṃ lhar/ dar ser kha gang steng*/ 'bru ser po'i dgu tshom bkod/ zhi ba'i g.yon du/ chos skyong la dar nag po kha gang steng*/ 'bru nag gi lnga tshom dang*/ de phyir phyogs mtshams la tshom bu brgyad bkod/ de rnams so so'i khar mañdzu yod kyang legs/ med kyang rung la/ dbus su shel lam dngul snod du bla ma'i rten gtor tshe'i bum pa kha rgyan shing lo dang rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ lto ba pad 'dab brgyad kha gyen bstan can/ gsham du tshe ril rin chen rgyan ldan spungs/ rtse rgyan la shing lo dang*/ dbus su me tog dkar la dmar mdangs can gyi ze'u 'bru'i steng*/ thod chab/ de steng gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga/ rtser nyi zla nor bu dang*/

mtha' skor mdun du/ phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i dkar bshos lnga la dkar/ sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang gi rgyan gnyis can/ phyogs mdog bya/ bar mtshams su tshe ril byur bur spungs/ mdun g.yas g.yon la thabs shes rdzas/ sha dang*/ chang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ tshe mda' rgyan ldan yang gzug /zhi ba'i g.yas la zangs snod du/ yi dam rten gtor thog mdel dbyibs zur gsum rno dbal can me ris brgyan pa/ rtse rgyan dang phrag rgyan la me ri ye shes lnga'i mtshon byed can gyi/ dbus su me tog dmar smug gi ze'u 'bru'i steng*/ gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu dang*/ phur pa/ de gnyis kyi steng bya khyung dang*/ lcags sdig gis mtshan pa/ mtha' skor du sde brgyad dmar gtor me ri can brgyad/ bar mtshams su zas sna bskang ba bshams/ de'i g.yas ngos dngul snod du dzaṃ gtor zan 'bru bzhi'i steng nor bu sum brtsegs mar tshon rgyan dang*/ rtse rgyan shing lo dang*/ dbus su me tog ser skya'i steng*/ shing tog dang*/ ne'u le nor bu skyug pa bcas/ gtor ma'i mtha' bskor/ zho/ 'o ma/ sbrang*/ zhag dang tshil/ rkang mar dang gzhan yang zas sna spungs pa bkod/ bla ma'i g.yon du/ mkha' 'gro'i rten tshe mda' la dar sna lnga btags par so sor sin+dhu ra'i mkha' 'gro'i sngags byang bris pa dang*/ bya rgod lpags pa dri bzang byugs nas dril ba dang*/ gzhan yang me long*/ rin chen sna lnga sogs kyang btags la bum pa'am snod 'brus bkang ba'i nang 'dzug /de'i g.yon du/ lcags sam zangs snod du/ 'bru nag gi las mgon rten gtor zur gsum me ri can/ rtse rgyan yi dam ltar la/ dbus su pad+ma sngo nag gi lte bar/ ru dar dang*/ zhags pa/ lcags kyu dang*/ dgra snying bcas dang*/ mtha' skor yum bzhir zur gsum bzhi/ de rgyab phyogs dang mtshams su bdud mgon dmar gtor brgyad/ de rnams me ri dang*/ gtso 'khor thams cad la sha dar btsug /bar mtshams zas sna spungs pa bcas/

phyi'i rten rdzas dang*/ nang gi rten rdzas bya nag khyi nag /lug nag gi tsit+ta'i rtsa sbubs nang rtsa sngags dang spyi dril bris la/ dar dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis dril/ mdung dar/ zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ dgra snying sogs bris pa'am dngos su bshams/ med kyang rung ba las ci bya/ de ltar rten gtor bzhi kar smug rtsi byug /stegs bar ma rten kheb khar/ g.yas su bdud rtsi dbus su mchod gtor zur gsum can la/ mar rtsi dang dkar thig mar rgyan/ rtser nyi zla nor bu bcas/ g.yon du rak+ta/ de rnams la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar chos sman sel med btab/ sgron thur gnyis sam gcig /mdun ngos g.yas nas mchod yon sogs nyer spyod rnams gtsang zhing yid 'ong phreng tshar bshams/ stegs zhabs mar stag lpags steng*/ dbus su lcags snod yangs pa'i nang sa yis zhal ba byas/ lte bar hom khung bris pa'i nang 'dzud rgyu sogs shog ling spar ma'am bris pa bzhi la/ bstan pa'i spyi dgra'am/ dmigs bsal dgra ming bris la/ skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis/ ling khrus dang*/ lcags khang nang bcug /rang mdun e sogs dang*/ 'gugs gzhug gsum/ lha dbye dang*/ gu gul bdug dgra bo dngos su bsam la/ shog ling gcig gtor ma'i 'og tu mnan/ de steng yi dam gtor zlog gnam lcags thog mdel dbyibs zur gsum rno dbal can/ dug khrag byug pa/ me ris brgyan/ rtser dbu rtsang*/ sked par phyag rtsang gnyis/ sha dar ling gas brgyan/ mtshe dang yungs kar nag btsug /rgyab ngos su me sgron gnyis kyang btsugs/ rtse khra me ris phreng skor can dang*/ gro lod tsakli'i steng dar gdugs dmar smug /yu bas dkyil la btsug pa/ rdo rje phyed pa rtse dgu'i tog bya/ mtha' skor phyogs mtshams sde brgyad dmar gtor me ri can brgyad la rtsang thur gsum re dang*/ sha dar/ lid+ga/ mtshe dang yungs kar nag btsugs/ mtha' bskor gyi mu khyud la pho nya las mkhan gyi tshul du rtsang phur dmar nag la dug khrag gis sbags pa nyer brgyad srin mo 'gros su btsug

/de mthar 'og nas rim bzhin bsnol/ ser dkar/ dmar nag /ljang gi 'byung ba go ldog ltar dkri ba'am/ yang na sngo dmar gyi skud pas 'tshubs ma ris su dkri/ rtser sha dar/ lid+ga khrag rkang gis brgyan/ nang skor rnams su mi ro dang*/ lhu dum sogs kyang bkram la/ dur khrod kyi bkod pa la brjid ldan rngam brjid can bya/ de'i mtha' skor ram/ zur du zangs lcags kyi snod gcig gam so so'i nang du/ gtor zor thog mdel dbyibs can dbu la rtsang gsum re dang*/ mtshe yungs btsugs pa bshams/ g.yon du lcags snod yangs pa'i nang sa'i zhal la dang*/ hom khung bris pa'i nang shog ling bcug la/ steng du chos skyong zlog gtor zur gsum rno dbal can/ rtser trak+shad tsakli/ dar gdugs nag po tog gong ltar/ mtha' mar yum bzhi'i dmar gtor mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bkod/ de'i mthar phyogs dang mtshams su bdud mgon brgyad kyi dmar gtor bcas thams cad la dug khrag byug cing me ri dang*/ lcags ri la rtsang phur btsug pa la sogs gong bzhin yi dam gyi rgyas bkab pa'i chad lhag ma song bar nges par bya/ 'di la gtor zor dgu po de mi dgos/ yi dam gyi g.yas su/ shing gi khri'i khar/ skong gtor gyi 'og gzhi sa la byas pa'i 'byung bzhi bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du ri rab/ de'i phyogs bzhir/ shar gling zla gam/ lho gling sog ka /nub gling zlum po/ byang du gru bzhi gling phran brgyad bcas dang*/ ri rab steng du trak+shad gtor ma zur gsum che ba me ri can/ gling bzhi'i steng du ma gshin dmar gtor bzhi/ gling phran brgyad steng bdud mgon dmar gtor brgyad/ de rnams la dug khrag byug la me ris brgyan/ bang rim dang po'i mthar/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang rdzas brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi tsakli btsugs sa dang zan spar re yang btab/ byang shar zla ba dang*/ lho nub nyi ma/ phreng skor gyi mchod rdzas sogs dkor chas sna tshogs pa'i rigs rnams dang*/

dar tshon stag gzig ras mo rnams snyug rtser 'phyar ba btsugs/ bang rim gnyis par khyung 'brug seng sogs bya rigs 'dab chags rnams dang*/ bang rim gsum par stag gzig dom sogs gcan gzan rnams dang*/ bang rim bzhi par glang chen bse ru/ rta mchog sogs ri dwags dang g.yung dwags sogs thams cad spar du btab la sgros ldan bar mtshams med par bkod/ phyi skor ba'i lcags ri'i steng rtsang phur dug khrag gis sbags pa nyer brgyad srin mo 'gros su btsugs pa'i rtser lid+ga sha dang*/ khrag kong dang*/ mtshams bzhir mar me bzhi/ spos thur bzhi bcas btsugs/ bar mtshams rnams su zas sna dang*/ rin chen phye ma/ dar sna/ sman sna sogs spungs/ steng du dar gdugs sngo nag /yu ba ri rab la btsug pa/ de steng bla ma sku gsum dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tsakli steng dar dmar gdugs/ de steng rigs lnga dang rigs gsum mgon po'i tsakli'i steng dar gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog can/ de rnams lta na sdug cing yid du 'ong bar bya/ gtor chen gsum gyi mdun/ g.yas na khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang lnga'i me tog /gu gul dang tshil chen bdug spos/ mar nag gi snang gsal/ khrag zhag gi dri chab/ sha khrag gis sbags pa'i bshos bu zur gsum/ thod rnga dang*/ rkang gling gi rol mo bsham/ pad snod yangs par 'bru bcud sbyar ba'i tshogs bam gzugs rgyan ldan la/ stobs ldan sha /myos byed chang dang*/ bza' bca' sna tshogs kyis bskor ba bshams/ yi dam gtor 'bul dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ gser skyems/ yang dmar gtor gcig bcas dang*/ las mgon gtor 'bul dmar gtor gcig /bskang ba dmar gtor dang dkar gtor/ dzaṃ lhar dkar gtor/ de rnams gtor chen rnams kyi thad du bshams/ bzlog pa'i skabs mnga' gsol gtor chung bdun/ phrin bcol gtor chung bdun rnams la zangs lcags snod bcu bzhi 'dzoms na dang*/ yang na snod re'i nang gtor ma bdun re bshams pas 'thus/

trak+shad gtor 'bul yang bshams/ lar zlog pa'i grangs dang bstun pa'i gtor ma bshams lugs gong ltar bya ba smos ma dgos/ las phur/ g.yab dar/ rdor dril/ gser skyems brdar rgyu/ gtor gri/ bsang chu 'thor g.yab sogs kyang bkod/ gzhi mdun stegs kyi khar/ sngon 'gro'i dkar gtor dang gser skyems/ glud gzugs g.yas g.yon bshos bu/ ting lo/ rgyab tu changs bu/ sha dum 'bru sna btab pa bsham/ lar dkar gtor nang 'bru sna dang*/ dmar gtor la sha dum/ phud skyems la'ang 'bru sna btab pa bcas kun la dgos/ gzhi drung gang bder/ re nag gam/ ras nag steng hom khung nang*/ slar zor len bzhag rgyu'i shog ling dang*/ sbyin sreg blug na'am gtor rgyag nyin bsgral las skabs/ zhal bstab rgyu'i shog ling bcas 'og tu bcug /de steng zan ling re/ bzlog pa tshar grangs dang bstun bsgral las rgyur rim gyis bzhag dgos/ dbye rdzas bya rog sgro dang*/ 'ug sgro bkod/ yang nye log gang bder nyin bstar gyi mchod 'bru/ chu gtsang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me/ zhal zas/ drag bshos/ mtheb skyu/ dam rdzas/ bdud rtsi/ lid+ga zan spar can dug khrag gis byug pa/ gal che na dgra ming bcug pa mang po dang*/ dmar gtor chung ngu 'ga' zhig dang*/ bam tshogs/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs/ gtor 'bul rnams sogs zhag shas kyi mkho chas kyang 'du bgyis la/ gzhan yang zhi ba dang drag po'i spyan gzigs dkor chas ci 'byor pas mdzes shing rngam par brgyan/ rdo rje slob dpon mdun/ rdo dril thod ḍā/ g.yab dar/ yungs kar/ nas bzed bkod/ las kyi rdo rje'i mdun spos khang dang spos shing*/ gu gul dkar nag /ting bu dang*/ chab bum/ zhal dkris sogs bshams/ rnga chen/ sil sbubs/ rkang gling*/ dung dmar/ rgya gling*/ dung dkar sogs gang 'dzoms bya/ de ltar gtsang sbra dang bcas bshams legs par grub nas spos dang*/ chab kyis bsang*/ phyi nang gi 'grul bcad/ rnal 'byor pa rnams bde ba'i stan la 'god/

༈ nyin dang por tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ bsam pa lhun grub/ brgyud 'debs/ dkar bgegs nas rim pa ltar bton la/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs sngags mthar rol mo mtshams rgyag gis/ a āḥ yang dag don sogs nas ye shes gsang ba/ shog phran/ gro lod/ mkha' 'gro/ tshogs las/ trak+shad mthar skong ba bcas dang*/ dzaṃ ser/ de nas tshe 'gugs bkra shis bcas brjod/ rol mo rnga tshig gsham gsal ltar bya/ ma mgon rgyun gtor skabs dang bstun/ ༈ de nas nyin bzhin 'don 'grigs la/ dang po tshig bdun ma/ bsam lhun/ brgyud 'debs srid zhi ma dang*/ spro na yang dag rdzogs sangs dang*/ lcang lo can sogs/ de nas sngon gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin chen snod mchog sogs nas byin rlabs skabs bran rgyu 'di phyin thams cad la nges dgos/ hūm̐ steng gi lha dang sogs la sh+tsau ka re'i mtshams dril gsil/ 'di'ang rigs 'gre byed/ pū dza kha hi nas/ dkar gtor dang*/ skyems phud phul/ sil snyan zhi rol sum 'phar mthar bzhag

ḍā dril/ 'di nas bkra shis yan sum 'phar thams cad la rol rtags 'di bzhin no// bgegs gtor hūm̐ bh+yo/ nga ni pad+ma badz+ra nas/ byin rlabs dang*/ thams cad kyi 'gugs pa'i rgya byed pa 'di'ang rigs 'gre dgos/ na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs/ dril/ sngags bcas lan gsum/ sam+bha ra g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon se gol bcas las rdor gyis chu sbreng*/ bh+yo bi shwa la thal mo kha gyen bstan/ sngags gnyis kar gsum re/ hūm̐ nyon cig sogs/ dril gsil dang*/ ta ya phaṭaḥ nas/ sbub chol 'bebs/ bgegs gtor phyi rol du phul/ gu gul bdug dril gsil dang yungs kar gyis brab/ g.yab dar g.yugs/ phaṭa drag po brjod la tshes bcu gsang 'dus dang gro lod gzhung gi rol chen nyin bzhin res mos kyis mthar sum brdung gis/ bgegs bskrad/ bka' brgyud bla ma dang mtshams gcod rnam rtog gnyis 'dzin skabs gu gul gnas dang yo byad la 'thul zhing*/ shīn+taṃ ku ru ā nas/ dril/ rol mo 'bebs mthar/ 123 3 12 3 srung 'khor rang rig bla ma sogs/ a āḥ nas/ rol mo 'bebs mthar/ 123 3 12 3 thal sbyar/ skyabs 'gro/ chos sku longs sku sogs lan gsum/ sku gsum bla ma'i sogs/ yan lag bdun pa'i mthar/ rol chen ḍā dril bcas/ byin 'bebs spyan 'dren rnams kyi thog mtha' dgos pa rigs 'gre'o// mthar sum brdung 'dzag che rdeg bcas/ byin 'bebs/ bzhi dril/ skye med chos dbyings nas/ 'khor los sgyur ba lan gsum dang*/ rgyal ba rab 'byams nas/ sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ dal ran 'dir bshams mchod rdzas sogs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs rnams lan gsum re mchod rdzas thams cad la sman raka 'thor mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ phyi sgrub kun bzang*/ hūm̐ 'khor 'das ye stong sogs nas/ lus lha rtsa 'khor bskyed pa bcas/ dril/ sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ 'khor 'das ye stong klong chen nas/

spyan 'dren sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs mthar/ 1 122 12 122 12 stong gsum stong sogs/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal mchod/ bskang*/ bshags pa/ mtshams rgyag / bstod pa/ chos dbyings rgyal ba nas/ sil snyan 'bebs bzhag rol/ bsnyen pa dang por/ spyan 'dren sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bo dhi tsit+ta nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥnyer lnga bar/ rgyun bsnyen gong ltar gyi hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ gi bar sum brgya bzla/ de nas rigs lnga'i bskyed bzlas rnams la rnga mi bskul/ de nas nang sgrub ye shes gsang ba'i gzhi rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ sil snyan sum brdung*/ a a āḥ yang dag don ni sogs dang*/ lam bskyed rim gsal btab/ hrīḥ mkha' dbyings ye shes sogs nas spyan 'dren dril/ sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ sil snyan 'bebs nas/ 'dzag gnyis bdun brdung dal ran bcas/ bzhi dril/ hūm̐ sngon gyi bskal pa sogs lan gsum/ gnas mchog 'dir nas sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ sil snyan 'bebs nyis brdung gnyis 'phar gong ltar/ nyi zla pad+ma 'bar sogs bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod phreng skong bshags rnams so so'i dbyangs gdangs dang bstun pa'i rol tshigs skabs thob dang*/ sman raka gtor 'bul sogs skabs sbreng tshul/ gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o// bshams pa'i mthar/ rig rtsal myur rtogs shog nas/ 'bebs bzhag rol/ tshogs thengs bya/ ༈ yar 'tshogs/ sil snyan sum brdung*/ chos dbyings skye med sogs bstod pa dang*/ mtshams rgyag bla ma rig 'dzin nas/ chu bzhag lta bur gyur bar/ sil snyan 'bebs bzhag rol/ rang rig bla ma sogs bsnyen dmigs dang*/ bsnyen pa dang por/ thod phreng rtsal nas/ ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ spyan 'dren sngags/ 25 rgyun bsnyen thod phreng rtsal 50 nas/ ā yu sid+dhi dzaḥbar 300 bzla/ de nas shog phran tshe sgrub/ shrī ma hā gu ru nas/ dzab bsnyen so sor 50 bzla/ de nas gsang sgrub gro lod/ rol mo nyis brdung 'dzag med kyis/ gdos bcas lus snang sogs bskyed rim dang*/

drag rtsal 'gying rngams rgya stag steng: rig rtsal sogs gter gzhung rdo rje'i gsung du nges pa'i zhal rgyun lags/ spyan 'dren sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs nas/ bdun brdung gnyis mthar 'dzag med kyis/ dgongs su gsol dang*/ sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs nyis brdung gong ltar/ phyag 'tshal gdan 'bul mchod skong bshags par/ mtshams rgyag / dril/ bstod pa mthar/ sil snyan 'bebs bzhag rol/ bsnyen pa dang po/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ shrī he ru ka sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra can spyan 'dren sngags/ 25 rgyun bsnyen artsig 300 bzla/ mthar artsig sham bur/ sde brgyad las bskul/ a ya ma nas/ bh+yo zlog cig bar bzla'o// de nas 'bul gtor rnams bran/ rol mo bzhi brdung 'theng 'gros gnyis kyis/ bzhengs bskul dgongs su gsol nas/ rdul du rlog la/ mtshams rgyag / dmar gtor zlog gtor nang du phul/ rdo rje drag po sogs nas/ bdud rtsi gser skyems bzhes nas/ dmar gtor dang*/ skyems phud dgra phyogs su 'thor/ sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bzlog pa so sor/ thal rdeb dang mtshams rgyag re bcas sngags mthar dmar gtor gcig zlog gtor nang du phul/ rol mo 'bebs bzhag rol/ tshogs thengs/ ༈ yar 'tshogs/ man+dha ra wa/ sil snyan sum brdung 'dzag med rigs 'gre dgos/ rig rtsal ma 'gags sogs/ lha bskyed nas spyan 'dren dang po/ dril/ sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ sil snyan 'bebs sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ rang nyid ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs/ spyan 'dren gnyis par dril/ sngags mthar/ ḍā dril sil snyan 'bebs sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ nga ni dpal chen sogs spyan 'dren gsum par sngags mthar/ ḍā dril/ sil snyan 'bebs nyis brdung 'dzag med gong ltar/ rab 'jigs sogs/ gdan 'bul/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod phreng*/ skong zlog bshags par/ mtshams rgyag / bstod pa rnams gdangs dang skabs thob rnga tshigs bya/

mthar/ sil snyan 'bebs kyis bzhag /dzab dmigs dang bsnyen pa 300 bzla/ bsdu rim mthar/ tshogs kyi yo byad la bsang chus bran/ rol mo sum brdung 'dzag che brdeg gis/ bcom ldan kun bzang sogs dang*/ bla ma yi dam nas/ las rdor gyis rdor dril/ g.yab dar bcas 'gugs pa'i rgya/ rig 'dzin bdag la nas sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung gis/ bshug pa bcas lan gsum/ rjes mar bdun brdung 'theng po lan gnyis bcas/ nga ni snang srid/ bsgral las skabs/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon las phur bcas mtshams su bkrol/ rdo rje phur bus gdab par bya/ lhubs gdangs skabs 'dir tshig rnga mtshams rgyag bcas/ bam bsgral/ kun bzang klong la rol mo lto skor tshe/ rnga thing brdung byas mthar bdun brdung 'theng po gnyis dang*/ sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs bdun brdung gnyis dang 'dzag med gnyis kyis/ bzhi dril/ rgyal ba rab 'byams sogs/ zhal bstab gdangs kyi skabs dgu brdung 'dzag che brdeg can lan gnyis/ rgyun par bdun brdung bya/ tshogs phud rim pa drug spros la bsham/ bdud rtsis bran la/ rim pa ltar/ sman gtor nang phul/ gcig lhag ma'i dus 'bul rgyu bzhag /mthar bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog nas/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /slob dpon 'dus pa bcas dpa' bo'i dga' ston tshogs la rol/ zhabs brtan bkra shis bcas bton/ lhag ma bsdu ba'am/ h+ya gṛ ba'i dgongs pa gong gi gtsang lhag phul ba las bka' gnyan phyir mang lhag gang byung mi rung gsung rgyun snang*/ de nas/ ḍā dril/ rol mo chem brdung 'bebs/ bshug glu bcas/ nyis brdung 'dzag dang*/ sum brdung 'dzag med spel mas/ bam sgrol lhag sdud sogs sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /lhag gtor dkyil 'khor 'og tu bsags la/ gtor rdzogs nyin phyir gtsang sar 'bul dgos/ tshogs thengs/ ༈ yar 'tshogs/ pad+ma nyi zla'i sogs/ gsang bdag bskyed bzlas 25 dang*/ yang gsang trak+shad mdun bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/

gsal gdab gzhung ltar spyan 'dren sngags mthar g.yab dar 3 g.yugs/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs nyis brdung gis/ bzhengs shig bla ma sogs dang*/ bskul lo 'bod do gdangs byed na dgu brdung 'dzag med dang*/ bdud dmag sa ya'i mthar/ mtshams rgyag / ma mo sa ya nas brel du btang*/ ḍā dril/ mthar dgu brdung 'dzag med dang rol mo 'bebs dang nyis brdung gis/ chos sku longs sku sogs phyag 'tshal/ bzhugs gsol mthar/ mtshams rgyag / 'das dang ma sogs/ dam bzhag mchod pa bstod pa'i sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /bsnyen pa dang po/ spyan 'dren sngags/ 25 rgyun bsnyen rtsa sngags dang*/ spyi dril sbrel mar 300 bzla/ dam bzhag sngags lan gsum mthar gtor ma bran/ rol mo sum brdung gis/ 'khor 'das rang grol/ sngags mthar/ mtshams rgyag bcas/ gtor ma zlog gtor nang phul/ khyod la gtor ma 'bul sogs dang*/ sngags mthar/ rol mo sum brdung*/ skong gtor bran/ stong gsal mkha' dbyibs sogs nas/ gnyer gtad do// 58/7 mthar dkar gtor dang*/ dmar gtor bskang bar phul/ sil snyan 'bebs kyis bzhag /trak+shad gsol kha gsung*/ de nas dzaṃ ser/ rang nyid skad cig sogs/ bdag mdun bskyed mthar/ rin chen 'bar ba'i sogs/ bsnyen dmigs dang*/ sngags sum sbrel ltar 100 bzla/ gtor ma bran/ sil snyan sum brdung*/ mchod bstod mthar/ sil snyan 'bebs kyis bzhag /dkar gtor dzaṃ gtor drung du phul/ de nas zangs sbubs ma/ 'byung ba bzhi yi sogs sgrig 'don gyis/ rim gsal ltar dzab bsnyen rnams so sor 25 bzla/ drag dmigs skabs yig 'bru dgu pa trak+shad rtsa sngags so// de nas tshogs thengs/ yar 'tshogs/ yas zor mdos chen gyi 'don 'grigs gsham gsal ltar dang*/ de nas srid gsum gting zlog las gtor ma che ba gnyis dang*/ mnga' gsol dang*/ phrin bcol gtor chung bcas bcu bzhi dang*/ las mgon gtor 'bul sogs bran la/ dang por rkang gling bzhi 'bud btang nas/

rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis rkang gling btang*/ rang mdun yam̐ las sogs drag po'i lha tshogs mdun bskyed mthar/ gsal ba'i snang bar gyur nas mtshams rgyag dang*/ zla gam dmar nag sogs/ bzhengs bskul spyan 'dren dril/ sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs dang ḍā dril/ gsol lo mchod do zhes pa rnams la sman raka 'thor zhing gtor ma lnga yi dam zlog gtor nang phul/ bstan srung rgya mtsho dang*/ snang srid lha 'dre sogs/ gtor ma gnyis las mgon zlog gtor nang phul/ slob dpon mdun las phur dang*/ lcags khang du lid+ga/ lha dbye'i rdzas bcas bkod la/ 'gro don lhun 'grub shog mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung gis/ rang mdun e las dang*/ na mo dkon mchog gsum dang zhes par 'gugs pa'i rgyas/ 'gugs rol 'bebs*/ g.yab dar/ bshug pa bcas lan gsum mthar sum brdung gis/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdzus skyes sogs/ rdor thal bar phur bu 'dzin phur bskyed dang*/ dril sngags mthar/ mtshams rgyag bcas/ 'o las ngan khyod sogs/ bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgros/ lha dang dbye mthar/ mtshams rgyag dang*/ 'o dam nyams ru tra las ngan sogs/ phur pa gdab/ lid+ga bsgral/ dum bur gtub/ dril sngags mthar/ mtshams rgyag bcas/ gnas spar/ 'o las ngan sogs/ phaṭa nas/ mtshams rgyag / ling ro snod du bzhag la/ slob dpon gyis 'dzin bzhin/ dam nyams las ngan sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs zhes par bdud rtsi bran la/ bzhi dril/ kun bzang rigs lnga'i sogs nas zhal bstab sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung tshe las rdor gyis ling ro phyed zlog gtor gnyis nang btab/ phyed zlog gtor chung ba dang bdun nang btab/ so sor bdud rtsi bran/ drag bskul/ che ba'i che mchog mthar/ sa ma ya nas/ mtshams rgyag dang*/ phrin bcol ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs rim bzhin/ gtor chung drug yi dam zlog gtor nang du phul/ bcom ldan kun bzang che mchog skabs gtor chung gcig mgon po'i zlog gtor nang 'bul/

gong 'og gdangs la rnga tshigs so sor bya ba kun la 'gre/ mthar rbod gtong zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod nas/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ las mgon gtor rbad/ ma hā kā la sogs nas/ rbad sngags don bzhi ma'i mthar/ rol mo 'bebs bzhag /gtor 'bul trak+shad zlog gtor nang phul/ rigs lnga'i gtor zlog sgrig 'don gyis so sor thal rdeb bcas gtor zlog tshar gsum/ de nas tshogs thengs/ lar zlog pa tshar gang 'gro tshogs thengs gang 'grigs dang*/ tshar grangs gsog skabs/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ rang mdun yam las sogs sngar ltar rol mo dang*/ gtor 'bul gong 'og bsgral las/ gtor rbad/ gtor zlog mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ zlog pa tshar gnyis kyi rjes ma'i skabs gtor rbad mthar// 'dzag che ba gcig sum brdung 'dzag med che gcig /sum brdung chung gcig /de 'dra lan gnyis mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /de nas gtor zlog grub nas/ tshe sgrub 'chi med btsan rdzong*/ hrīḥ dkon mchog gsum dang sogs/ rdor dril 'dzin/ mda' dar g.yab/ tshe dzab gnyis sbrel 100 bzla/ thal mo sbyar la/ dril/ dbyangs gsal/ rten snying*/ yig brgya sbrel mar lan gsum*/ hūm̐ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs/ 'dir mchod bstod bshags pa tshang zhing*/ mthar ḍā dril/ zhi rol sum 'phar mthar bzhag /lus snang lha sku sogs bsdu rim dang zung 'jug gi skur ldang*/ de nas kun bzang bkra shis/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med sogs dril gsil dang*/ me tog 'thor/ mthar/ ḍā dril/ zhi rol su 'phar mthar bzhag /rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi sogs dang*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir sogs/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs brjod/ tshogs grol lo// ye shes mgon po'i rgyun gtor btang ba skabs bstun bya'o// gtor bsngo bton na mchod sbyin gnas sogs mgon po'i mthar 'don/ ༈ gtor rgyag nyin 'don 'grigs nyin ltar la/

bsgral las skabs sngon du hom nang yod rgyu'i shog ling gcig de/ zan ling dang mnyam bsgral gyis/ shog ras sbyin sreg blugs na zhal bstab rgyu bzhag /de min zan ling dang mnyam phul dgos/ 'don pa dal brel dang*/ tshogs thengs sogs gang bdes/ sgra gcan phyogs thebs bstun pa'am/ sā dha ka 'dzin rtog med pa'i gdeng yod na nam 'grigs bya ba'i/ zlog pa'i mtha'i pha rol rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ mthar/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /de las snga bar phyi rol du gom pa'am 'dom nyer lnga mtshams skyer shing gi me thab zur gsum brtsig bcug la/ rtse phyogs gtsang la gtad pa'am/ dgra phyogs su gtad/ nye skor tsher ma can sogs shing skam mang ba bcug /ser sbrengs gshar na de'i chas bsgrig pa dang*/ dar nag 'phyar/ zor chas rnams gra bsgrig /hom khung nas shog ling gcig de'ang bton la/ gsal shing rtser bskyon nas bzhag /yang na sgrub khang nang nas gtor rgyag byed tshe gral mdo lta bur/ phyar nag bting*/ de steng sa dkar gyi gru gsum nyis rim me ris bskor ba bris la de nang shog ling bzhag pas 'thus/ de nas slob dpon sngags chas rdor dril dang 'dus pa rnams zhwa bzhes la mthon po zhig nas/ gser skyems rin chen snod mchog la phyogs gtsang ngam/ dgra phyogs su gdong bstan la/ tshig dang mtshungs par gser skyems 'thor ba dang*/

'bebs gnyis kyi sngon mar gser skyems 'bul/ rjes mas blugs/ mchan/ skabs thob byed/ des drag po'i mdos zor gyis lam phye ba sngon du grub nas/ nang du 'ong*/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ bskang ba'i bzhengs bskul tha tshig /hūm̐/ bskul lo thugs dam sogs nas/ gtor g.yog pas skong gtor btegs la/ las rdor gyis mar me dang spos rnams sbar/ bdud rtsi bran/ las bzhi'i phrin las myur du sgrubs// rol mo sum brdung dang*/ 'di nas/ tsakli dar gdugs bkra shis rdzas rtags/ rgyal srid tsakli rnams len la gzhi steng bzhag /hūm̐/ stong gsum 'jig rten sogs nas/ rbad sngags don bzhi dang*/ dam bzhag sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /dal ran bcas/ skong gtor mtho sar phyogs gtsang ngam dgra phyogs su gtor zhal bstan la bzhag /'di skabs zor las kyi 'don cha rnams ma 'khrul bar bsal/ gtor khyer ba rnams kyang bsgrig /'dus pa rnams zhwa bzhes/ ser phreng byas na bzhengs/ de min mi dgos/ rol mo 'bebs mthar dgu brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐ 'bod do bskul lo sogs zhal chem las 'gyed mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ bskul lo rbad do rab 'byams sogs nas slob dpon gyis chos skyong dang*/ yi dam gtor chen gnyis btegs tsam byas/ ser sbrengs skabs gtor g.yog par khur bcug /de 'phral gzhi steng der dar dkar po'i thog tu phye mar bkod/ gtor gdan stag lpags dang*/ gzhan zor chas rnams kyang so sor khur bcug /drag po'i phrin las mdzod nas/ rol mo 'bebs bzhi brdung kho nar byed nas sngon du dkar gtor dang gser skyems chas shog ling dang stag lpags/ rkang gling*/ dung dmar/ gtor zor dgu dang mda' bcas phyogs gcig tu bzhag pa dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ yi dam gtor chen/ dar nag gnyis sam gcig /spos 'dzin pa slob dpon gyis rdor dril g.yab dar bcas/ drag sngags rnams bzla bzhin/

rnga ba kha shas dang rol mo pa/ de nas rnga pa yongs rdzogs byon/ 'bul sar slebs nas/ gtor ma rnams stag lpags steng bshams/ nye skor du dar nag 'phyar/ slob dpon dbus dang*/ g.yas g.yon ser phreng pa rnams bzhengs la/ shog ling me thab nang bcug /ser phreng*/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /de nas shog ling chus bran/ thams cad kyis 'gugs pa'i rgyas/ 'gug gzhug rgyas pa tshar gcig /na mo dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam zhi khro'i lha sogs tshar gnyis/ lan gsum kar 'gugs sngags dang*/ bshug pa bcas/ rang bzo mngon spyod kyi/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo// gsan du gsol lo sogs dang*/ rol mo 'bebs gnyis kyis/ kyai nyon cig snang srid sogs nas gal gol ba dri ba che'o// mthar/ rol mo 'bebs gnyis bcas skyems mchod/ dkon mchog kun 'dus mthar/ rol mo 'bebs gnyis kyis skyems dang*/ dkar gtor mchod/ rol mo 'bebs kyis/ spro na slob dpon nam dbu mdzad kyis bzhes 'bod bton na 'dir bya/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /de nas rang bzo mngon spyod zor las/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo sogs dang*/ zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas/ rtsad nas chod par shog: mthar rol mo 'bebs chem brdung gis bzhag la/ yang phrin las mdzod nas rol mo gong ltar/ yang rdul du rlog nas/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ mthar 'bebs/ yang rmang nas ma ldang zhig la/ 'bebs/ yang skyabs gnas hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'bebs/ thal bar rlog la/ 'bebs/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo// bden don gnyis sogs nas/ thal bar rlog la/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ tshig rnga mtshams rgyag bcas/ rdo rje gro lod lan bcu gsum/ mthar chem brdung gis bzhag /hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: bdag cag sogs nas/ sangs rgyas sa ru phyin na dga' mod/ mthar/ 'bebs chem brdung bcas bzhag /de ltar gtor zor dgu po so sor 'phen/ nga bdag ye nas sogs dang*/ mda' zor yang 'phen/ rol mo 'bebs chem brdung mthar sum brdung gis/

hūm̐ ma hā kā la mthu bo sogs dang*/ tsakli gtor gdugs len/ me sgron sbar/ me thab yang sbar la/ rbad sngags don bzhi ma'i sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung dal ran gyis/ las mgon bzlog gtor 'phang mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ rdo rje dregs 'joms lha tshogs sogs nas/ dgra la mā ra ya phaṭa nas/ rol mo 'bebs chem brdung dang sum brdung gis khro rgyal 'bar ba'i lha tshogs sogs lan gsum 'don tshe/ tsakli dar gdugs len/ me sgron sbar/ sngags rnams mthar/ yi dam zlog gtor me thab tu 'phang nas/ mā ra ya'i rol chen ldir/ dar nag lan dgur brdab/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /yang nang nas gtor rgyab skabs/ gtor zor 'phang pa thams cad re phyar nang gtor g.yog gnyis kyis bteg /de rjes las rdor zhwa bcas dril bu gsil/ g.yab dar g.yab/ drag sngags rnams 'don bzhin/ skabs su rkang gling yang 'bud nas/ sngar brtsegs pa'i me hom nang gtor zor rnams bsreg la/ de nas rigs lnga'i gtor zlog sgrig 'don so sor thal rdeg bcas dang*/ slob dpon gyis mtshams gcod dang srung 'khor bsgom/ tho btsugs phyi lam bcad/ sgrub khang sgo drung du/ gtor gzhong sbub la rdo rjes mnan/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha sogs nas/ gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og tu khug /'gug rol nyis brdung*/ g.yab dril/ drag 'bebs/ bshug pa bcas lan gsum mthar sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ dngos snang sems su sogs/ gtor bro phreng sbrel lu gu rgyud bcas mthar/ gtor gzhong rnams kha gyen pas rnal 'byor pa sogs nas ku ru oṃ/ nas gtor/ nang du 'ong dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs pas rgyal dbyangs/ ho dgongs su gsol lan gsum dang*/ sil snyan 'bebs sum brdung gis/ snang srid 'khor 'das sogs lan gsum dang zla ba yar tshes rol mo ldir/ gral la bzhugs/ phye mar bkye drangs/ zhabs brtan dang bkra shis brjod/ sbyin sreg blugs na longs skabs byung tshe 'dir bya/

mthar tshe 'gugs dang bkra shis sogs bya'o// phyi nyin dngos grub len chog gam/ yang na me haṃ blugs na nyin dang po'i 'don 'grigs ltar/ ye gsang*/ shog phran/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro/ tshogs las/ spro na tshogs brgya skabs/ bcom ldan kun bzang nas/ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog bar/ tshogs re bshams la/ bsgral bstab bcas grangs 'dzin/ phud sman gtor nang thams cad phul nas/ lhag phud phyogs gcig bzhag /slar lhag ma'i skabs phyi rol du 'bul/ mgon po skong ba bcas/ gtor 'bul yang bya/ dzam ser mthar/ sbyin sreg 'don 'grigs 'og tu gsal/ slar tshe 'gugs dang bkra shis bya/ dngos grub len pa nang snga bar/ zhi drag mkha' 'gro/ tshogs/ chos skyong*/ dzam lha bton/ tshe 'gugs kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs/ tshe ril tshe chang drangs/ dril bcas/ dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya dang*/ ye shes lha tshogs mthar/ ḍā dril/ zhi rol mthar sum brdung blangs nas/ dbang bzhi pa len pa/ skya rengs shar dus sam nyi shar dang bstun la/ ye shes gsang ba'i/ hūm̐ bla ma rig 'dzin sogs nas sngags dbang skabs/ zhi ba'i rten gtor tshe bum slob dpon gyi gnas bzhir bzhag la/ sngar ltar gtor ma yar bzhag /chu bzhag lta bur gyur nas rol mo sum 'phar bcas bzhag /rten dang gtor ma'i sogs kyis bsdu rim dang*/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang*/ bkra shis brjod cing me tog char bsnyil/ ḍā dril/ zhi rol sum 'phar/ de nas slar yang gtang rag tu lha bsang btang ba sogs bya'o// ༈ drag po'i me hom las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi dus ni mar ngo'i brgyad/ bcu bzhi'i nyin phyed dam/ nam gung yang na gang bder bya ba'i/ phung gsum sas bsres/ rgyar mda' gang*/ dpangs ji bde byas la dug khrag gis chag chag btab pa'i steng*/ me thab gru gsum nag po rgyar sor mo nyi shu pa/ kha khyer rim gsum rnams la ral gri dang gri gug spel mas bskor/ phyi rol me ri'i phreng ba dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga mthing nag

/de rnams rdul tshon nam/ bri ba gang bde'i thabs kyis mchu nang skyer pa sogs drag po'i yam shing dug khrag gis sbags pa zur gsum pa'i mtshams par brtsegs pa'i nang me tshang dang*/ shar lhor mar nag gi ti lo bzhag /bud shing skyer pa dang tsher ma can zur gsum du bzhag /slob dpon g.yas ngos su stegs kyi khar ras dmar po'i steng*/ yi dam dang chos skyong gi mchod pa rim pa gnyis su bshams pa'i yi dam la g.yas nas brtsams pa'i khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang lnga'i me tog gu gul dang tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ mar nag gi snang gsal/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha khrag gis sbags pa'i drag bshos zur gsum/ thod rnga rkang gling gi rol mo sogs dang*/ gtor 'bul dmar gtor bcu yang bshams/ chos skyong la'ang de ltar gyis mchod pa dang*/ gtor 'bul bcu sogs bsham/ g.yon ngos su stegs kyi khar ras nag po'i steng yi dam dang*/ chos skyong gi dbye rdzas rnams rim pa gnyis su bkod pa'i g.yon nas brtsam lcags snod gru gsum mam/ zangs lcags snod gang rung la lid+gar spar btab par dug khrag gis byug pa brgya/ gal che na dgra ming bcug /sha dum brgya/ sngar gyi shog ling ras mo rnams khrag dang bsres la thod par blug pa dang*/ 'bru sna/ lcags sam zangs sam snod du mar nag tshan mo 'di thab kyi nye skor du bzhag dgos/ dar zab brgya/ ka pā lar bdud rtsi dang*/ thod pa rak+tas bkang pa/ dmar gtor brgya/ sha khrag bsres pa'i bag phye'i ril bu brgya bcas bkod/ chos skyong la'ang de ltar bshams dgos/ slob dpon mdun rdo'i me yol nang ngos stegs kyi khar/ rdor dril/ thod rnga/ g.yab dar/ dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab/ bsang chu/ 'thor g.yab bshams bkod/ slob dpon sngags chas rdzogs par rus rgyan bcas so// dar sngon stod g.yogs/ rak+ta dang*/ thod phreng gi se ral khar byas/ gdan nag po'am/ sngon po'i steng du/ rkang pas rkang pa mnan pa'am/

g.yas skyil krung*/ rkang g.yon bslang ba'am/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsug pa gang bdes kha lhor bltas la/ sngon du las byang bskyed bzlas zin bzhin 'di nas ma grol bar ngag bcad dang*/ rdor dril ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar byas la/ dang po shan pa'i khyim gyi me snod du blang bar/ dpal 'bar spar/ bsang chu bran la/ thab kyi ting lo spar nas/ bud shing rnams kyang sbar/ drag po'i skabs 'dir lag g.yas dgang gzar dang*/ g.yon blug gzar gyis mar khu lan gsum blugs la/ me gsos rlung g.yab brdeb/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rang rig rdo rje gro lod sogs/ bdag mdun lha bskyed nas/ bsreg par gyur nas/ ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs bdun brdung gnyis rjes mar 'dzag med kyis/ ho ho dgongs su gsol lo sogs spyan 'dren sngags mthar mar khu dgang blugs kyis bdun byon skyems su phul/ ḍā dril/ 'bebs nyis brdung gis/ phyag 'tshal gdan 'bul mchod skong bshags pa bstod pa'i mthar/ 'bebs sum brdung gis/ zlog pa'i nang gi na mo dkon mchog gsum sogs 'gugs gzhug lan dgu/ g.yab dril/ 'gugs rol sum brdung bshug pa bcas/ zhal phye/ hūm̐ khro rgyal dregs 'joms sogs nas/ lhun grub shog bar/ 'bebs kyis bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ shrīḥhe ru ka sogs nas/ ru dra'i rus pa sogs/ lha sngags dang*/ rdzas sngags sbrel ma brgya res dang po lid+ga brgya mtheb srin gyis phul/ mthar dgang gzar khar/ dmar gtor bran/ rol mo sum brdung gis/ ho/ dgongs su gsol lo sogs kyi sngags mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ gtor ma dgang gzar gyis me thab nang du 'bul mthar/ khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sogs zlog pa sngags mthar chem brdung*/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ sngar bzhin zhal phye dang*/ mam sa mtheb srin gyis phul ba dang*/ rak+ta blugs gzar gyis/ 'bru sna mtheb srin gyis/ zhun mar dgang blugs kyis/ dar zab mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi dang*/

rak+ta gnyis dgang blugs kyis/ gtor ma dang*/ zas sna mtheb srin gyis dbul ba ste/ de ltar dgyes rdzas re re bzhin brgya rtsa re/ lha sngags rdzas sngags sbrel ma mthar gtor 'bul re dang zlog pa bcas sngar ltar bya'o// rjes su gzhung gsal ltar me lha gro lod 'khor bcas sogs bsdu rim bya/ de nas gsang bdag bskyed bzlas/ pad+ma nyi ma'i sogs dang*/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum gyis me gsos shing*/ bud shing bsnan la sbar/ mdun bskyed las mgon/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs nas lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren sngags mthar mar khu dgang blug gis bdun byon skyems su 'bul/ 'bebs nyis brdung*/ dkyus ltar la/ bstod pa'i mthar/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐/ dpal mgon srog bdud sogs zhal phye gong ltar la rigs 'gre'o// rtsa sngags dang spyi dril gnyis sbrel gyis/ dgyes rdzas bcu so sor brgya re'i mtshams su gtor ma re bran/ 'khor 'das rang grol/ sngags mthar dgang gzar gyis gtor 'bul dang*/ khyod la gtor ma 'bul ba'i sogs mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung gis/ sngar bzhin dang*/ khro rgyal 'bar zlog bcas rjes su me lha srog bdud 'khor bcas/ zhes yi dam kha bsgyur gsungs ltar gyis bsdu rim bya/ long yod na me mi bsgul bar bzhag /de min dug khrag chus zhi bar byas nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas bsdus la chu bor 'dor zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ las gzhung gi tshe 'gugs dang bkra shis la 'jug par bya'o// ༈ yas zor bca' bshams gter gzhung gsal ltar ma 'khrul bar zhib par byas la/ las byang 'og zhi drag gi bzlas pa rnams kyi sngags sham du/ dgra bgegs dam sri mā ra ya phaṭaḥ bh+yo bzlog /thal rdeb bcas nyer lnga re bton dgos shing*/ zangs sbub ma'i mthar mdos byin rlabs/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sogs sngags tshan gsum so sor nyer lnga re dang*/ mdos kyi drung dmar gtor bcu gnyis kyang bshams/

de nas mdos bskyed pa/ swa bhā wa dang*/ snang srid 'khor bcas thams cad sogs nas/ ba ling+ta āḥ hūm̐ bar/ bdug spos bsreg /ru dar 'phyar zhing*/ 'di skabs rol mo yang brel tsam bya zhing*/ g.yab 3 ḍā dril/ rol mo 'bebs dgu brdung 'dzag med kyis bzhengs shig mar/ bskul lo rbad do'i gdangs gis bkab/ bzhengs shig srid gsum nas thung du btang*/ nyin gzhan la'ang res mos kyis spyan 'dren gnyis rer bkab pa'i bskul mtshams bcas mthar/ rol mo 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ rang byung chos dbyings sogs/ bskang mchod skabs/ chang dang*/ rak+ta/ dug khrag rnams rim pas mchod cing*/ mdos la bdud rtsi 'thor ba sogs gzhung ltar bya/ 'gres byang gnyis bcas so so'i sngags mthar/ rol mo/ mtshams rgyag dang*/ mthar/ 'bebs sum brdung gis len/ de nas lid+ga/ mkhar thab/ sha dum 'bru sna bcas so sor brgya rtsa re dang*/ lid+ga lcags khang mdos drung bshams la chus bran/ rang mdun e sogs dang*/ g.yab dar bcas/ 'gugs gzhug nyer gcig /'gugs rol bshug pa bcas lan rjes mar 'bebs mthar bzhag /bla 'gugs nyer gcig sngags gsog /rol mo sum brdung gis/ 'o las ngan sogs lha dbye mthar/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ zhal phye/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rab 'byams sogs nas/ bzhes su gsol bar/ mthar/ 'bebs bzhag rol/ ma hā kā la sogs/ rbad sngags mthar khā hi btags pa'i zhal bstab sngags nyer lnga re dang*/ lid+ga nyer lnga re sbrags nas las rdor gyis mdos nang 'bul mthar/ rol mo sum brdung*/ hūm̐ ma hā kā la mthu bo che sogs sngags mthar/ dmar gtor re mdos nang phul/ yang 'bebs sum brdung*/ gong ltar zhal phye re dang*/ rbad sngags dang zhal bstab sngags tshan rnams rim pas nyer lnga re'i mthar/ gtor 'bul dang bcas rigs 'gre'i bzhi gsum bcu gnyis bton pas khyon zhal bstab rnam gsum brgya rtsa re grub par byas mthar/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ de nas mdos zor la gzhung ltar mchod rdzas rnams kyis gso zhing bran la/

byin rlabs gong ltar/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥsogs sngags tshan gsum lan gsum re dang*/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ rgyal ba rgyal ba'i 'khor lo sogs/ 'gres byang bcas/ bar mtshams rnams la rol mo/ mtshams rgyag re dang bcas/ sgrub par mdzod nas/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs spyan 'dren sngags g.yab dar g.yab/ dril bu gsil la khā hi/ sbyar ba brgya rtsa/ a ya ma la khā hi sbyar ba brgya rtsa/ rbad sngags dang thal rdeb brgya rtsa/ dam bzhag sngags brgya rtsa bcas bton/ de nas srid gsum gting zlog sogs nyin ltar dang*/ gtor rgyag nyin khang thog nas gser skyems dang*/ sgrub khang nas bskang ba phul thon nas/ mdos kyi sgo dbye slob dpon gyis mda' dar thogs la/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ 'khor 'das rab 'byams sogs bton la/ 'bebs bzhi brdung*/ zhal chems las 'gyed/ hūm̐ 'bod do bskul lo sogs/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ bskul lo 'bod do sogs gzhung ltar/ ser sbrengs skabs mdos chen gyi rjes zlog gtor gnyis btegs dgos/ 'bul sar slebs nas 'gugs gzhug gsum dang*/ gser skyems mchod/ spro na bzhes 'bod/ de nas/ 'bebs sum brdung*/ hūm̐ sngon byung srid pa'i sogs zor rnams rbad sngags dang bcas so sor 'phang la/ 'bebs sum brdung gis len/ hūm̐ ma hā kā la mthu bo che'i mthar rbad sngags bton bzhin rol mo 'bebs chen bcas mdos chen dang mgon po'i zlog gtor rgyab/ de nas rdo rje dregs 'joms sogs gong gsal zin bris ltar byas pas khyab par yod/ de ltar gsang sngags kyi zab chos 'di nyid bka' gnyan pa byin che ba'i/ de yang thog mar dbang dang lung gis rgyud smin cing grol bar bya ba dang*/ de nas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i sgo nas bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi don du bya ba las/ gar thod thod du bon gyer lta bu mi rung zhing*/ de yang rnal 'byor pa bskyed rdzogs ldan pa rab/

tha na'ang 'don pa lhag chad med par mi tshig gis bar ma chad pa tsam dgos rgyu las/ gang byung byas pas/ gter srung gi bka' chad 'khu ldog 'byung nges pas rang bzos ma bslad pa gal che zhing*/ gter chen nyid kyis chos bdag so sor zin bris mi 'dra bar gnang ba'i mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang 'dir ni bla ma kun mkhyen la gnang ba'i bzhed pa ji bzhin/ rje chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi lugs srol gtsor bton pa'i bca' bkod 'don bsgrigs bcas rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje dang rol pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun rnams dang yang go bstun nas/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bltas chog zin thor bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig// / ༈ zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul tshogs las yon tan kun 'byung gi 'don 'grigs rab gsal mthong ba myur rtogs bzhugs so// bsam 'das brjod bral pha rol phyin// mkha' 'dra'i rang gzugs rnam rol ma// bde chen gar mkhan rgyal ba'i yum// lab kyi sgron mas kun tu skyongs// de ltar mchod par brjod pa sngon du song nas/ de yang zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul 'di nyan thos rang rgyal sogs theg pa 'og ma rnams kyis gang zag bdag med kyi don phyogs mtshon tsam rtogs shing*/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i 'khor lo sher phyin gyi mdo rnams nas chos dang gang zag gnyis ka'i bdag 'dzin bzlog nas zab mo stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i don ston cing byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs la 'khrungs shing*/ tha ma nges don gtan la 'bebs pa'i mdo sde rnams las bder gshegs snying po gzhom gzhig bri gang dang bral ba'i ye shes snying po mngon sum du bstan pa'i 'phags bzhi skyed byed yum chen mo'i dgongs don/ de bzhin gsar rnying rgyud sde rnams nas kyang gdod ma'i zung 'jug bde ba chen po sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid mngon du byed pa'i don dang*/ de'i thabs gsang spyod rig spyod sogs thabs shes lam gyi cha thams cad kyang rdzogs par bstan pa'i zab mo'i don 'di nyid nyams su bstar ba'i rnal 'byor bdag gis gang la rten 'cha' ba'i gnas rab dur khrod/

'bring bas mtha'/ tha ma dgon gnas so// mi bya'i gnas kyang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang grong khyer gyi dbus su gsungs kyang*/ mdor na bdag tu 'os pa dang*/ gnyan sar 'os pa de yin no// dus ni yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dus bzang dang*/ nyin mo ring dus nyin/ mtshan mo ring dus mtshan mo/ nya dang nyi zla'i lto ba ma gtogs lnga bdun dgu gsum lha 'dre'i las dus rnams la'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar nges par byas nas/ skabs su babs pa 'don sgrig bshams bkod kyi rim pa ni/ stegs kyi khar zhing ngam stag lpags kyi steng*/ gong gtor bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi gtor ma lnga tshom mam/ phreng tshar gang rung bkod pa'i mdun du/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma zhig kyang bshams/ nang mchod kyi ka pā la dang*/ nyer spyod mchod pa g.yon nas 'go brtsam phreng tshar dang gzhan yang tshogs kyi yo byad gang 'byor/ skong gtor rgyas bsdus gang rung skabs bstun/ mkha' 'gro gtor 'bul lnga tshom can sogs mkho ba'i yo byad 'du byas la/ nang mchod byin brlab/ oṃ āḥbighān gyis bsangs la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum bar dang*/ mchod rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi bran cing*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du sogs kyis mchod pa byin brlab/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ ḍā dril bya/ bdag cag rnams la sogs nas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// bar/ byang chub sems kyi kun slong bya ba sngon gyi phyag bzhes ltar dang*/ de nas mgron bsdu'i dmigs pa bcas/ bdag cag rnams sogs nas/ don du 'dus shing brjod la rkang gling kha brdab lan gsum/ de nas lan gsum 'bud pa'i thog mar ring ba/ bar ba de las thung tsam skad 'gyur gcig dang ldan pa/ tha ma de las yang thung ba skad 'gyur gsum dang ldan par bya/

de nas phaṭa ring gsum brjod/ skyabs yul dmigs pa bcas skyabs 'gro bdun nam nyer gcig skabs dang bstun/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems bskyed bcas bton/ skyabs yul mi dmigs pa'am rang la bstim/ slar tshogs zhing mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs nas/ sa ma dzaḥ'i mthar ḍā dril khrob bkrol/ rdor dril thogs la/ ma lus sems can nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod bar dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod sogs dang*/ ga te'i sngags ci nus bzlas la/ byin rlabs bsdu dmigs mthar/ phaṭa brjod bzhin pas bdud rtsi chu rgyun dmigs pa'i mthar/ mchod lha spros nas/ stong gsum rab 'byams sogs dang gtong len dmigs pa sbyar/ rim skyes 'pho ba byas la/ maṇ+ḍal/ lpags pa gser gyi sa gzhi mthar/ phaṭa/ rjod bzhin dkar tshogs lam khyer skor gsum zhes thod sgyed ma'i dmigs pa bya/ 'phen len dmar 'gyed skor gsum/ rkang gling*/ gnas gnyan sa sogs dang*/ de nas/ gnas chos dbyings sogs gsol 'debs rnams rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ bdud rtsi bum 'gyed ma'i dmigs pa bya/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal sogs nas pha brgyud bstod pa'i mthar thod zhal ma'i dmigs pa bya/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul sogs/ thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ mthar 'dod yon lnga mchod dmigs pa bya/ kye ma mi min ye shes sogs nas/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub stsol// mthar bstab pa g.yang gzhi ma bya/ kye ma mi min ye shes sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod mthar bstab pa mchog phur ma bya/ de rnams kyis ma rgyud gsol 'debs rdzogs/ ma nam mkha' lta bu'i yum chen sogs sras bstod mthar/ phaṭa kha shas brjod/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul sogs/ skal ldan rnams la bcud du phob bar/ mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul 'di mthar ḍā dril khrob bkrol bcas phaṭa brjod/ de nas tshogs bdud rtsis bran la/ 'bru gsum dang*/ ga te'i sngags bcas so sor lan gsum bton nas byin gyis brlabs la/

bka' brgyud tshogs las/ gnas chos dbyings rnam dag gi gzhal yas sogs nas/ dbyings su drong bar dang*/ ma rgyud tshogs las/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul sogs mthar/ phaṭa dang*/ ḍā dril khrob bkrol bya'o// de nas sbyin bdag sogs lus sbyin sogs dmigs bsal dgos pa can yod tshe/ rang mdun gzhogs phab nyal te tshogs rdzas bshams la bdud rtsi bran/ bsre ba gsum sogs lus tshogs kyi dmigs pa byas la/ oṃ ma cig ma la sogs dang*/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen bton nas bar mtshams rnams su phaṭa brjod/ 'di skabs spro na gdon tshogs dgu ma'i bstab pa sbyar nas/ stong gsum gzhi bdag man chad nas/ sogs/ phyin bskyur la/ slar bsre 'pho'i dmigs pa byas nas/ dbang sdud ni/ skad cig gis bdag nyid dur khrod kyi bdag mo khros ma sogs nas dmar 'gyed dmigs pa rgyas par byas/ gdon tshogs dgu ma'i bstab pa rnams so so'i mtshams/ phaṭa brjod/ ḍā dril bkrol/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par shog /bar dang*/ mthar/ phaṭa brjod/ bsdu na/ stong gsum gzhi bdag sogs nas/ lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol/ bar dang*/ de nas tshogs phud gtor ma phul la/ phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong sogs/ gtor bsngo bton mthar/ phaṭa brjod/ ḍā dril bya/ tshogs brgya lta bu'i grangs gsog skabs/ sbyin pa rgya chen dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'= bdag gis lus mchod sbyin sogs dang*/ gcod yul nyams su len sogs dang*/ khyab par shog bar/ phaṭa brjod/ slar yang mchod pa rnams kha gso/ bdud rtsi bran/ karma ḍā ki ni sogs dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mgron bsdu ba sogs sngar ltar la/ stong gsum rab 'byams ma dang*/ pags pa gser gyi sa gzhi gnyis 'khrigs chags su btang*/ gsol 'debs/ gnas chos dbyings rnam dag dang*/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan gnyis 'don res bya/ yum chen sher phyin dang*/ ma rgyud thabs kyi brgyud pa gnyis 'don res tshogs las skabs 'gres bskang bsdu ba dang*/

tshar rjes ma'i skabs spro na gdon tshogs dgu ma'i bstab pa bya ba gong du smos ltar dang*/ gzhan rnams dkyus bzhin/ bskang ba lan rjes ma bton cing*/ gtor ma bdud rtsis bran la/ 'og min chos dbyings sogs kyi skong ba tshang ma dang*/ bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bar bton mthar/ phaṭa dang ḍā dril bya/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsdu zhing*/ bdud rtsi bran/ dmigs pa dang bcas phyogs bzhi 'jigs rung*/ sogs kyis lhag ma bsngos mthar/ phaṭa dang ḍā dril/ de nas mkha' 'gro gtor 'bul/ 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs dang*/ kye ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro sogs mthar/ phaṭa dang*/

ḍā dril/ de nas mchod pa kha gso/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni sogs nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da bar dang*/ nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul zhing*/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma sogs dang*/ smra bsam brjod med sogs kyis bstod/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// sogs 'gre/ yi dam lha tshogs= dpa' po mkha' 'gro= chos skyong srung ma= de nas/ bde ba legs pa ji snyed pa// sogs kyi bshags pa'i mthar/ ḍā dril dang bcas yig brgya tshar gsum/ sbyin pa rgya chen sogs/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod sogs/ bdag gis lus mchod sbyin sogs dang*/ gcod yul nyams su len sogs nas/ khyab par shog bar/ phaṭa/ brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba/ grol nyin lta bur/ byin 'bebs dmigs pa dang bcas/ ḍā dril 'khrol zhing*/ phaṭa brjod bzhin/ ma yum chen thugs las sprul sogs mthar yang*/ ḍā dril bkrol zhing*/ phaṭa brjod skyabs yul bsdu zin pa dang*/ zhi zlum dmigs pa bcas tshe gzungs bzla zhing*/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas sogs/ shis pa brjod/ de nas rang gzhan thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i ngang nas mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ gcod yul phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur nas/ sogs brjod/ chos dbyings lhun gyis grub pa sogs/ bkra shis me tog gis char bsnyil bar bya'o// yang dmigs bsal sbyin bdag gal chen la byin rlabs dbang bskur byed par spro na/ grol nyin lta bur stabs bde bas/ gong gi mkha' 'gro byin 'bebs kyi sngon der/ slob ma rnams la dang po chab btang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul nas gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang mos 'don shes na dpon slob mnyam du gyer/ de nas mkha' 'gro byin 'bebs dmigs pa dang bcas/ ma yum chen thugs las sogs ting nge 'dzin gyis byin rlabs 'pho dbang gis smin par byas nas gzhan rnams gzhung gong smos ltar gyi bkra shis sogs mtha' rgyas mdzad pas grub/

gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun bzhin/ si tu pas spel ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba mad+ga lam̐/// / ༈ gu ru rin po che'i gsol 'debs tshig bdun mar grags pa'i zin tho nyung ngu lags/ rgyal kun ngo bo bla ma mchog /pad+ma 'byung la gus btud nas// gang la gsol ba 'debs pa yi// man ngag rnam par gsal byed bri// de yang rang yi dam gang rung du gsal ba'i spyi bor ram snying ga'i dbus su/ gu ru rin po che mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang dbang yab yum gsal btab/ de nyid rtsa gsum kun kyi bdag nyid du shes pa la/ 'khor mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs kyis bskor ba 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong na bzhugs par bsam la gsol ba 'di ltar du gdab ste/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: zhes brjod cing don ni go bde la 'di ni spyir gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig dang*/ bye brag /o rgyan yul gyi zhes pa nas/ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol bar rdo rje phag mos gsungs par grags pa'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs te tshig rkang bdun yod pas de ltar grags la/ de nas gu ru'i thugs srog snying po/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni saḥr tsa hri yaḥtsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags/ byin 'bebs sngags/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga yab yum gyi sngags dang*/ gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la:

lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs: ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs: yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi bskur bar byin gyis rlobs: rgyud bzhi dag par byin gyis rlobs: lam bzhi 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs: zhes pa rnams kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma gu ru yab yum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba btab pas/ gu ru'i sku'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer dkar po skar mda' chad pa ltar byung ste bdag gi smin mtshams su thim/ bum dbang thob par bsam/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i gnas las 'od zer dmar po mar me'i rtse mo ltar rgyang gis byon rang gi mgrin par thim/ gsang dbang thob par bsam/ gu ru'i thugs las 'od zer sngon po spos reng gi dud pa ltar 'phros rang gi snying khar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ gu ru'i gnas lnga las 'od zer 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rnam par byon te rang gi gnas lngar thim pas/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam pa ste/ dbang bzhi sogs ni bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang ste dbang bzhi rnams thob pas rim bzhin gyis/ rgyud bzhi/ rtsa dang*/ rlung dang*/ thig le dang*/ byang chub sems kyi rgyud dag ste/ lus rtsa khams rnam par dag pa lhar sbyangs/ ngag rlung dbyings su grol ba ste sngags su dag /kun rdzob kyi thig le ye shes dwangs ma'i thig ler dag /tha mal gyi shes rgyud rang bzhin klong yangs su grol ba bde chen byang chub sems su dag ste/ rim pa bzhin lam bzhi yang 'byongs te/ bskyed rim gyi lam/ rdzogs rim/ phyag rgya'i lam/ rdzogs chen lam ste bzhi/ yang tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam bzhi zhes pas lam bzhi yang yod mod kyi 'di rang gi skabs don ni gong du smos pa de kha ste/ rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung las kyang*/ rtsa rlung thig le byang sems rgyud smin/ bskyed rdzogs phyag rgya rdzogs chen lam 'byongs/

zhes gsungs pa dang mthun pa'i phyir ro// sku bzhi ni spyir grags ltar/ chos longs sprul sku ngo bo nyid sku'o// de ltar dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa dang bstun/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dhe wa dhā ki ni kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ zhes brjod/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi yang yang blang zhing gsol ba gdab/ mthar gu ru rin po che mkha' 'gro tshogs bcas rang la thim ste rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du mnyam par bzhag go// 'dir smras pa/ rang cag bod yul skye 'gro rnams kyis// bla ma'i skal pa pad+ma 'byung gnas// bka' drin mnyam med gu ru rje de// yin par shes nas gsol ba 'debs dgos// grwa pa'i gzugs dang sgrub gzugs byas nas// chos kyi snying po bla ma ma dran// dam chos nyams len rgyud la med par*// kha bshad byed pa bdag 'dra'i chos pa// ri klung med par khengs te 'dug go /rtsa ba'i bla ma gu ru rje de// dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs che bas// gsol 'debs badz+ra gu ru drongs shig /a ho sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas// a ti klong yangs ngang du bsnyen na// a don chos sku'i ngo bo pad+mas// e dbyings chen por bslu ba med gsungs// zhes gu ru rin po che'i gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zin bris nyung du 'di'ang*/ dbu mdzad rnam rgyal gyi 'dod ngor rdo rje'i snying pos tsā ri'i gnas su thun mtshams zhig tu bris pa dge/ 'di nyid bka' 'bum gras su 'jog mdzad 'dug cing lung yang bzhugs 'dug pa ltar ro// ༈ klong gsal gter byon ye shes rab 'bar gyi bca' thabs 'don 'grigs gsar bkod don gsal bzhugs// swa sti/ rtsa gsum bdag nyid pad+ma drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo// bka'i gnang ba stsal du gsol// 'di nyid bca' thabs 'don 'grigs sngar gyi rnying lugs dang*/
