rje gong ma'i zhal rgyun lugs dang*/ rig 'dzin h+ya gṝ was bsgral las dang*/ zor 'phen gsar bkod de rnams kun 'dus nor bu lugs dbon sprul de nyid kyi bzhed srol sor bzhag la/ gter chen mchog nas chos bdag a lo kun mkhyen la gdams pa'i bskyed rim gyi zab gnad gtsor bton/ o rgyan rdo rje'i gsung rnams dpang du byas nas bkod pa la/ de'ang*/ thog mar 'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub sngon du them pa'i gang zag gis/ zla ba gang rung gi dmar phyogs tshes gnyis la brtsams te dben pa'i gnas su rtsa gsum gyi rten dang*/ 'di nyid kyi sku bris 'bur gang 'byor bshams pa'i drung*/ stegs bang rim gsum gyi dang po la/ g.yas ngos su bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gtor ma lnga tshom mthong brgyud bzhin dang*/ dbus su dkyil thang ngam/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga'i steng*/ mañdzi'i khar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i steng du dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ g.yon ngos su bsnyen phur byin can dang*/ tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar bkod/ mdun ngos nyer spyod mchod pa cha tshang bshams pa brje mi dgos/ de 'og g.yas nas brtsam sngags srung mar gtor gdan gru gsum la zhing lpags steng*/ snying gzugs can spyi 'gro/ rnam sras gtor gdan zlum po la/ mkhar thabs kha bad can steng du nor bu sum tshom khar nor bu 'bar ba/ mtha' 'khor gtor 'brang rgyas brgyad kyis bskor/ bsnyen sgrub zin la gsal ba'i/ skong gtor bang rim bzhi'i steng*/ dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ bang rim rnams su/ nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga/ bkra shis rdzas rtags/ rgyal srid/ khyung 'brug sogs 'phur lding gi rigs dang*/ stag seng sogs gcan gzan rigs/ glang bse ru sogs ri dwags g.yung dwags rigs rnams spar btab pas bskor la/ dar tshon dang*/ stag gzig ras mo/ rin chen phye ma/ sman sna/ spos sna/ 'bru sna/ dam rdzas sogs phyur bur spungs la bkod/ khyab 'jug dmar gtor g.yas dkyus la/

'khor gtor de 'dra brgyad kyis bskor/ dam can gtor gdan gru bzhi'i khar/ mkhar thabs bad can steng*/ bshos bu zur gsum/ 'khor gtor de 'dra ba bzhi bad dang mnyam pa/ mdun du ra mgo /g.yas lcags tel/ g.yon sman leb/ 'brang rgyas/ gsang phyi/ ting lo sogs kyis bskor/ rgyal po la mkhar thabs bad can steng*/ bshos bu zur gsum lnga tshom/ de rnams la smug rtsi dang dkar thig dmar rgyan gang 'os bya/ mdun ngos su chos sman btab pa'i bdud rtsi dang*/ sman gtor/ rak+ta nyer spyod mchod pa rnams phreng tshar bshams/ de 'og tu las dkyil zhing ngam stag lpags steng lcags snod du sa'i zhal bar ro sol byug la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu bri/ dbus dang rtsibs bcu'i lte bar brub khung re brkos la/ ling khrus sngon du zin pa'i shog ling gsum dgos par gcig dbus kyi brub khung du gtor chen zhabs su bcug /gnyis zur du hom khung nang bzhag nas slar bsgral las skabs dmigs rten byed/ rtsibs bcu la zan ling re bcug /de steng drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum brjid ldan/ spro na gtor zhal rngams pa bya/ rtse mor bya khyung gi gzugs sam tsakli la dar dmar gdugs/ rtsibs bcur khro bcu'i dmar gtor rnams gtso bo'i sum cha dang mnyam pa bar mtshams rnams su khrag gi kyu gu kha phyir bstan bkod/ gtso gtor la dbu rtsang gsum/ g.yas g.yon la spyan rtsang gsum re ste drug /'khor gtor rnams la gsum re/ mtshe dang yungs kar nag /zan ling ro ltebs dang*/ sha dang*/ me sgron gnyis kyang gtor chen rgyab ngos 'dzugs/ mtha' mar rtsang phur dmar nag dgu bcu srin mo 'gros su btsugs/ ba su ta dang sngo dmar skud pas 'tshubs ma ris su dkris/ de'i g.yas su me dbal zlog gtor zur gsum la gtso gtor las dma' tsam/ logs gsum la pra mo he gsum gsum la dmar gtor de las chung tsam gsum/ g.yon ngos su sngags srung zlog gtor rtsa gsum pa/

de dpal gtor las dma' tsam/ de mthar dbang mo nyer brgyad la khrag kong nyer brgyad kyis bskor/ de gnyis la'ang rtsang thung gsum re/ mtshe yungs/ lid+ga nyis bstab/ sha dang*/ me sgron re 'dzugs/ mtha' mar rtsang nyer brgyad kyis bskor la/ sngo dmar skud dkris bya/ gnyis kar gtor gdugs dmar smug re/ las dkyil gyi nye logs gang bder lcags sam zangs snod du/ sa'i thun kong zur gsum lnga'i nang rtsang thur gsum re dang*/ mda' gzhu mtshon tsam/ rak+ta/ rdo/ dmar gtor/ thod zor rnams kyis mtshan pa bkod/ mdun ngos su khrag gi mchod yon/ dbang po'i me tog /gu gul sogs bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ dug chu'i dri chab/ sha chen gyi drag bshos/ thod rnga rkang gling sogs ci ltar 'os pa bshams/ nyin bzhin gyi sngon 'gro dkar gtor la 'bras chan dang zan ril gyis bskor ba/ dmar gtor/ glud gzugs spyi 'gro/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ zhi bshos dang*/ drag bshos/ bskul chen skabs 'bul rgyu'i gnam phud/ sman raka gtor gsum snod gcig nang bzhag pa/ dmod zlog gi dmar gtor dang*/ zlog pa tshar grangs lnga'am gang 'don kyang tshar rer gtor chung bdun re 'bul dgos par de lugs kyi 'ga' zhig dang*/ me dbal/ khyung*/ khro bcu/ sngags srung*/ dam can/ bskul rnga yab ma dang*/ bka' srung lnga/ chad tho/ brtan ma de rnams la dmar gtor bcu gsum rgyan rtse 'bug re/ drag po'i rigs la lcags theb gru gsum 'dzoms gal che/ dam rdzas dang 'bru sna gang 'os/ 'don bya dang bstun pa'i gtor ma rnams sngon du bshams bkod zin par byed/ hom khung du shog ling gnyis yod rgyu'i gcig de grol nyin zhal bstab skabs gtub nas/ zan ling dang mnyam phul dgos/ gcig shos slar zor len bzhag rgyu dang*/ nyin bzhin zan ling re dang*/ slar mkho khyad sgo dbye dang*/ lam sel la dkar gtor gnyis dang*/ bskul gyi dmar gtor brgyad rnams la rtsang gsum re btsugs pa snga rjes gang bder bca'/

las 'phur dang rdor dril g.yab dar/ dbye rdzas/ bya rog dang 'ug sgro/ thun rdzas mtshe dang nyungs kar nag /'bru sna/ dam rdzas/ chang phud/ rak+ta/ spos phor/ chu gtsang*/ chab bum rnams 'du byas la/ stegs gang bder zur du ma mgon dang*/ lha sman ma'i rten bshams pa'i drung du/ de dag gi rgyun dang rten gyi gtor ma gang dgos mthong ba brgyud bzhin legs par tshar du dngar ba dang*/ 'bul gtor de rigs rnams kyang*/ dus gcig bca' ba gang bde'i tshogs 'don mi chag pa'i khyad par dang*/ rim bzhin gtor ma rnams bzang du btang dgos shing*/ snod stong pa che chung gang yang nye skor mi bzhag pa gnad/ slob dpon mdun ḍā dril/ 'thor nas/ nyungs kar/ gzhan yang rol chas/ rnga dung*/ rkang gling sogs nyer spyad mtha' dag tshang bar byas la/ mchod rdzas rnams spos rum dang*/ chu gtsang bran/ ༈ nyin dang por/ tshig bdun ma dang*/ bsam pa lhun grub/ 'og min bde chen sogs brgyud 'debs/ mdun gyi nam mkha' nas/ skyabs 'gro ye shes rtse mo gsum/ sems bskyed bdag dang mtha' yas gsum/ ma gyur 'gro ba dang*/ shes rab dgyes rol tshar re nas/ sar drongs shog: bar dang bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni las kyi sogs/ dpal du shar bar dang*/ phyi gtor swa bhā nas/ rin po che'i snod sogs/ lhun grub mdzod: bar/ gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis dang*/ gser skyems phul/ ye shes bla med nas/ hūm̐: bar de'i glud gtor btang*/ bdag nyid las kyi bgegs bskrad dang*/ srung 'khor nas gzhung bzhin/ byin 'bebs bsdus pa de yis 'thus/ bhan+dha stong gsum sogs byin rlabs nas/ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: bar/ rdor sems dang*/ khro bcu bzhag /thugs kar gtsug tor sogs nas lha bskyed/ rdo rje pad nyi dang*/ hūm̐ yig dmar nag sbrel 'don gyis/ spyan 'dren sogs sngon bskal ma dang*/ bzhugs gsol/ phyi nang gsang mchod/ bstod pa nas/ dkyil 'khor lha la bshags bar/

dzab bskul tshig bdun ma dang*/ zhi bsnyen sham can sgrig 'don gsum dang*/ zhi bsnyen brgya brgyad snang stong dbang drag sogs/ drag bsnyen gong 'og gnyis pa lnga tsam/ yang drag bsnyen bdun/ 'khor sngags bdun/ kha skong yig brgya gsum sogs dang*/ dzab bstod/ de nas sngags srung sogs bka' srung lnga yi las byang bton la/ so so'i bskul gyi 'og bar dang*/ tshogs rdo rje lta bu'i sogs nas/ dang po sman gtor dang*/ bar pa bskang gtor nang 'bul/ skong bshags dri med mtha' bral btang*/ de nas 'byor tshogs 'dod yon sogs bshags pa yig brgya bcas/ tha ma bsgral mchod skabs/ las rdor gyis g.yab dar/ rdor dril bcas/ bden stobs gsang 'dus le brgyad bzhin kha bsgyur gyis tshar gcig /zhal bstab zlog gtor che chung gsum dang*/ bka' srung gtor 'bul drug nang sogs la phul/ gtsang lhag zhig kyang bzhag /las rdor gyis rdo rje slob dpon sogs dang*/ 'dus pa rnams kyis/ gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sogs gyer/ tshogs la rol/ zhabs brtan 'don/ mang lhag steng gtsang lhag bkod/ sman rag gis bran/ dang po phud sogs kyis lhag ma btang*/ zlog bskul rnga yab ma dang*/ sngags srung sogs kyi bskul rnams bton la so sor gtor 'bul dang*/ chad brtan nas bkra shis sogs rjes chog gzhung ltar gyis 'grub/ de nas mgon po'i rgyun gtor mtshal ma dang*/ bkra shis tshe ring ma sbrags 'don sngar rgyun ji ltar bya'o// ༈ nyin bzhin 'don lugs ni/ gong du smos pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i/ gzhung gi byin 'bebs bsdus pa de rgyun par dang*/ yul gyi ming ni dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba gnyis 'don res sman raka gtor gsum byin rlabs nas badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐ḥbar/ skabs 'dir snga ma'i 'don zin rnams su ma gsal yang*/ 'don sgom la don dang mthun pa'i khyad par/ gter gzhung theg pa'i sgo 'byed las/ 'gro rnams sgrol phyir sogs nas/ rang nyid rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa'i thugs kar sngags phreng gsal gdab la/

he ru ka'i yig brgya bdun bzla/ rang snang rdo rje sogs nas/ rang nyid he ru ka sogs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gsol 'debs dbang blang mthar/ khro bcu'i srung zlog las/ bla ma rgyu'i he ru kar thim sogs nas/ oṃ gha gha sogs nang*/ oṃ badz+ra mud kā ra sbrel ma lan gsum/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi thugs kar sogs dang hūm̐ bcu brgya brgyad bzla/ na maḥs man+ta bdun sogs/ khro bcu rang 'dra sogs nas/ stong par bsgom la/ slar yang na ma sa man+ta la/ oṃ ha ra ha ra btags pa gsum/ de nas las gzhung gi/ thugs kar gtsug tor sogs nas/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ mchod bstod nas/ lha la bshags: bar dang*/ gzhung las bsnyen pa'i man ngag la/ zhi bar bsnyen/ drag por sgrub/ las la sbyar ces/ dang po ni/ zhi ba'i dzab bskul sngon bskal ma tshar gcig /badz+ra gu ru sham can gsum/ zhi bsnyen sum brgya brgyad/ gnyis pa drag po'i dzab bskul ye shes bcud chen las/ snang stong dbang drag sogs artsig gong 'og gnyis brgya brgyad re bzla'o// dngos grub bde ba che'o: gsum pa las la sbyar ba/ artsig nyer gcig /go cha'i lha lnga'i sngags/ ya man+ta ka nyer gcig sogs/ yig brgya/ ā li kā li/ ye dhar sbrel ma gsum re/ dzab bstod ye shes lha tshogs sogs/ de nas gtor bzlog gi mdun bskyed la bskyed rdzogs chung ngu'i/ phyi nang snod bcud sogs nas/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod bar dang*/ dzab bskul rigs sngags bcud bsdus las/ rang nyid drag por gsal sogs/ artsig gong 'og gnyis brgya brgyad re/ artsig la me dbal dang*/ sde brgyad sngags shams can nyer gcig /mngon du gyur pa'o: bar/ kha skong dang dzab bstod bya/ sngags srung*/ rnam sras/ khyab 'jug /dam can/ rgyal po rnams kyi las byang so so'i bskul pa'i 'go bar bton/ de nas bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i tshogs/ rdo rje lta bu nas dang po sman gtor dang*/ bar pa bskang gtor la 'bul/

bskang gtor bran la/ bde chen zhing gi sogs kyi bskang bshags btang*/ ma bskang tshan gnyis 'don res bya/ 'byor tshogs 'dod yon sogs kyi bshags mthar yig brgya/ tha ma bsgral mchod dang*/ bden stobs mthong brgyud bzhin gcig /bsgral zhing bstab pa bzlog gtor che gsum dang*/ bka' srung bskul gtor drug rnams la phul/ gtsang lhag kyang spros la bzhag /bstod chen/ nub phyogs bde chen sogs dang*/ gnam phud bran la/ bskul chen nub phyogs dgongs shig bla ma rig 'dzin sogs bton mthar sman raka gtor gsum nam mkhar mchod/ de nas las sbyor mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i bsgral las nus ldan rdo rjes bsgrigs pa'i/ mkhyen gsol drag po ye shes rab 'bar sogs bton la/ slob dpon mdun bsgral las kyi chas rnams bkod/ e maṇ+ḍal nas/ lid+ga khrag chang gis bran la/ bden stobs mthar artsig dang*/ dgra bgegs a kar+ṣa ya sogs 'gugs gzhug lan gsum/ lha dbye/ thun brab/ phur gdab nas/ zhal bstab zlog gtor gtso 'khor rnams su phul la khā hi bar/ de nas las gzhung gi drang srong dmod zlog /bcom ldan dpal chen sogs nas/ 'gal rkyen mtha' dag bzlog bar/ bar mtshams gsum por drang srong lha yi sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig de sbyar zhing*/ artsig sham bur drag po khros pa gsang rgyud las byung ba'i drang srong dmod sngags re sbyar/ mthar gtor ma zlog gtor nang phul/ de nas gtor zlog mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i/ bcom ldan dpal chen sogs kyi bar mtshams bdun so sor/ artsig dang sngags thun bdun pa zhes/ traka rak+ṣa sngags tshan gsum dang*/ artsig sham bur drag sngags chen mo bdud pra marta sogs dang*/ rgyal 'gong 'dul sngags dang*/ artsig la byad bzlog drang srong dmod sngags btags pa/ yang artsig la/ yang zlog trig khrom sbyar ba de rnams thal rdeb dang bcas/ zlog pa tshar lnga'am gang 'os bton la/ tshar rer gtor chung bdun re zlog gtor nang 'bul/

de nas me dbal gyi zlog pa'i phrin las/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig sogs/ zlog tshan lnga la drang srong lha yi dmod pa sogs tshig rkang bcu bzhi de sbyar nas/ artsig la sde brgyad las sngags sbyar/ mthar gtor ma me dbal zlog gtor nang phul/ khyung zlog /oṃ ma hā shuṇ+ya ta sogs nas/ bzlog cig sgrol bar dang*/ khro bcu'i zlog pa/ che mchog pad+ma nas/ bh+yo bzlog bar/ 'di snga rjes gnyis gtor ma zlog gtor nang phul/ ral gcig bka' zlog /ye shes kun gyi nas/ phaṭa phaṭaḥbar/ gtor ma sngags srung zlog gtor la phul/ rdor legs kyi zlog pa/ dbang drag pad+ma'i bka' nas/ rbad:bar gtor ma phyi rol 'bul/ mi kha'i zlog pa/ bdag nyid pad+ma drag po nas/ sngags dang zlog pa lan gsum mthar/ rig sngags bden pa'i dmod pa yi sogs nas/ rgyas bar mdzod bar brjod la/ chos bdag kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i tshogs zhu lan gnyis de brjod la rol/ zhabs brtan dang*/ lhag ma bsdu bkod/ sman raka bran la/ dang po phud kyi sogs lhag gtor btang*/ bshal chu brtan ma'i gtor mar blug /zlog bskul rnga yab ma dang*/ sngags srung ma sogs kyi bskul gtor rnams so sor phul/ chad tho dang*/ brtan ma phul/ gtor bro'i mthar/ gtor gzhong rnams kha gyen pas sogs brjod/ me tog 'thor/ tshe 'gugs/ rang snang shes rig sogs mda' dar g.yab/ badz+ra gu ru tshe sham can dang*/ tshe bh+rūm̐ sogs sgrol ma nyer gcig bzla'o// dngos grub len pa/ bkra shis dang*/ bsdu rim mthar/ lha'i skur ldang nas/ bsngo smon bya/ pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs brjod/ de nas ma mgon rgyun gtor dang*/ lha sman tshe ring ma'i gtor chog sgrag 'don rnams sngar lugs ji bzhin par nyams med bya'o// ༈ gtor rgyag skabs/ zor las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhin dgos rgyur kyang*/ h+ya gṛ was gsar bsgrigs de dbang gi rdo rje nas gsungs par bzhed pas/

gtor rgyag phyogs thebs dang chu tshod bstun dgos bzhin/ las gzhung nyin ltar la/ zlog pa tshar grangs sogs gang 'os kyis/ tshogs rol dang*/ lhag ma btang ba'i rjes su/ khang thog nas/ sgo dbye'i dkar gtor dang*/ gser skyems kyi chas thog sa la/ a kā ro gsum gyis byin brlabs/ bhūm̐ las rin chen bar mtshams gsum la skyems dang*/ mthar dkar gtor mchod/ rdul du rlogs bar/ nang du 'ong la/ slob dpon gyis sgo rtsang bzhi len la/ gtor chen gsum kha phyir bstan la cung zad dpag /me dbal zlog pa'i mtha'i/ nga ni dbang drag pad+ma'i sogs nas/ bstan du gsol bar/ gser skyems bshams la/ tha tshig bsgrag pa/ hrīḥ bdag nyid gang shar rang grol sogs nas/ skyems phud 'dzin bzhin mthar las rdor gyis nam mkhar mchod/ a mṛ ta na ra kan: bar/ de nas tshogs pa rnams bzhengs/ lam sel dkar gtor bran/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭata sogs kyis bsang*/ thod pa'i snod sogs nas/ shar la sogs pa bton nas phul/ dar nag phyar/ ser sbrengs ji bzhin chas pa'am/ sgrub khang nas gtor ma rdeg pa ci ltar byas kyang khog phyogs mtshungs dgos pas/ snga nas sa gzhir gru gsum nyis rim me ris bskor ba'i lte bar nṛ tri bri/ bud shing gru gsum pa brtsig pa'i rtse phyogs gang yin der bstan pa sogs tshag bkod grub par byas la/ gtor zor rnams gtegs nas bshams zin par/ zor lan shog ling yang btsug /dang po/ gser skyems thogs la/ snang zhing srid pa'i lha sogs/ bar mtshams gsum la mchod/ na moḥ rje btsun sogs 'gug gzhug lan gsum/ de nas dmar gtor brgyad bran/ zlog bskul rnga yab ma/ bka' srung gzhan lnga nyin ltar bton pa gtor ma rnams zor du 'phen/ sngon tshe 'das dus sogs/ chad tho'i gtor ma'ang brdeg /rab 'jigs rngam pa'i sogs nas mda' gzhu sogs kyi zor tshan lnga po rim bzhin rdeg /sngags srung ma'i bka' zlog /las kyi dbang mo sogs kyis me sgron sbar la/

sngags mthar gtor zor brdeg /me dbal gtor ma btegs la/ rngam brjid pad+ma drag po sogs me sgron sbar/ mthar rdul du rlogs: nas gtor zor rgyab/ lha tshogs rnams la dmod bcol ched du slob dpon gyis gser skyems thogs la/ bzhes 'bod/ ho dgongs su gsol lo sogs gzhung gi bar mtshams gsum der skyems mchod/ thams cad kyis sgrig 'don dang*/ me sgron gnyis sbar/ mthar artsig dang*/ bdud pra marta na'i sngags rnams brjod bzhin gtor chen brdeg la me hom du phul/ rol chen mā ra ya dang*/ g.yab dar g.yab/ dar nag brdeg /de nas sar bzhugs la/ log tri'i sngags nyer gcig dang*/ trig khrom ma nyer gcig mthar/ na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang sogs spyi 'gro bzhin thal rdeb dang bcas tshar gsum*/ rig sngags bden pa'i sogs nas/ rgyas par mdzod bar dang*/ bzhengs la/ brtan ma skyong*/ gtor gzhong rnams brtsegs mar sbub la nye logs su dar nag sbreng*/ slob dpon gyi rdo rjes mnan la/ na moḥ rje btsun sogs 'gugs gzhug gong bzhin la/ gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar pa'i 'og tu sogs kha bsgyur nas/ a a bar lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i sogs kyi mthar/ gtor gzhong rnams kha gyen pas rnal 'byor pa sogs brjod/ me tog 'thor/ mtshams gcod/ srung 'khor dang*/ khyung gi dmigs pas phyi lam bcad la yar byon/ sgrub khang sgo'am/ nang gang bde nas 'don zin sngar lugs kyi rgyal dbyangs/ dgra bgegs bdud bzhi thul sogs tshar gsum gyer la/ dkyil 'khor lha la me tog 'thor/ mthar zhi rol zla ba yar tshes bkrol/ gral la 'khod nas/ phye mar drangs/ zhabs brtan dang*/ shis brjod/ tshe 'gugs sogs bton la/ mgon tshe gnyis bcas nyin ltar gyis 'grub bo// ༈ skabs 'dir sbyin sreg bya na/ tshe 'gugs dang rjes chog gi sngon du bya/ phyi nyin 'drar stabs bde nges pas/ las byang nyin dang po bzhin btang nas/

tshogs las zhal bstab grub nas tshogs rol dang*/ zhabs brtan bton mtshams/ gnas de'am gzhan gang bder mchod rdzas bshams bkod sogs snga tshags zin par byas la/ dang po/ sna sel gser skyems bde bar gshegs so zhes pa btang/ zhi ba'i sreg blugs dngos gzhi gter gzhung rgyal sras kyis bsgrigs pa'i go gsal bar zhib dpyad gnang 'thus mthar chags su bton pa'i mthar/ las gzhung gi tshogs lhag dang*/ bskul rnams sogs rjes chog gzhung bzhin gyis khyab/ ༈ yang tshes nyer bdun dang nyer brgyad la ma mo'i khrag mdos dang*/ rgyal mdos dmigs bsal sbyar dgos tshe/ las gzhung gi/ dbyangs gdangs skor 'don pa zor yang tsam byas la/ tshogs lhag gi rjes thog der/ glud mdos yas ltag gi rdzas rnams gzhung gsal gang dgos snga nas bsgrigs bkod grub pa zin nas/ khrag mdos la/ na maḥ sa man+ta sogs lan gsum re dang*/ na mo sangs rgyas sogs tshar grangs gang 'os bsags la/ glud rdzas bran cing*/ bsngo bsgrangs byas la/ mthar gser skyems mnyam nyid chos sku sogs kyis mchod la/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs mthar mdos phyogs gtsang la ring bar rdzongs/ rol chen dang*/ mtshams gcod/ srung 'khor bsgom la/ de nas las byang gi/ bskul ba rnams phyin dkyus ltar bton/ ༈ rgyal mdos skabs kyang 'di mtshungs kyi/ chas rnams 'dzoms par byas la/ nyon cig nam mkha'i lha sogs nas/ spyan 'dren mtho nam mkha' sogs/ ra khri ra dza dzaḥbar/ rgya ching*/ kyai/ lha srin sogs/ tshe bsring du gsol bar/ de nas rgya ching smra ra sogs/ dngos gzhi'i glud bsngo le tshan rnams rdzogs nas/ bsring du gsol bar/ na maḥsarba/ sogs gsum re/ nyon cig nas/ hūm̐/ bar byang gcig de tshar grangs gsog mthar khrag mdos kyi gser skyems/ mnyam nyid chos sku'i sogs btang*/ rgyal mdos kyi nyon cig snang srid lha 'dre sogs dang*/ da ni mdos kyi lam bstan sogs/ mthar mdos phyogs gtsang la ring bar skyel/

rol chen dang*/ mtshams gcod/ srung 'khor/ de nas gong bzhin las gzhung gi bskul rnams bya'o// yang tshogs brgya spro na/ las byang nyin dang po sor bzhag gi/ tshogs rdo rje lta bu nas/ dang po mchod pa/ bar pa bskang bshags/ tha ma bsgral bstab bton la/ bden stobs bsdu na dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam sogs sh+tsau ka zhes 'thus par/ grangs 'dzin cing mthar tshogs rol dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba sogs gzhung ltar ro// ༈ dngos grub len chog /nangs snga bar 'tshogs la las byang btang nas skya rengs shar ba'am/ nyi shar rtse sprad kyis/ tshe bsnyen brgya brgyad bzla skabs/ tshe rdzas dngos grub tu rol/ dbang blang dngos kā ya sid+dhi sogs tshar bdun ring*/ dpal gtor dang*/ bsnyen phur/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum dag la dbang blang*/ de nas bkra shis dang*/ bsngo smon rjes bsdu grub thog /lha bsang gtang rag gi tshul du btang bar bya'o// ces bstan pa'i spyi rim don la sman pa'i ched du gzhung gi dgongs pa dang bstun nas/ si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis gsal bar bkod pa nongs pa bzod cing*/ dge bas bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro la dge ba'i dpal du shog /sarba dza ga tam/// / ༈ de'ang 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo dang rnam dbyer med pa'i rgyal dbang karma pa rim par byon pa rnams/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ o rgyan rin po ches bka' gter du ma nas yang yang bsngags brjod lung gis bstan par gsal zhing*/ khyad par rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho nyid bram ze pad+ma dkar po dang thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs pa'i myong grol ril nag gi phab rgyun gtso bo'ang de lta'i skye bdun dam rdzas 'di nyid len cing*/ gzhan yang ye shes rang snang gi cod pan mtshon phyir brda thabs kyi zhwa nag gser mdangs can mjal ba'i phan yon sogs kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i thabs tshul kho na ste/ ༈ skye bdun ril bus 'dul ba'i dus tshod ni deng gi skabs nyid du nges pa ste/

don tig 'gro ba kun grol gyi rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus su tshe thung nad mang zhing*// longs spyod dbul phongs nyon mongs rang gar spyod// chos la nyan bsam sgo gsum gus mkhan med// de dus tshegs chung don che'i dam rdzas 'di// 'gro don phyogs bcur skyo ngal med par spel// zhes pa la sogs phan yon brjod las 'das pa mchis so/// /gtor bsngo don bsdus par mos na/ rten yod na bkram/ de mdun gtor ma'am/ phye mar gang rung dang*/ skyems phud sogs ji ltar 'dzoms pa bshams la/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭo sogs/ kham̐ las brag steng sogs/ spyan 'dren sngags dang*/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni sogs/ nag po chen po gshegs su gsol bar/ bh+yo/ byang shar chos dbyings sogs nas/ mgyogs byed chen mo gshegs su gsol// bar dang*/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥsogs/ byang shar pho brang sogs/ rak+mo rak+ṣa sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi sogs nas bzhugs su gsol bar/ oṃ khrag gi rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ skabs gsum grong sogs/ gsang sngags nang gtor gzhung ltar nas/ kun 'grub mdzod bar/ daṃṣ+ṭota sogs stong par gyur pa'i sogs nas/ lha chen dpal 'bar sngags ring mthar/ dam can/ zhing skyong/ a phyi/ tshe ring ma/ brag btsan/ thang lha/ mkhar nag bcas kyi gtor sngags kyang sbyar la bton/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag spyi gtor yang bton/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ ho/ gang gi drin sogs/ pad la 'dud/ bya spyod rnal 'byor sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyi sogs/ sh+tsau ka gcig nag po yab yum sogs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sogs/ daṃṣ+ṭota sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i sogs sngags dang bcas/ bstan srung mthar thug sogs/ hūm̐/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i sogs skong ba sngags dang bcas/ bsnyen pa bya/ spro na thun gtor la/ na mo rat+na sogs 'gugs gzhug dang rbad sngags rnams gsum re/ hūm̐ gang zhig bla ma sogs mthar sngags dang*/ trig khrom ma zlog pa bcas rgyas bsdus ci ltar yang bya/

hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings sogs nas/ gnang du gsol bar/ bh+yoḥ ma gcig smin mtshams sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sogs/ pha la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ oṃ sa ma ya sogs nas/ tshe rabs sngon nas sogs/ zhi bar shog bar/ bdag ni mngon par sogs nas bkra shis/ mthar bsngo smon bcas ci 'grub/ de las bsdu na/ ma dag ma bton pas 'thus so// sarba mad+ga laṃ/// / ༈ ri khrus rgyas par spro na/ lha gang rung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ bum pa dang mchod pa bshams/ bum bskyed bzlas pa bum lha 'od zhu bcas zin nas/ lha khrus rten byin chen la dgos pas rgyas par rab gnas nang ltar/ bsdu na kun rig khrus chog ltar bya/ de nas khrus chu yang bum par blugs nas ri khrus ltar bya'o// khrus kyi khang pa sogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba: 'di ni khrus= 'di ni sbyin pa'i= phyin drug tshang ma dang sngags/ chu bo drug gis= sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid= sngags/ 'dod chags zhe sdang = dkon mchog gsum po dug mi mnga'= zhes bsdu ba dang*/ mthar sngags dang*/ 'byung bzhi dug gi sogs/ dmigs yul zhes kun la sbyar rgyu/ gang la dmigs pa de la zer gsungs pa red mod/ mthar sngags/ rgyas par gang la ser sna sogs/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag phyin bton/ sdig par ma gyur cig bar dang*/ mthar bkra shis lnga'am gsum tsam gdangs/ thad kar btang nas mtho dman mi byed/ mthar 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs= kun 'grub shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar sogs bton pas 'grub/ sarba mad+ga lam/// / ༈ oṃ swa sti/ tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor chen po'i bshams bkod 'don bsgrigs bzhugs so// na mo a mi ta bha ye/ dang po lding khri bang rim gsum can gyi steng mar/ dkyil 'khor ras bris bkram/ de steng mañdzi rim pa gnyis/ 'og mar dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba rgyan dpe gcig la rtser rdo rje rtse lnga/ nyi zla nor bu/ shing lo me tog

rgyan gyi lte bar chos 'byung sngon po/ g.yas g.yon/ a yig dkar dmar gyis mtshan pa mchan ldan/ de steng rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings dmar po can/ nyer lnga'i rdzas dang dri bzang chus sum gnyis bkang ba kha rgyan dang*/ dung chos/ gzungs rdor sngags byang dar dmar dgab pa bshams/ steng du sku'i dkyil 'khor tsaka gdugs dang bla bre 'phan gyis mdzes par bstar/ dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma tshe ril dang tshe chang yang gang bder dgod/ mchod lha bcu gsum la lha bshos bcu drug /'byor na sgab skor yang bshams par bya'o// mthar mchod pa g.yas bskor gyis bshams pa zhig dang*/ de 'og phyogs mtshams bka' srung dmar gtor me ri can bcu so sor tsakli/ shar gyi shar steng*/ nub kyi nub 'og /de 'og bang rim la myos byed kyi mchod yon/ chu gtsang zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos/ de 'og bang rim la dri bzang chab/ lha bshos/ mar me bcas phyogs rer nyer bdun bkod pa'i re re nas brgya rtsa tshang bar bshams/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum dang*/ mchod pa phreng tshar/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas gtsang zhing rmad du byung ba ci 'byor bshams/ tshogs kyi gtor ma dang*/ dam rdzas/ bdud rtsi/ rak+ta/ zas sna gang 'byor dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir 'don pa dang bstun/ gzhag rgyu'i phur pa gdan can lnga/ mtshams bzhir mda' dar dkar sngo dmar ljang btags pa bzhi/ me long bzhi bcas kyang 'dzoms par byas/ yang byin 'bebs spyan 'dren tshe 'gugs skabs g.yug rgyu'i mda' dar rgyan sna tshogs kyis brjid pa zhig dang*/ yungs kar sogs rdo rje rgyal po'i mdun du bzhag /rdor dril/ ḍā ru/ gzhan yang rnga rol la sogs pa byin che zhing nyams dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba'i mchod rdzas dag kyang ma tshang med pa dang*/ bka' srung gtor 'bul/ dus rgyun 'bul gtor dmar gtor gtso bo gcig la gtor ma dgus bskor ba/ yang dmar gtor gcig can gnyis/ bdud bzhi'i tshogs bsgral rgyu/

tshogs bzhi/ dam rdzas dang bcas dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhir gang bder bkod/ bdud bzhi lha bdud dkar po/ dar dkar gos/ phyag na me dpung*/ lhan skyes bdud ser po/ dar ser gos/ phyag na chu'i gzhong pa/ 'chi bdag bdud dmar nag khro zhal can/ mi lpags gos dang*/ phyag na ba dan nag po/ chu glang sngon po zhon pa/ las nyon bdud ljang gu/ dar ber ljang gu/ lag na nad rkyal dang*/ bdud zhags thogs pa bzhi ka'i mdun du mar me/ g.yas g.yon changs bu/ sha dum/ 'bru sna sgog tsong sogs blugs la snod bor chog pa zhig gi nang bzhag nas/ dkyil 'khor lding khri'i 'og gi phyogs bzhir ma nor ba bkod/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs gser skyems bcas bshams la/ dang po sa 'dul phur gdab kyi chas sogs bkod la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ bsam pa lhun grub/ brgyud 'debs mthar rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ nga ni badz+ra he ru sogs/ sngags rol mo 'bebs chung zhabs bton la mtshams rgyag tsam gyis gzhan rnams dkyus ltar bton la/ phur gdab rdzogs pa dang*/ rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ yungs kar thogs/ hūm̐ nga ni mi bskyod rdo rje'i sogs nas gong ltar thams cad rdzogs mtshams 'bebs dang sum rdung gis/ mda' dar thogs la/ bh+yoḥ nga ni yum chen sogs gong ltar/ mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag nyin ltar du brgyud 'debs mtha' nas/ dkar bgegs byin rlabs man bton/ bgegs gtor byin rlabs 'bru gsum lan gsum bden stobs dang*/ 'bul sngags gnyis so sor lan gsum/ hūm̐/ nyon cig mthar/ rol chen gang rung zhig mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag gnas bdag gtor ma/ mthar mchod rol sum brdung 'phar can dang*/ sum ba rdung lta bu'i sbub chol dkrol la/ hūm̐ snang srid rdzogs pa chen po nas/ srung 'khor āḥbar 'bebs kyis bzhag skyabs 'gro sems bskyed so sor lan gsum re rnga mi bskul/ mthar/ rol chen 'bebs kyis sum brdung lta bus byin 'bebs mthar rol mo bzhag

/oṃ shu n+ye ta sogs nas/ zhi bsnyen gnyis sbrel mar 300 bton/ bdud rtsi drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs ngag byin rlabs dbyangs gsal byed 21 bzlas/ rang nyid sher phyin sogs yig drug 108 bzlas/ shū n+ye ta nas sum brdung blang*/ snang srid thams cad sogs nas/ 'bar bar gyur bar de nas rol mo 'bebs chen gyis sum ba rdung lta bur blangs la hūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan sogs nas/ gcig tu 'dres par gyur bar tshig rnga bcas bton mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis gdan 'bul dang*/ 'bebs sum brdung gis yo byad longs spyod 'bul mthar 'bebs dang bcas/ tshogs thengs/ yar 'tshogs sum brdung gis brda chos brda yi mchod pa rnams 'bul mtshams 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ phur bu thogs/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe ye dag sogs bdud bzhi tshan bzhi po 'bebs dang bcas so sor bsgral bstab mchod pa bcas phul la 'bebs kyis bzhag mchod rdzas la bdud rtsi 'thor/ bigh+nanā lan bdun dang*/ a mṛ te nyer lngas byin brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin chen sna lnga las grub mthar/ gha na tsakra oṃ āḥhūm̐ mthar mchod rol/ 'di phyin rnga mi bskul/ oṃ ṭha ṭha sogs dang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ swa bhā wa nas 'bar nas gyur bar/ oṃ shu n+ye ta nas pho nya'i lha bar dbyangs dang bcas mda' dar g.yab/ nyi ma shar phyogs rdo rje'i sogs mthar chags nas/ myur 'grub shog bar/ skabs mtshams dril gsil bya dgos/ de nas bsnyen pa gang 'grub 300 dang*/ hrīḥ bsnyen/ 200 gzungs ring 108 bcas mthar dbyangs gsal rten snying yig brgya bcas tshar gsum bton/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs dang zhi rol/ sbyin pa btang zhing sogs gung gseng*/ tshogs grol/ yar 'tshogs tshar gnyis gsum 'don par spro na gang gi a bh+rūm̐ swa bhā wa nas bzung bsnyen pa thun bcad/ gong ltar mthar zhi rol 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ dngos 'byor mchod pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan sangs rgyas sogs sngags mchod mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis oṃ āḥhūm̐/

tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis tshogs/ tshogs bran mchan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das sogs nas pū dza kha hi nas rol mo 'bebs dang rkang gling dang sum brdung bya/ tshogs phud gnyis bcad dang bdud rtsi rak+ta sogs dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ rked pa dngos grub rdzas dang*/ lhag ma cha gsum bgos te cha gcig mkha' 'gro la/ cha gcig chos skyong la/ cha gcig bdud bzhi dang lan chags la bsngo rgyu rnams mchod dpon pas spros/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshe dang ye shes sogs nas zhal bstab 'don mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis bshags pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje tshe dpag med sogs dang*/ mthar phud mchod nam mkhar phul/ 'bebs dang sum brdung gis bstod pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshe dang ye shes sogs nas/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /mchod dpon pas g.yas bdud rtsi/ g.yon tshogs dang rak+ta bzung*/ rang lus tshe lha'i pho brang gi rak+ta rol zhes pa'i skabs su tshogs drangs la/ a la la ho/ zhes tshogs rol/ bdud rtsi btung la/ dpral bar byug /rak+ta mgrin par byug /tshogs rgyan snying khar byug /bar chad lam sel/ zhabs brtan 'dra gang 'tshams bton/ lhag ma

changs bu byas pa bsdu/ klong yangs chen po nas/ a la la rol mo 'bebs dang rnga tshig gang rung gis/ nyi ma dbus su bro gcig sogs/ mā ra ya phaṭa nas 'bebs kyis bzhag mkha' 'gro la/ gtor ma 'di tshogs lhag ma gtogs zur du med/ bran/ hūm̐ bh+yo gtor snod bhan+dha nas rgya mtshor gyur/ rol mo sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐ bh+yo dag pa mkha' spyod sogs/ kha ram̐ kha hi bar 'bebs kyis bzhag /chos skyong gtor ma 'di'ang tshogs lhag bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor snod lcags sam nas/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho/ rol mo drag 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ 'og min gnas dang sogs nas/ kha hi bar 'bebs mthar dgu brdung 'dzag dkyil 'khor mthar yod pa rnams kyi drung du phul med kyis/ hūm̐ tshogs lhag glud dang changs bu sogs mthar rol mo 'bebs/ tshogs lhag phul/ rol mo bzhag /chos skyong gtor 'bul bcu po dang gnyis de bran/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum dang sogs nas mthar rol mo drag 'bebs kyis bzhag /hūm̐/ rang nyid rdo rje sogs nas bdud rtsir gyur bar/ de nas gdangs gyer tshe rol mo len/ de min tshig rnga bcas/ hūm̐ ma hā ka la phyag bzhi pa sogs nas mthar rol mo 'bebs sum brdung gis gzhan yang tshe lha'i mthar/ 'bebs dang sum brdung 'dzag bral gyis/ bh+yo srid pa'i rgyal mo sogs dang*/ mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag bkra shis brjod/ 'di gsang 'dus le brgyad ma'i/ oṃ bkra shis nyi ma stong khams brdal med ltos/ dril gsil bcas 'don pa dang bstun/ mda' dar phyogs bzhi nas g.yob/ hūm̐ rdo rje tshe yi sogs/ mthar rol mo sbub chol 'bebs dang sum brdung ngam dgu brdung gis bdud bzhi rnams phreng tshar dpag la bkod/ chang rgod bran/ dpal 'bar sbar la/ bswo bskul lo bskul lo sogs/ mthar 'bebs dang rnga tshig gang rung gis rim bzhin gong ltar bdud bzhi so sor brdzang*/ mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis srung 'khor/

hūm̐ rang nyid rdo rje tshe dpag sogs dang mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /bka' srung gtor ma bzhi po dus rgyun 'bul gtor mi the ba'i dmar gtor bzhi dgos bran la/ byin rlabs rnga mi bskul/ 'bul tshig dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir phul rnga bskul/ mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag pa le tshan bzhi'i mtshams/ 'bebs mthar rol mo bzhag /dngos grub dang dbang blang ye gsang gi bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs nas sngags kyi skabs gtor dbang len/ rak+ṣaḥ bar dang tshe gzungs tshe rta 'don tshe/ tshe ril chang drangs/ de nas sku gsum bla ma/ rten dang gtor ma sogs/ bkra shis ltar brjod la mtha' rgyas bya'o// yang smin dbang gi skabs dngos gzhi gong ltar/ sgo dbye'i mtshams ye gsang gi bla ma rig 'dzin dbang len rak+ṣaḥbar/ de nas bdud bzhi rnams gong ltar rim bzhin brdzang 'debs nas/ srung 'khor dang*/ bka' srung gtor 'bul mtshams/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ hūm̐ ye shes lnga yi sogs dang*/ yig brgya mthar rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ nga ni rdo rje tshe dpag sogs kyis bgegs bskrad mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /dri ba dang dri lan rjes zlos bya/ mig dar 'ching bcug /maṇ+ḍal/ ho bdag lus sogs/ dbang bshad lo rgyus rdo rje'i tshig rkang ltar bya/ skyabs sems nongs bshags/ mig dar bsal/ lha ngo bstan la phun sum tshogs pa'o// mthar rol chen 'bebs dang sum ba rdung gis byin 'bebs/ hūm̐/ zhing khams rnam dag bton mthar 'bebs dang sum ba rdung lta bu'i spyan 'dren/ ye shes lnga ldan 'don mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho bar/ ar+gham̐ sogs nas dang*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i mchod bstod bya/ 'dir tshogs skal ldan sogs dang*/ brtan par byas/ de nas bum dbang yongs rdzogs bskur nas/ lha dbang yang bskur/ don brjes dang*/ yi dam lha sogs dang*/ de nas hūm̐ rgyal ba rab 'byams sogs tsakli'i dbang bskur/ lhung bzed 'khar gsil chos gos dang*/

khro chas/ 'dod yon dbang bcas/ spyi 'gro ltar na 'di nas tshe 'gugs 'jug /brgyud 'dzin gal gnad tshe sbyin sreg las mtha' dang pusti'i lung sbyin/ 'og gi bka' srung gtad pa bcas bya zhing gar thod thod la mi bya/ spro na tshe bdud bkug la/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum dang sogs kyis bkug la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje tshe dpag sogs kyis bsgral/ lid+ga bsreg /zhal bstab bton/ slob mar yang sbyin/ de nas pusti'i lung sbyin bya/ 'di mtshams nyi ma shar phyogs sogs byed nas/ mda' dar spyi bor bzhag /gtor dbang*/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi gtor ma sogs mthar tshe gzungs tshan gsum bton la tshe ril chang sbyin/ spro na bka' gtad/ gang ltar mtha' brten/ rang las gzhan gces sogs rdor 'chang sku spyi bor bzhag /gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ ho bdag lus phung khams kyi maṇ+ḍal/ de nas brtsams te dam tshig khas len pa sogs bya'o// slar sku gsum bla ma/ rten dang gtor ma nas/ mngon gyur shog bar bsdu rim byas la shis brjod rjes bskul rigs rnams gong ltar bya/ zhes si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa dza yan tu/ sarba mad+ga laṃ/// / ༈ swa sti/ za 'dod sla chos mkhan gyi 'don bya 'di// dpal ldan bslu brid mgo skor rgyan du mdzes// lam zhor la bsang stabs bde don 'du byed par spro na/ rtsa ba gsum dang 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi rten yod na bkram/ gzhi dkar po'i steng*/ skyems phud dang*/ phye mar/ spro na mnga' gsol gtor ma bca'/ mda' dar dang*/ bsang shing sman spos rnams bgyid la/ dang po tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ spro na bsam 'grub ma/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan sogs/ gsang sngags nang gtor yi dam sngags bsngos bcas dang shab+da la rol mo/ kun 'grub mdzod la rol mo/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭota sogs/ stong par gyur pa'i sogs nas/ gnyis med gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sogs lan gsum/

spyan 'dren sngags dang rol mo de ltar/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ bla med mchod pa sogs sngags yongs rdzogs rol mo zhabs bton/ kun tu bzang po sogs/ rdo rje gdan gyi sogs/ rdo rje mi 'gyur sogs/ bdag nyid dpal chen sogs/ dri za'i rgyal po sogs/ klu yi dge bsnyen sogs/ de rnams la so so'i rol tshig dang ldan pa dgos/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag dkar gtor mthar rol mo dang mda' dar g.yab/ phye mar khur la/ spro na bsang bskor bya/ sangs rgyas bstan srung tshang ma tshig bzhi'i mtshams me tog 'thor zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas mthar rol mo bcas/ mchod sbyin gnas dang*/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs dang*/ bkra shis dpal 'bar sogs/ de ltar mchod pa skabs mtshams rnams su phud dang phye mar sogs bsang rdzas rnams 'bul bar bya'o// yang*/ bsdus pa byed na/ tshig bdun ma nyung ba/ bdag nyid skad cig gis sogs/ gsang sngags nang gtor dang*/ bla ma brgyud rim tsho gsum bzhag /yi dam bya ba'i rgyud sogs/ kun 'grub mdzod bar/ ma dag ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor/ sangs rgyas bstan srung sogs tshang ma bkra shis bcas/ mchod sbyin gnas sogs bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis dpal 'bar brjod par bya'o// de ltar rgyas bsdus gnyis de'i bsang dang gtor bsngos kyang don bsdus stabs bde 'gyur ram snyam/ maṅga lam/// / ༈ g.yang skyabs stabs bde don 'thus 'dod na gzhi dkar po'i steng*/ spro na rnam sras gtor ma mar zan gyis bca' ba'am/ bsdu na phye mar spungs pa dang zas sna gang 'dzoms dang phud skyems/ dkar gtor ram yang na phye mar dang g.yang rdzas nor sna mda' dar sogs bshams la/ dang po'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ spro na bsam 'grub ma bton/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor sogs/ oṃ swa wa sogs/ rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge bā+ai se po sogs nas/

spyan drangs/ spyan 'dren rol mo 'bebs dal ran dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ ri rab byang phyogs sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod nas rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ oṃ bā+ai swā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ bā+ai shrā ma na yang brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la sogs brgya rtsa brgyad bzla bzhin/ spro na/ zangs gzhong du mar gyi ril bu rnams bzhag la chu sbreng*/ de nas sngags ring gnyis so sor lan bdun nam gsum re bzla'o// de nas rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ oṃ mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas/ swā hā/ rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /oṃ dam tshig bdud rtsi sogs/ gtor sngags lan gsum/ rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i sogs nas 'grub/ mdzad du gsol/ rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs kyi gtor ma mthar rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis g.yang rdzas rnams yon bdag rnams la so sor gtad la/ sangs rgyas bstan srung sogs nas mthar bkra shis bcas rol mo bya/ g.yang sgo bsdams la yon bdag rang gnas su btang*/ dril gsil bcas yig brgyas bzod gsol dang*/ dkon mchog rin chen sogs bsngo smon rgyas gdab bya'o// bkra shis/ smras pa/ tshig nyung don dang ldan pa'i gnad 'dus 'di// rang gzhan phan bde'i gter chen bum bzang ngo*// zhes pad+ma nyin byed kyis gzhung mthun bkod pa'o// mad+ga lam̐/// / ༈ dgongs gter gur drag gi bca' bkod 'don 'grigs bzhugs so// rdo rje drag po'i zhabs la 'dud// mchog thun dngos grub char ltar stsol// de la 'dir lding khri mtho dman gnyis kyi mtho bar stan khebs dang*/ dma' bar stag lpags gting*/ gong gtor g.yas bla ma'i gtor ma dang*/ dbus chos 'byung bsnol mar dpal gtor pad 'dab bzhi can/ g.yon chos skyong la zur gsum me ris mtshan pa log gsum mtheb kyu gsum dang ldan pa bcas dkar dmar rgyan bkra dang*/

de mdun mchod pa phreng tshar dang*/ bsnyen phur byin chen bkram/ gung du zhal thang sogs kyang bshams/ g.yas g.yon tshe ril chang bcas dang*/ stegs 'og mar/ ma ṭaṃ khog par las dkyil ras bris bting*/ de steng mañdzi'i khar lcags snod du 'bru nag phye ma dug gis sbrus pa las gyur pa'i gtor chen gnam lcags thog mdel dbyibs khru gang las mi chung ba/ dbus su khro zhal rngams brjid rtse bran thod skam snyan rgyan ldan pa zhal 'bag dang gtor mar smug rtsi gsol/ de phyir yum dang khro rgyal bzhi mkha' 'gro sde bzhi bcas kyi gtor ma dgu/ de phyir khro bcu'i gtor ma bcu/ de phyir ging yab yum gtor ma brgyad/ de phyir sde brgyad gtor ma brgyad bcas/ gtso 'khor gtor ma me ris brgyan/ so sor khrag rkang mtheb kyus lha grangs dang mnyam pas bskor/ rtse mor bya khyung 'khor lo dang*/ de steng dar gdugs sngon po phub/ g.yas su srung ba'i 'khor lo zhal sgrub por bstan pa dang*/ g.yon du zlog 'khor zhal phyir bstan bcas btsugs/ gtor chen 'og tu gru gsum brus la de nang bsad 'khor bcug /mtshe dang yungs kar nag dpal 'bar gsum dang rtsang gis brgyan/ mtha' skor rtsang phur dmar nag dra ba phur so ris su bskor zhing rgyu ma dang*/ sngo dmar skud pas 'tshub ma ris su dkris/ yang gtor chen g.yas khram shing ngos la khram ris btab/ ngos phyir pho rgyud byad zor bh+yo zlog zer ba bri/ mo rgyud byad zor bh+yo zlog bris la btsugs/ gtor chen phyi skor shar gri zor/ lhor khram zor/ byang tshe zor/ shar lhor mda' zor/ lho nub rwa zor/ nub byang rdo zor/ byang shar dug zor bcas de rnams phal cher thun rkang zur gsum nang btsugs la bkod/ yang mdun ngos thun rkang zur gsum nang*/ nam mkha' dang rgyang bu dar tshon brgyan pa dang*/ shing byang la gnam lcags tho ba dang*/ mtshon cha'i 'khor lo/ gnam lcags sdig pa mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa dang*/

me dpung bris pa rnams so sor byas pa dang*/ mtshe yungs kar nag rtsang dmar rnams 'dzugs/ yang ru ṭa'i snying zor thun rkang nang bcas la bzhag /lha dbye rdzas bya rog dang*/ 'ug sgro brub khung du gtor rgyag skabs rdeg sa shog ling gcig dang*/ de steng nyin ltar bsgral ling re bcas dang*/ bsgral phur dang*/ thun rdzas/ yungs kar/ khrag thun/ mtshe thun/ dug thun/ mda' thun/ rdo thun/ tho ba/ ral gri sogs phyogs gcig gang bder gcig dang*/ g.yab dar/ gser skyems bzlog pa tshar re spro na gtor ma lha grangs ltar/ dang po gtor ma bcu/ de nas bcu/ de nas brgyad/ yang brgyad bcas 'don tshig dang bstun pa'am/ mthar gtor chen nang 'bul rgyu'i der mkho khyad kyi gtor chung grangs mang*/ dam rdzas bcas dang*/ mdun du sman gtor rak+ta/ phyi mchod phreng tshar dang drag bshos bcas/ tshogs dang bdud rtsi/ dam rdzas/ zas sna bshams/ bka' srung dmar gtor gtso 'khor bcu can nam/ gcig tu bsdu na mtheb kyus bskor ba ci bde chad tho dmar gtor rtsang sogs btsugs pa che legs/ brtan ma sum tshom can/ sngon 'gro bgegs gtor changs bu ting lo sha dum bcas/ gzhan yang nyer mkho'i rigs kyi spyan gzigs mchod rdzas sogs 'jigs la rngam pa bstar/ sgrub po rnams gral du bde bar 'khod/ dang po tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ bsam pa lhun grub ma/ brgyud 'debs mthar spro na rol mo dang po byin 'bebs dang*/ gcig brdung nas/ bcu gcig bar 'dzag bcas mthar 'bebs dang*/ sum brdung gis bla mar 'jug /rol mo gong gsal brgya brdung ma byas kyang 'bebs dang sum brdung gis skyabs sems la 'jug /so sor lan gsum re/ rdo rje rgyal po bcas mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /bgegs gtor bran/ bh+rām̐ las byung ba'i sogs/ dengs shig nas rol mo sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ nga ni las kyi sogs mthar rol chen gang rung zhig dang*/ srung 'khor hūm̐ steng 'og phyogs mtshams/

rak+ṣa hūm̐ nas 'bebs dang sum brdung gis mchod pa byin rlabs sman rag gtor gsum sngags lan gsum/ pu dza oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas mchod rol sum 'phar mthar/ 'bebs chen gyi sum brdung lta bu dang bcas/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul dang mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ chos kun stong nyid sogs bdag mdun gcig char bskyed la/ spyan drangs gyur nas rol mo 'bebs chen dang rol tshig gang rung gis/ hrīḥ yul gyi ming ni sogs dang mthar 'bebs dang gnyis brdung gis bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa ā+oṃḥhūm̐ nas mchod rol dang sum brdung len nas/ nang mchod mthar kha kha khā hi nas mtshams rgyag byed na/ bdud rtsi lag mchod bya zhing*/ chos sku snang ba sogs dang*/ rak+ta mchod rol mthar khā hi nas 'di phyin tshig rnga dgos/ mchod tshan bzhi mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis bstod nas mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag la tshogs thengs bya/ de nas 'bebs sam sum brdung gis dzab bskul mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /dzab dmigs dang zhi bsnyen/ 1000 drag sngags dmigs pa/ drag bsnyen/ yang spel tshig can/ 'khor sngags dang hūm̐ bcu ma/ khyung dang mkha' 'gro bzhi bcas dang*/ artsig sham bur sde brgyad sngags dang*/ dregs pa gzir sngags sbrel ma bcas/ 21 mthar dbyangs gsal byed yig brgya/ ye shes lha tshogs nas zhi rol bya/ bka' srung dang mdun sogs rnga mi ltos/ gsal bar gyur nas rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig nas tiṣ+ṭha lhan bar mtshams rgyag tsam shab+da bar/ mtshams rgyag gis bzhag la sngags bsngos lan gsum/ rnga tshig bcas/ hūm̐ legs ldan nas grogs mdzod cig bar/ 'bebs mthar bzhag /tshogs pa gung gseng*/ yar 'tshogs rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung gis tshogs/ hūm̐/ chos sku rnam dag sogs nas/ hrīḥṭha 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ hūm̐ nub phyogs o rgyan nas/ pū dza ho bar 'bebs dang sum brdung*/ tshogs phud phul/

bshags pa dang skong ba dang bcas/ tshogs bar pa phul/ rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung bya/ bsgral las chas rnams slob dpon mdun du bzhag la/ gser skyems phul zhing*/ ho mi mngon dbyings bzhugs sogs gzu dpang mthar 'bebs kyis rol mo bzhag /brub khung ling ga chus bran/ e las brub khung sogs nas/ bden stobs tshar gsum/ rol mo drag 'bebs rjes ma'i mthar dgu brdung bcas/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po nas/ mdzod bar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis lha dbye mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis las kyi gnyer gtad/ sa ma ya nas 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ phur bu 'dril zhing*/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings sogs dang*/ mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis rnam shes spar/ de mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis thun rdzas kyis brab/ hūm̐/ rdo rje phur pa sogs bar skabs mtshams rgyag tsam re byed/ mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis zhal bstab bton la 'bebs dang sum brdung lta bus/ zlog pa/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas sogs yongs rdzogs mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /grangs gsog tshe 'di nas 'dzin/ bzlog pa tshig lhug tshar gsum dang*/ dmigs pa gsal zhing ting 'dzin ldan pas sngags bzlog kho nas grangs gsog pa'ang bzhed/ de nas trig khroṃ dang lo3lt;?>ི sngags bzlog tshar gsum re/ spro na me dbal khyung dang rtsang zlog rnams/ ༈ nyang lugs drag po bder 'dus nas kha skong bya/ de nas tshogs las rdor gyis gzigs mdzes gyer/ slob dpon 'dus pa bcas pas lan mo la rin thang ma gyer/ bar chad lam sel/ zhabs brtan skabs gang 'os/ lhag ma bsdu/ rol mo 'bebs dang bshug glu bcas te sman gtor nas dkyu gu gcig phab/ slob dpon gyis gtsang lhag bcas/ mang lhag steng bzhag mtshams su bsre ba dang 'don pa dang bstun la/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis sogs mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung dal ran gyis chad tho dang*/ tha tshig bsgrag pa/ hūm̐/ 'byams klas sogs dang*/ gtor gzhong nam mkhar sogs nas 'thor/

hūm̐/ dbang drag pad+ma'i sogs/ 'chi med tshe nas sid+dhi hā bar lan gsum/ de nas zhi rol sum brdung gis mchod bstod mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /bzod gsol bsngo ba/ bkra shis mthar zhi rol sum 'phar ldir/ da ni nyin bstar chags dang*/ zor rdeg nyin sde brgyad las gtor/ gtor chen mtha' skor nas len nam mi bde tshe gsar du dmar gtor brgyad dang*/ dkar gtor gcig bcas la/ lhag ma yan sngar ltar la/ zor las nang gi sgo dbye mthar rol mo 'ur brdung blangs nas zor bskul/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ do nub dpal gyi sogs nas/ yā bar 'ur brdung dang bzhi brdung bcas gza' rgyu phyogs dang bstun nas/ spos ru mtshon phyar dar sogs dang ser sbrengs kyis sna drangs te gtor zor rnams rim pas phyir khyer la/ 'phen sar slebs nas/ dang po/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma sogs kyis gser skyems phul/ rol mo 'bebs brgyud gong 'og ma/ rjes mar sum brdung gis bsgral las nang gi ho mi mngon dbyings bzhugs dang skabs mtshams gser skyems phul skabs mtshams rgyag tsam dang mthar 'bebs gnyis btud kyis bzhag /'di skabs dkar gtor phul/ bsad ling la bkug gzhug lan gsum drag 'bebs bcas/ rjes mar thing brdung gis/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i nas/ phrin las mdzod bar 'bebs sum brdung gis/ chad tho dang*/ tha tshig bzhengs bskul nas/ phyogs kun zlog pa nas 'bebs dang sum brdung lta bus zor rnams rim par btegs la/ klu gnod sbyin/ rgyal po btsan/ bdud ma mo/ gshin rje/ lha'i bar mas nas yas rim bton la mtshams rgyag 'ur brdung re'i skabs sde brgyad las gtor re dang zor rdeg mthar/ rkang zor mtshon cha ni rgyang sdig par brdeg la// hūm̐/ drag po las kyi sogs dang*/ 'ur brdung dang sum brdung bcas/ dpal gyi gtor chen la dpal 'bar sgron nas btegs pa/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ 'bru nag khrag gis sogs/ mthu ma chung nas 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/

las byang nang*/ hūm̐ nga ni pad+ma drag po nas/ rdul du rlog bar 'bebs dang*/ bsad ling dang gtor ma mer bsreg /sum brdung gis dmod bcol drag tu bya/ dar nag brdab/ sum brdung gis ru ṭa'i snying zor 'phen la rol chen gang rung ldir/ zhal sgrub khang du phyogs la/ rol mo len nas/ brtan ma skyong mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag la gtor gzhong rnams sbub la slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram steng du bzhag ste/ na mo rje btsun sogs kyis bkug gzhug lan gsum/ rol mo drag 'bebs bcas/ hūm̐/ 'byams klas sogs bro brdung/ slar yang bden stobs brjod mthar bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod thams cad kyi sku tshe mdzad pa phrin las gdul bya 'gro don thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ lha rgyal lo// lha rgyal lo// lha rgyal lo// lan gsum skad gsang mtho bar brjod/ de nas sgrub khang nang phyin la phye mar drangs/ gtang rag mchod bstod sogs gong bzhin bya/ phyi nyin lta bur tshogs brgya grangs bton tshe/ tshogs tha ma'i skabs/ bden stobs tshar gcig rol mo drag 'bebs dang bsgral bstab bya/ 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ tshogs byin rlabs la 'jug spro na skong bsdus bton tshe/ dur khrod gsang mchog mthar 'don/ slar yang kun bzang mkha' dbyings sogs dkyus ltar/ tshes bcu skabs kyang de ltar bya/ gzhan las byang ltar sgrub chen skabs sngags brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ de tshe bsnyen phur gtor ma tshe ril chang bcas dbang dang dngos grub rol/ gzhan mchod bstod/ bzod gsol bsngo ba bkra shis mthar 'jam rol sum 'phar can dang dung dkar sogs ldir la mtha' rgyas spel legs mdzad par zhu/ gsung rgyun ji bzhin/ si tu pas spel ba'o// maṅga lam/// / ༈ pad+ma badz+ra grub thob rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor bshams bkod 'don 'grigs ma li ka'i phreng ba bzhugs so// gu ru pad+ma badz+ra na mo/

dang pos gzhi gtsang mar lding khri bang rim gsum can bkod la gong mar ras bris bkram/ de steng mañdzi la sum brtsegs 'og mar dpal gtor rgyan ldan/ bar par bum pa rdzas ldan dang dar sna tshogs kyi mgul chings

dung chos gzungs rdor bzhag can/ steng mar ka pā la mtshan ldan rdzas kyis bkang ba bcas dar dmar chos 'byung lteb kyis bkab/ de steng rim bzhin gsung dkyil/ thig le'i smin chen/ dkyil 'khor/ phyag mtshan dkyil 'khor rnams ma reg tsam gyis tsakli sku yi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bshams/ sku'i dkyil 'khor steng bla bre dang*/ 'phan sogs mdzes pa bstar/ gong smos dpal gtor gyi phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma/ mtshams bzhir lha bshos bzhi bshams/ de phyir mchod pa skor bshams g.yas bskor bya/ steng phyogs gang bder mtshan brgyad tsakli bkod/ las bum la mgul chings dkar po kha rgyan bcas g.yon phyogs stegs dang por bzhag /spro na sgab skor gyis bklub/ de'i phyir stegs gnyis par myos byed kyi mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ stegs gsum par rak+ta'i dri chab/ gtor ma zur gsum rgyan ldan/ dar zab/ tshogs dang*/ dam rdzas/ mar me bcas/ phyogs rer nyer bdun re bkod pa'i brgya rtsa brgyad tshang bar bshams/ de'i steng 'og gi phyi nang gang brgya rtsa'i nang du bka' srung bder/ shar du phyag bzhi g.yas zur pa/ lhor legs ldan/ nub rang byung ma/ byang trak+shad gtor ma bcas gsum me ris brgyan pa dang sha dar/ mdun du lha btsan dkar bshos pad+mas mtshan g.yon du bzhag pa bcas la so so'i tsakli btsug pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mdun ngos stegs bar mar g.yas sman mchod yon sogs brgya brgyad nang du thod/ g.yon rak+ta'i thod pa dkyil du sman gtor rgyan bkra bcas bshams/ de mthar spyi mchod phreng tshar dang*/ sgra'i bye brag pi waṃ/ ting ting shag sogs ci 'byor bzhag /mthar phyogs bzhir mda' dar phyogs mdog gi dar btags pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhir ral gri bzhi bcas 'dzug /zhing ngam stag lpags steng tshogs dang dam rdzas/ bdud rtsi/ gzhan yang zas sna dang*/ bye ma byang bu/ thar lam dar dkar khrus dar/ phud skyog /chab thur/ bzhag yul gang bder gnam phud mchod rgyu'i sman rag gtor gsum/

sngon 'gro gtor ma gser skyems bgegs gtor bcas bshams/ bka' srung gtor 'bul dmar gtor lnga/ dkar gtor sman leb bcas kyang bshams/ gzhan yang brgya rtsa kha gsos mtheb kyu sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams 'du bgyid la/ dang po rnal 'byor nyams bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas/ nyin mthar chags/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ bsam pa lhun grub ma/ pad+ma badz+ra brgyud 'debs/ dang po nyin thog mar sil snyan 'bebs dang sum brdung blangs nas dbyangs dang bcas thig gdab bya/ yang rol mo gong ltar gyis sa 'dul le tshan cig bton mthar 'bebs dang rol mo bzhag /bgegs gtor byin rlabs 'bru gsum lan gsum/ nyon cig sogs/ ta ya phaṭa nas gtor ma sbyong*/ sbub chol rol chen gang rung gis 'bebs mthar bzhag /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gnas bdag gtor 'bul mthar zhi rol 'bebs dang sum brdung gis mtshams gcod la 'jug /gu gul bdug /mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis skyabs 'gro lan gsum mtshams mtshams rgyag ci bde'i mchod pa byin rlabs dang po nang mchod bran/ de nas mchod rdzas la bdud rtsi bran la mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /rdor sems bton/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bzlas/ dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi 'thor/ mar me phal cher spar/ mda' dar g.yab/ rol mo 'bebs chen gyis byin 'bebs bton/ mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /de nas mi rtag bsgom pa dang*/ dam bca' bdag bskyed rnams la rnga mi bskul 'dur gdangs bya/ rtsa bsnyen 1000 spyi dril 10 bcas shu n+ye tas ras bris la bdud rtsi 'thor/ rol mo sum brdung gis mdun bskyed gzhal yas lha bskyed yongs rdzogs dang spyan 'dren tshig lhug sngags bcas mthar sum brdung nas rol chen 'bebs dang rnga tshig dbyangs gdangs gang rung gis bskul/ sngon bskal ma lan gsum/ dam ye bsre mtshams dal ran dang sum brdung lta bus gdan 'bul bshags pa/ mchod pa'i sngags mthar mchod rol sum 'phar can/ sman rag gtor gsum/

gnam phud 'bul mtshams so so'i gong 'og gam/ yang na gsum ga rdzogs mtshams mthar 'bebs dang*/ skong bshags mthar 'bebs/ tshogs thengs dang po byed/ yar 'tshogs sum brdung gis bstod pa 'od gsal 'khor yug mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag la/ dang po 'og gi sngags dmigs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid pad+ma badz+ra yab yum sogs kyi mthar/ rtsa bsnyen/ 1000 spyi dril/ 108 sngags byang rnams dang bcas bton/ shu n+ya ta nas bum par bdud rtsi bran/ rol mo sum brdung gis bum bskyed rdul tshon phrin las sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥnas spyan 'dren skabs 'bebs chen dang sum brdung gis/ he ru ka dpal sogs mchod pa rnams so sor bton la skong ba'i sngags mthar rol mo 'bebs mtshams rgyag zer ba dpyad dang bstod pa ye nas lhun grub sogs mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /rang lus snang srid sogs/ rtsa bsnyen/ 1000 spyi dril/ 108 bcas/ shū n+ya tas thod dkyil la bdud rtsi 'thor la rol mo sum brdung gis bdag mdun sogs thod pa thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ de mthar spyan 'dren la 'bebs chen dang sum brdung gis/ 'og min chos dbyings sogs/ phyag mchod rnams rdzogs mtshams 'bebs kyis bzhag la/ rdul tshon bum pa thod pa sogs/ spyi dril sngags 108 dang*/ tshogs thengs gnyis pa gung gseng*/ yar 'tshogs la/ shu n+ye ta sogs/ gsung dkyil la bdud rtsi bran nas sum brdung gis/ bdag mdun bum dkyil thod rdzas sogs gsung gi dkyil 'khor le tshan dang po'i mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung gis gzhan le tshan thams cad rdzogs mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /gzhi lus dag pa sogs/ rtsa bsnyen/ 1000 spyi dril/ 108 mar me sbar/ 'di man re zhig rnga la mi ltos/ sil snyan gyis mchod rol skabs su bya/ de nas sku yi dkyil 'khor oṃ shu n+ye ta sogs/ snang srid 'khor 'das sogs/ 'dur gdangs bya ba'i rnga la mi ltos/ mthar mchod rol sum 'phar can/

thig le'i dkyil 'khor/ snang srid rdo rje sogs nas mchod rol sum 'phar can/ phyag mtshan dkyil 'khor/ ye nas rnam dag sogs/ mthar mchod rol sum 'phar can gyi mthar/ gcig brdung*/ nyis brdung*/ sum brdung*/ bzhi brdung so sor 'dzag dang bcas rim brel gyis 'bebs bcas mthar bzhag rnga tshig 'di grangs ldog nas ldir ba'ang snang*/ thal mo sbyar nas rigs kun khyab bdag sogs 'dur gdangs bya bzhin sgra mchod skabs mchod rol dang 'bud brdung bkrol ba gang yod sbir nas sum brdung gis blangs nas mthar/ 'di phyin tshig rnga dgos/ tshogs/ mngon gyur shog bar/ zhi rol sum 'phar gyi mjug tu sum brdung gis blangs la skong ba phyi snod 'jig rten sogs/ la gnas shog 'bebs dang sum brdung*/ mchod pa brgya rtsa la bdud rtsi bran nas 'bebs dang sum brdung gis/ ye nas rnam dag sogs mchod pa rnams rdzogs mtshams sngags mthar mtshams rgyag tsam gyis bzhag la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum/ bdag dang mtha' yas sogs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas nyan rang sogs nas dgongs su gsol gsum/ bde gshegs khro rgyal sogs/ grangs gsog tshe 'di mthar rol mo 'bebs dang nyis rdung nas gong gi ye nas rnam dag sogs la 'jug pa'i bshags pa bcas gong dang 'dra ba'i tshar bzhi tshar mtshams 'bebs mthar bzhag la lan re bde smon 'od dpag med sogs tshogs thengs dang po/ yar 'tshogs/ ye nas rnam dag nas bshags pa sogs sbrel ma bcas sngon ma ji lta bzhin tshar bcu tshar mtshams rjes mar hūm̐ nas 'bebs mthar rnga bzhag /bshags pa sogs tshan gsum rnga la mi bskul bar tshar mtshams/ tshogs thengs gnyis pa bya la/ yar 'tshogs gtor 'bul rnams bshams nas bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bhan dha mtshan ldan mthar byin rlabs lan gsum mthar sbub chol gyis sum brdung 'dzag med kyis/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dag pa mkha' spyod sogs seng gdong gtor 'bul mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag

/bhan+dha lcang lo sogs nas/ bsil ba'i tshal zhes sogs mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag /bhan+dha skra 'byar sogs/ 'og min byang phyogs nas mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag 'di kun tshig rnga las gdangs ma byas tshe 'gor sum brdung mi dgos/ gong 'og kun la 'gre/ de nas gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong zhes tshig bsgyur so mdzad srol snang*/ 'di dbyangs byed na sum brdung 'dzag bral dgos/ ri rab byang shar sogs mthar 'bebs dang dgu brdung 'dzag med kyis drag po e yi sogs nas mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung bzhi brdung 'dzag med 'dra gis/ yul ni sbas yul sogs mthar 'bebs dang sum brdung 'dzag bcas dal ran gyis hūm̐ hrīḥ pad+ma 'dab stong sogs/ spyan 'dren sngags kyi mtshams sum brdung gis mtshams rgyag tsam byed nas/ rig 'dzin chen po sogs nas/ tshogs 'bul mthar 'bebs kyis bzhag ho dgongs su gsol lo// phyogs bcu sogs/ lan gsum sgrig 'don bya/ tshogs la rol/ bar chad lam sel dang*/ zhabs brtan/ yang na smon lam bzang spyod dam smon lam 'dra skabs 'brel gang yod bya/ tshogs lhag bsdu/ rol mo drag 'bebs bshug glu dang bcas ldir nas a las lhag ma bton mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag bkra shis ho dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyi mthar zhi rol sum 'phar can dang*/ rgyal ba rab 'byams sogs smon lam dang*/ rang lugs chos srung gtor bsngos bcas bton nas grol/ grol nyin la lhag ma tshar mtshams zhi rol 'bebs dang mthar sum brdung nas gro lod ye gsang bla ma rig 'dzin rnam rgyal bum pa phul nas bzhag la bum chu bskyed lha tshogs sogs nas lta bur gyur bar/ mthar 'bebs kyis rol mo bzhag /rten dang gtor ma'i lha tshogs sogs kyi bsdu rim dang*/ gong gsal/ dbang rdzas gzhan phul mi dgos// bkra shis bcas mtha' rgyas bya'o// yang gnas 'dren skabs las byang gzhung bsrang ba gong ltar gyis/ tshogs kyi smon lam tshar gsum dang*/

de nas/ 'dir mthun pa'i pad+ma badz+ra gyi thugs rje bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ chos dbyings rang sogs mtshan brgyad tsakli las bum bye ma mdun du bzhag /dzaḥhūm̐ sogs nas 'gugs pa lan gsum/ de nas dkyus ltar la/ hūm̐ nga ni pad+ma sogs bgegs gtor skabs rol mo 'bebs dang sum brdung rnga tshig dang bcas mthar rol mo 'bebs kyis bzhag /hūm̐ 'di ni rdo rgyal yab yum phul pad+ma sogs/ dbang khrus rnams bar mtshams rtsa sngags spyi dril bton/ gnas spar sogs rim bzhin/ mtshan byang mthar zhi rol ring tsam gis dal la bskor ba gsum mam phyag gsum byas te dal gyi lho sgor bzhag /'dod yon bsngo/ 'di skabs zhi rol zhig byed/ lam bstan bya/ rdo rje 'chang zhag grangs tshe dang ro gcig gyur dang*/ nub tha mar/ ro mar me bstan gcig gyur nas/ khyod kyi ma dag sdig sgrib sogs sbrel nas/ khyab brdal shog bar/ rtsa sngags lan gsum/ prā wa= ra gsum/ spyi dril bcas lan gsum gyi mthar/ ming byang spar/ de tshe zhi rol sum 'phar can ldir/ gzhan yang zhi khro/ mi 'khrugs kun rig bcas kyi rtsa sngags/ yig brgya bcas brjod/ mthar ngo mtshar sangs rgyas sogs/ dmigs yul ngan song sogs/ 'di ni nub kyi phyogs rol sogs/ pad+ma 'dam gyis sogs/ mi gtsang lus 'di= ci ltar sngon sogs nas/ bzang spyod sogs rnam lnga bton la gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam ji snyed kyi dpung bskul/ tshogs drangs/ zhabs brtan sogs skabs dang bstun/ lhag ma bsdu sogs nas/ bkra shis bcas gong ltar bya'o// dmigs bsal snying thig dbang mo che'i sgo nas slob ma smin grol lam 'jug gi skabs las gzhung ltar gyi skong bshags tshar mtshams rdo rje rgyal pos ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang len pa ye gsang ltar byas nas/ slob ma mdun du 'khod la/ sngon 'gro tshan gnyis/ srung 'khor dang sgo dbye skabs phyogs bzhir mda' dar g.yab/ man+ḍal dang*/ spro na lo rgyus 'don/

zhu gnang dang skyabs 'gro cha lag gur drag nang ltar/ sems bskyed dang bcas/ gong gi rdor sems sgom rim slob ma la phog la/ khrus bya/ de nas dbang gzhung gsal ltar mdun bskyed ji bzhin slob ma lhar bskyed/ slob dpon yang lha'i nga rgyal ldan bzhin/ ye shes spyan 'dren dam dbye bsre ba grub mtshams dbang rdzas rnams gzhung ltar bkra shis dang bcas bskur/ yang dbang gi zab gnad phye ba ni/ rig pa'i 'phrul gyis rtogs dgos so// chas dbang mnga' gsol skabs gzhung tshig ltar rnga rol dung kar sogs sbir/ lar yang gnas 'dren dang*/ dbang chen 'di skabs 'brel chags pa'i dril gsil spyan 'dren byin 'bebs sogs kyi skabs rol chen dang zhi rol sogs skabs thob bstun la/ de nas 'bul gtor bskul rnams kyang gzhung tshig dang mthun par phul/ rol mo sogs kyang dkyus ltar 'gre'o// de nas tshogs rol/ lhag ma/ dngos grub dbang blangs bkra shis sogs mtha' rgyas bya'o// sarba mad+ga lam/// / ༈ drag po nus ldan rtsal gyi gsung las 'bring po bdag mdun dkyil 'khor bskyed rdzogs bshams bkod khyer bde ni/ lding khri'i khar ras bris bkrams/ de steng mañdzī'i steng dpal gtor rgyan ldan rtser gtso bo yab yum gyi tsaka li la dar gdugs sngon po phub/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i gtor ma/ mtshams bzhir lha bshos bzhi/ mdun du sman rag gtor gsum dang*/ mchod pa breng tshar bshams/ tshogs dang dam rdzas/ bdud rtsi/ zas sna tshogs/ gnam phud sman raka gtor gsum bcas dang*/ bka' srung 'bul gtor drug /sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis/ gser skyems bcas bshams la/ dang po 'don bya/ thig gdab/ sa 'dul/ sngon gtor gnyis btang*/ srung 'khor/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bdag bskyed bsnyen pa/ de nas mdun bskyed yongs rdzogs bsnyen pa zin nas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye nas rnam dag sogs mchod pa skong bshags/ tshar grangs bton tshe gong gsal ltar/

de nas bka' srung gtor 'bul rnams dang*/ tshogs mchod dang*/ tshogs la rol mthar lhag ma bkra shis/ grol nyin lta bur dbang blangs/ rjes chog bla ma rig 'dzin sogs dang*/ rten dang gtor ma'i lha tshogs sogs/ ye shes gsang ba las gsal ba ltar bya'o// lha thog dpon karma tshe brtan la bsgrigs chags bsdebs nas gnang ba'i nges pa khungs ldan yin/ yang gter chen zhal rgyun/ bla ma rta mgrin mgon po'i lugs kyi rgyun khyer la dang po skyabs 'gro rdor sems/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa dam bca' ba/ bdag bskyed gsal btab la bzlas pa mthar rjes rim bla ma rig 'dzin sogs nas/ lta bur gyur bar gyi khyer bde'i bka' nges can 'khrul med do// zhes pa 'di yang pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gsung rgyun dang ljags bsgrigs gnang ba bcas spel ba sarba mad+ga laṃ/// / ༈ de ltar rnga rol yod med rnga tshigs rnams 'dir gsal/ tshogs thengs/ bsnyen grangs mang nyung gdangs dbyangs rnams skabs bstun gyis/ gang 'tshams der dpyad pa las ci zhig /zhi rol/ skabs 'dir sum 'phar can bkrol ba dang*/ skabs gdangs rnams kyang rnying lugs kho na dang*/ tshig rnga rnams kyi skabs sngags rnams rdzogs par byed/ gdangs kyi mtha' yang de ltar byed na 'don pa chad lhag mi yong ba'i gnad la dga' ba 'dra ba lags/// / ༈ rab gnas bkra shis char 'bebs kyi 'don 'grigs nges gsal me long bzhugs/ na mo dharmā kā ra ya/ 'dir rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i cho ga las/ rten gang yin de'i mdun slob dpon zhal phyogs la bzhugs/ slob dpon gyi g.yas su bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ de dang gang bde zhig tu pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus/ rnam rgyal bum pa lnga phrag lngas bkang ba/ byang du las bum/ shar nas g.yas skor du phyin drug gi bum pa/ byang du dri ma khrus bum bshams/ phyin drug gi bum par 'bru spos sman rin po che sogs rim bzhin blugs/ rab gnas yi dam gang 'brel gyi gtso bo'i sku mdog gi dar gyis rnam rgyal bum par mgul chings dang*/

las bum yang gzhung nas las lha gang gsungs pa de'i sku mdog gi dar gyi mgul chings bya/ skabs 'dir bde mchog lta bu la sbyar na/ rnam rgyal bum par mgul chings sngo/ las bum dmar/ phyin drug gi bum par mgul chings/ sbyin ser/ tshul dmar/ bzod ljang*/ brtson dmar/ bsam dkar/ shes rab sngo/ dri ma ser/ mchod pa g.yon bskor/ bde mchog skabs/ rgyas par 'byor na dkyil 'khor la mchod pa cha drug /bum dkyil la mchod pa cha gcig gis bskor/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa cha gcig phreng tshar/ bdag bskyed mchod pa cha gcig /phyi rol mchod pa cha gcig /g.yas g.yon gang bde zhig tu stegs kyi khar mnga' dbul ba'i tsakli rnams dang rdzas rtags sogs rim bzhin bshams/ zangs gzhong sogs kyi nang 'bras bkrus pa gur gum chus btsos pa 'bo gang tsam/ dung chos su dri bzang gi chu blug pa dang*/ yungs kar phul gang dang*/ gu gul bcas bshams la zhal 'grims rgyu dgos pa dang*/ tsā ru'i bza' ba/ sbyong chas 'dag chal/ khrus chas/ sku phyi gos zung rnams bshams la dang po/ tshig bdun sogs dang*/ de nas/ bdag nyid sogs nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa thun bsdu bcas song rjes/ dpa' gcig rnam par gyur/ rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ mchod dpon pas bum pa rnams la gu gul bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ sum bha ni sogs/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re sogs/ lha chu dal 'gro sogs oṃ ta he sogs dri bzang gi chus sum gnyis bkang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ sogs/ sngags re dang chu thigs sprad nas lan bdun dung chos su blugs la rgyal rgyam ltar bzhag /rnam rgyal bum pa'i kha rgyan ba lu dang shug pa gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag /gzhan phyin drug gi bum pa rnams kyang go rim ma nor bar bshams/ las bum ku sha'i kha rgyan/ oṃ khan+ḍa sogs bum bskyed bzlas pa bcas/ bzlas pa'i skabs slob dpon gyis gzungs thag 'dzin la bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa tshar nas gzungs thag las bum steng du spos la las bum bzlas pa bcas tshar rjes mthar/

oṃ shrī ri tsakra sogs/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po zhu ba sogs/ dung chos chu rnam rgyal bum par blugs/ puṣ+pe sogs/ ji srid dkyil 'khor sogs gzungs thag dri ma khrus bum gyi steng du bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ de nas gzungs thag bzlas pa so so'i skabs rim gyis spo/ phyin drug sngags so sor bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas/ 'bru rnams rten 'brel sogs/ na mo budhā= ye dharma= sbrel nas brgya rtsa'am tha na nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas/ mchod dpon pas nas 'grim/ thams cad kyis lag pa gnyis ka kha sbub ste reg /oṃ āḥhūm̐ nyer gcig /mchod dpon pas dung chu 'grim/ g.yon srin mdzub kyis reg yungs kar khro bo sogs/ las bum sngags dang*/ khan+ḍa ro hi/ sum+bha ni sgrol ma nyer gcig bzlas/ phu 'grim/ de nas bde mchog gi mdun bskyed kyi rim pa btang*/ bdag 'jug bcas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan sogs/ tshar gsum rjes/ gzugs brnyan gsal la rten rnams zhes tshig kha bsgyur la/ mchod dpon pas slob dpon mdun nam/ rten gyi drung lcog rdog gsum/ mar me/ changs bu bcas gsum bshams la/ slob dpon nam las rdor gyis yar bzhengs la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan sogs/ g.yas g.yon gsum re bskor/ mchod sbyin phyag rgya bya/ se gol brdab/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la sogs de 'dra tshar gsum/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan sogs snga ma ltar bskor/ sum bha ni sogs/ sku gsung thugs kyi spel ma tshar gsum/ de rnams snod gcig tu gsog /sbyong ba phyir dor/ gnas gzhan du 'gro dgos na 'di nas bzhengs la 'don/ 'gro mi dgos na bzhugs la 'don/ rang gi thugs ka nas sogs/ ye shes bskal sogs gzhung bzhin/ gdon mi za nas sbub chol 'bebs bya la/ gnas gzhan la 'gro zhing rab gnas bya dgos na ser sbrengs bya zhing*/ slob dpon gyis sum+bha ni brjod cing*/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug gin byon// slar rang gnas son nas gral du 'khod la/

srung 'khor ni/ sum+bha ni dang yi ge de rnams sogs/ oṃ tsakra prā ka ra hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sbyar ro// de tshe las rdor gyis tshogs pa'i sna rlung g.yas nas sbud par til 'grim la/ me long thog tu til gyis sdig pa'i gzugs byas nas/ g.yas su me/ mdun du til/ g.yon du chu gzhag nas snying gar kaṃ las sogs sngags bzla zhing*/ me chu'i nang dor/ g.yas su ye shes mer bsreg zhes sogs phyi rol du dor/ de nas khrus bya ba ni/ slob dpon nam las rdor gyis phyag len byed la/ stegs kyi khar khrus sder che ba gcig /khrus chu dur ba'i spir sogs bshams/ gos zung dang me long bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin sogs/ rnam rgyal bum chu nas cung zad 'thor/ khrus kyi khang pa sogs kyi tshe me long ngos su ku shas gru bzhir bris/ stong gsum kun sogs nas dur ba'i spir gyis khrus chab nas me long la byugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ sran dkar zan gyis drud/ 'og ma kun la 'gre/ las bum thogs la/ bcom ldan khan+ḍa sogs kyis bkru/ rol mo byed/ khrus ras thogs la/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ sogs dri bzang gis bris la/ me long ngos la khrus ras kyis phyi/ de khrus tshan gcig /stong gsum kun sogs khrus chab sngar ltar byug /snum nag byug /sran dkar gyis drud/ dri ma khrus bum thogs la/ ji ltar bltams sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sogs bar bar du bkrus la/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sogs gong ltar/ khrus tshan gnyis pa/ stong gsum kun sogs/ ri bo ltar ni sogs/ mthar sngags dang rol mo bcas bkru/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sogs khrus tshan gsum/ stong gsum kun/ phar phyin drug sogs bum pa so sor thogs la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs bkru/ chu bo drug gis sogs la dri ma khrus bum gyis bkru/ rol mo dang*/ rgyal dang sogs khrus tshan bzhi pa/ stong gsum kun sogs dri ma khrus bum thogs la/

de bzhin gshegs rnams sogs/ ston mchog dam pa sogs/ nyin mor bde legs sogs sngags bcas rol mo/ rgyal dang rgyal sogs khrus tshan lnga pa/ khrus kyi tshe rol mo 'di yi dam gang yin gyi mchod rnga yin/ srab 'jam yangs pa/ sna tshogs dbang po'i sogs gos zung 'bul/ rten bskyed ni/ rten rnams la las bum chu 'thor nas/ oṃ khan+ḍa sogs bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las sogs nas mtshan par gyur bar/ de nas thams cad yar bzhengs la/ spos thur bkye/ snying khar nyi ma sogs/ spyan drangs bzhugs par gyur/ ma lus sems can/ ji ltar sangs rgyas sogs/ sa maḥyaḥdzaḥhūm̐ḥbam̐ḥhoḥ lag pa bsnol zhing se gol brdab/ rol chen/ mchod rol/ spos thur bsdu/ gral du 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ sh+tsau ka gnyis/ de skabs rten gyi drung du mchod pa gsar du bshams/ bsangs sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs byin rlabs gzhung bzhin mchog gtsang ma sogs/ bcom ldan dpa' bo sogs kyis bstod la de tshe mchod dpon gyis me tog bkye/ thams cad yar bzhengs la gzan zlum khyer byas la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ mthar rol chen bcas me tog 'thor la tshar gsum 'don/ de tshe me long nang du/ rten thams cad shar bcug pa la/ gral la 'khod nas me long dung chos nang gi dri bzang gi chu slob dpon mdun du khyer nas/ rdo rjes dri yi thig le gsum bya/ rten rnams spyi bo'i sogs 'don/ dar dmar ser gyis me long bkab nas bzhag /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra hūm̐/ grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs/ de nas lag mchod/ tshogs byin rlabs/ tshogs btang*/ tshogs phud 'das gtor drung du phul nas gtor bsngos phyag bzhi pa mtshal ma bkra shis bcas tshogs drangs/ lhag ma bsdus nas lhag ma btang*/ rjes chog mchod pa byin rlabs mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol bkra shis bcas dkyus ltar ro// sgrub mchod skabs grol nyin bar gshegs bsdu mi nyan/

grol nyin rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa sku gsung thugs rten la bstim/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba sogs dang*/ phyi nang snga bar 'tshogs la bde mchog bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ 'bru dri yungs gsum byin brlab bya/ mdun bskyed phyi rol pa/ bdag 'jug gi skabs/ gzugs brnyan gsal ba rten rnams ni zhes tshig kha bsgyur ba tshar gsum/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan bcas tshar nas sbyang ba/ khrus/ rten bskyed/ pheṃ/ snying gar sogs/ ma lus sems can sogs/ bcom ldan 'di ni mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchog gtsang ma/ rkang brgyad bstod pa sngar bzhin/ snyan gsan phab la/ rten dgab pa rgyas btab pa sogs dor nas rkang brgyad bstod pa'i tshe las rdor gyis spos dang me tog bkye/ thams cad yar bzhengs nas gzan zlum khyer byas nas lag tu me tog bcas thal mo sbyar la/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das sogs nas gsol bar me tog 'thor zhing mchod rol bcas tshar gsum mthar/ byon nas kyang*/ sogs/ gang 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan sogs/ mtshams mtshams su rol mo dang me tog 'thor/ gral du 'khod nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga sogs/ oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka sogs nas/ rū pi ni ye'i bar bzlas pa rnams bzlas/ bzlas pa'i tshe ser sbrengs kyi grabs dang*/ ngo mtshar chen po sogs 'don/ de tshe me tog bkye/ ngo mtshar chen po tshar nas/ thams cad yar bzhengs nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes pa dang dam tshig dbyer med gyur sogs nas rnam dag go// rol mo 'bebs gcig byas nas slar sum brdung dal ran gyis ser phreng gshar/ na mo bud+dha ya sogs brjod cing phyag nas gang dgos sar 'thor/ spos sna/ slob dpon/ me tog gi snod bcas khyer/ tshur 'khor ba dang*/ thams cad rang mal nas bzhengs la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs/ gzhan yang bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ me tog 'thor la/ mthar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sogs gral du 'khod nas/ khar sang gi me long de slob dpon mdun du bzhag nas/

dbang rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ bcom ldan yab kyi go sogs bum pa'i dbang rten la bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyur zhes pa'i bar/ rten gyi me long de la dung chos nang gi dri bzang chus thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rten rnams kyi spyi bor sogs 'don/ de nas gser gyi thur mas slob dpon gyis spyan dbye tshul byas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan sogs dang*/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i sogs/ sku zhabs nas spyan dbye/ zhal phye sogs 'og nas 'byung ba rnams 'dir byas na rung yang*/ spyan dbye byas pas 'thus pa yin gsungs/ slob dpon gyis rten la rdo rjes reg cing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas gyur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas rten zhal bsgyur la/ mgon po bskal pa sogs dril gsil bcas/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i sogs brjod/ de skabs mchod dpon pas rten gyi drung mchod pa chu bzhi bcas cha gcig bshams/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gzhung ltar 'jig rten khams 'dir sogs/ mchod yon/ 'jig rten khams sogs/ zhabs bsil/ a tsa ma naṃ/ 'jig rten/ bsang gtor/ prok+ṣa na/ 'jig rten/ zhabs bsil/ pad+yaṃ sogs sbyar/ de 'phros gzhung ltar mthar mchod rol bya/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na sogs gdangs 'then/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad sogs/ rin chen gdugs dang sogs/ kha dog ma/ shab+da'i bar skabs rnga rol bcas kyi

mtshams rgyag / de las gzhan yang sogs mchod rol/ sems can rnams la brtse ba sogs/ dril gsil dang rol mo/ dkon mchog rjes dran 'don zhing*/ bstod pa'i dril gsil 'geb gdangs dang bcas pas/ gang gi drin sogs rol mo/ de nas mnga' dbul ba'i tsakli rnams snod nang du nas blugs pa'i nang du bzhag pa/ mchod dpon pas lag tu rang rang tshig don ltar gyi ma nor bar 'dzin la rten gyi drung du rim bzhin dbul/ maṇ+ḍal bzung la/ sa gzhi spos chu sogs/ khrus chal bzung la stong gsum kun sogs/ na bza' bzung la sna tshogs dbang po sogs dang*/ de nas kyang go rim bzhin tsakli ma nor bar/ mi dbang rin chen sogs/ theg mchog bla bre sogs/ lha mi dbang po sogs/ gzugs sgra dri ro sogs/ lnga phrag lnga/ rgyal ba mgon po sogs/ rin chen du ma'i sogs mchod rol/ de nas mnga' dbul rnams rim bzhin/ nye ring mi mnga' sogs dang*/ rol mo/ 'di phyin kun la mtshams su rol mo dgos/ rgyal ba'i dbu skra sogs/ bde gshegs sdug bsngal sogs/ srog shing sogs nas gdan gyi bar mchod rten gyi mnga' dbul phul/ rin chen du ma sogs glegs bam nang glegs thag bar gyi mnga' dbul phul/ rol mo/ de nas lag mchod tshogs byin rlabs/ tshogs/ de ltar 'bad bar 'don la/ de nas 'o thug sgrub pa ni/ sbyin sreg thab nang du/ lcags sgyed kyi steng rdza so ma dkar rtsi byugs la bkra shis rtags brgyad bris pa btsugs la/ nang du 'o ma/ 'bras blug /ka ra dang sbrang btab la/ dge slong zhig gis zhwa khra chos gos gyon nas bskol/ sbyin sreg tshar nas rtsa ri'i bza' ba la sogs phud dang*/ 'o thug bran nas/ na maḥsarba sogs/ tshar gcig /zhal zas ro brgya sogs/ zhal zas rten gyi drung du phul/ rol mo/ de nas 'o thug drangs/ de nas rten la gzungs thag btags nas/ na ma bud+dha yā sogs/ ye dharma sogs nyer gcig /su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs nyer gcig /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ sogs nyer gcig re bzlas/

bkra shis kha shas brjod/ me tog 'thor/ de nas bde mchog gi 'das gtor/ gtor bsngos 'bul/ phyag bzhi pa gzhung ltar 'don/ mtshal ma mngon rtogs spyan 'dren sogs bkra shis bar dkyus ltar/ de nas tshogs la longs spyod/ lhag ma rjes chog bkra shis bcas rnams nub snga ma bzhin byas la/ chos skyong gi rten gtor de slob dpon gyi drung du btegs la/ chos skyong ba'i sogs brjod nas rol chen bcas rten gyi drung du mar zhal gyu/ grol nyin mtshal ma dang bkra shis tshar nas chos skyong bsgo ba sogs nas gzhung bzhin bya/ de skabs rten gyi drung du mchod pa gsar bshams me tog dam pa sogs sho lo ka gsum/ rol mo bya/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras sogs tshar gsum/ de nas yon bdag bos la/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol sogs/ rdo rje lag tu gtad/ de nas yon bdag kun gral du 'khod nas/ me long las rdor gyi lag pa dar sogs rten khebs kyi dgab pas 'dzin la/ dbu mdzad pas sngon yang dag par sogs nas dkyus ltar ro// mtshams su rol mo/ dang po rdzas de rten gyi drung du 'bul tshul/ de nas slob dpon gyis reg /de nas yon bdag gis reg la sbyin bdag gi mdun stegs kyi khar bzhag pa'am/ rten gyi drung gang bder bzhag na'ang chog /kun la 'gre/ bkra shis gang zhig /lha rdzas las byas sogs/ de rnams thams cad la bar bar du mchod rol/ de nas tshogs la rol nas bkra shis ni/ ston mchog dam pa dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod/ bden grub ma gyer/ lhag ma btang*/ rjes chog bkra shis bcas gzhung ltar byas pas 'grub pa yin// bum pa'i nang du blug rgyu dri bzang gi chu/ rin po che'i snod kyi nang du/ sug smel/ shing tshwa/ spang spos/ ba le ka /tsan dan dkar dmar rnams thum po bcings/ chu gtsang ni bre phyed brgyad bskol ba'i gzhi gsum du bsdus pa'i chu yin/

de ltar ma grub na gur gum sbyar/ khrus chal ni/ 'o zho mar sbrang ka ra ste bdud rtsi lnga'o/ ba dmar zal gyi 'o ma/ zho/ mar/ lci ba/ gcin lnga ni ba byung lnga'o// dri bzang kyu ru ra'i phye ma sogs/ dur wa'i spir ni dur ba chun po'o// lar rab gnas gong bshad de ka ni nyin grangs sogs bya ba'i 'don lugs la/ de las bsdus pa dngos sta sbrel ma sogs nyin gcig gis tshar ba byed na/ dang po yo byad sogs bshams pa nas snyan gsan dbab pa yan sta gon skabs ltar dkyus bzhin byas la/ rgyas gdab pa dang rten dgab pa dor bas/ dngos gzhi drug gi dang po nas bzung 'di ltar sogs nas/ rten zhal bsgyur ba'i nang gi/ mchod pa shab+da'i bar/ de nas ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ dkon mchog spyi bstod/ sems brtse ma dang dkon mchog rjes dran tsam gyi rjes/ cho ga'i gzhung gang yin de nyid dang dkyil 'khor pa la sogs pa'i gtor ma so so'i cho gas 'bul zhing*/ de nas chos skyong bgo ba sogs rab gnas dang dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog rnams gong bshad dang 'dra ba yin/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i skabs nang par zhes pa la da lta zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ rab gnas kyi cho ga'i 'don 'grigs phyag len dang bcas pa 'di/ rje nyid kyi phyag len dang zhal khrid ji lta ba bzhin bris pa yin/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ gu ru rdo rje gro lod kyi zlog mdos skabs ḍā dril phyag rgyun zin tho yod/ nyin dang po/ dkar gtor hūm̐ steng gi lha sogs sh+tsau ka re'i mtshams dril gsil/ a la la dril gsil dang bcas sil snyan 'ur brdung skabs ḍā dril/ rkang dung med/ bgegs gtor na mo dkon mchog la 'gugs pa'i rgya dang dril gsil bcas lan gsum/ nyon cig sogs gong ltar dril gsil/ sarba bi ghan+na dril gsil rol mo 'ur brdung bar bkrol/ rkang dung rol mo 'ur brdung sngon ma dang rjes ma la 'bud/
