mkha' ltar dag gyur cig mthar ḍā dril/ byin 'bebs skye med chos dbyings bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ mthar ḍā dril/ sngon bskal ma'i 'gor ḍā dril/ sngon bskal tshar gsum dang*/ gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ chos dbyings bde chen sogs la'ang bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ sngags la dril gsil dang mthar rol mo ḍā dril/ gro lod spyan 'dren sngags dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ sngags la dril bsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ gong 'og thams cad kyi bsnyen pa rnams kyi 'gor rol mo 'ur brdung skabs rkang dung mi dgos par khyad par yin/ mkha' 'gro'i spyan 'dren sngon mar sngags dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ spyan 'dren gnyis pa yang de mtshungs/ spyan 'dren gsum par yang de bzhin/ tshogs kyi nang bla ma yi dam nas dpon slob dang las rdor gnyis kas rdor dril dang 'gugs pa'i rgya dril gsil 'ur brdung gsum ka dgos/ da ni snang srid bzhi mtshams dril gsil stangs stabs dang bcas/ gdangs 'then skabs kun bzang klong zer ba'i rol mo lte skor skabs/ rnga gdangs dang bstun pa'i thing brdung dgos/ mthar sngags dril gsil bcas/ zhal bstab rnams la'ang bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ mthar rol mo dang dril gsil/ las mgon spyan 'dren sngags la dril gsil dang g.yab dar g.yugs/ rol mo dang bstun ḍā dril/ bskul lo 'bod kyi mthar ma hā kā la sogs ḍā dril/ dzam ser phyin rkang dung mi dgos/ shab+da la dril gsil/ tshe 'gugs dang*/ bkra shis la sh+tsau ka re'i mtshams dril gsil/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya la dril gsil/ ye shes lha tshogs mthar ḍā dril/ ma mgon gtor bsngos la/ rol mo rdul sprugs gsum la dril gsil/ de nas rol chen ḍā dril/ a las thod pa hūm̐ yig 'don na ḍā dril/ bder gshegs 'dus pa sogs dang khor yug bcas pa'i mthar dril gsil gnyis/ shab+da la dril gsil/ zhing skyong chen po bzhi mtshams dril gsil/

gsol ka nang rnga 'ur dang*/ mtshams rgyag rnams dang bstun pa'i ḍā dril/ skong bar ḍā dril/ bkug gzhug dril gsil dang rbad sngags zhabs dril gsil bcas/ nyin bzhin 'don lugs la'ang snga ma dang 'dra zhing*/ kun bzang nang*/ sngags la dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ 'khor 'das ye stong mthar sngags dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ rtsa gsum gzhan rnams kyang snga ma dang mtshungs/ zlog pa'i 'gor rkang dung bzhi 'bud/ de nas rol chen bcas/ zla gam dmar nag mtha'i sngags la dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ gsol lo mchod do snang srid lha 'dre'i mthar rol mo dang dril gsil rkyang pa/ 'gug gzhug gsum la dril gsil/ phur bskyed sngags la dril gsil/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin lha dbye'i mthar dril gsil/ 'o dam nyams ru tra sogs phur gdab bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ liṅga bsgral/ gnas spar phaṭa rnams la dril gsil/ zhal bstab la'ang bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ mthar rol mo dang dril gsil/ tshar grangs gsog dus rol mo rkang dung mnyam pa las zur du mi dgos/ las mgon gtor rbad tshar rjes ma'i rol chen 'ur brdung sngon ma dang rjes ma la rkang dung 'bud lugs de ltar dgos/ gtor rgyag nyin/ gser skyems rol mo 'bebs gnyis mar dril gsil de mtshungs/ skong ba'i tha tshig rnams la bzhi mtshams dril gsil dang*/ rol mo 'ur rdung la dril gsil/ zhal chems las 'gyed mthar rol mo dril gsil/ bskul lo rbad mthar rol mo dril gsil/ ser sbrengs byas na g.yab dar g.yab/ dril gsil dang yi dam mgon po'i sngags rnams 'don bzhin 'gro/ de nas dgug gzhug dang gser skyems zor 'phen rnams rol mo dang bstun pa'i dril gsil bya/ gtor bro dang*/ rgyal dbyangs rol mo dang bstun dril gsil gang 'os/ dngos grub len dbang bla ma rig 'dzin thog mthar rol mo ḍā dril/ bar mtshams sngags rnams la'ang dril gsil bcas/ me hom skabs rang rig rdo rje gro lod mthar/

rol mo ḍā dril/ spyan 'dren sngags dril gsil dang rol mo ḍā dril/ bkug gzhug dang zhal phye'i mthar yang rol mo dril gsil/ las mgon spyan 'dren snga rjes gnyis la ḍā dril/ zhal phye'i mtha' yang dril gsil/ yas zor skabs mdos bskyed snang srid 'khor 'das mtha'i sngags rnams dril gsil dang*/ rol mo ḍā dril bkug bzhug rnams dang zhal bstab rnams la dril gsil re/ ma hā kā la'i spyan 'dren sngags kyi skabs dril gsil dang*/ g.yab dar g.yab rgyu sngags brgya rtsa 'don ring la dgos/ de phyin mi dgos/ thal brdeb gang dgos thams cad la bya'o// grol nyin mdos sgo dbye'i mthar dril gsil/ gzhan rnams thams cad zlog pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o// zhes sngon gyi phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa las byung ba'i de tshul ma nor bar rtsa gsum dgyes pa'i rol mor 'gyur bas/ kun nas nges par zhu/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ tshes bcu le'u brgyad ma'i ḍā dril bkrol lugs phyag len tho yod/ sa bdag lha klu'i mthar dril gsil re dang*/ rjes mar bhū mi pa ti sbrel ma'i dril gsil rol mo 'ur brdung nas dril bu bzhag /mchod sngags shab+da la ḍā dril/ spyan 'dren badz+ra gu ru'i dzab dbyangs gsum mthar rol mo 'bebs dang bstun ḍā dril/ mchod sngags shab+da la ḍā dril/ tshogs dang po bar pa gnyis gdangs mi 'then dus so so'i mthar ḍā dril bya/ tshogs tha mar 'gug gzhug la slob dpon dang las rdor bcas pas dril gsil dang*/ che mchog pad+ma tshig gnyis mtshams dril gsil/ sngags mthar dril gsil bcas/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog ḍā ru dbu mdzad kyis bkrol bas 'thus shing*/ mgon po'i gtor bsngos skabs spyan 'dren ḍā dril/ gsang sngags nang gtor mtha'i dril gsil rnams dang*/ ma ning spyan 'dren la ḍā dril mchod sngags shab+da la dril gsil/ zhing skyong spyan 'dren rol mo 'bebs gnyis dang bstun pa'i ḍā dril/

bdud dmag stong sde'i mthar yang ḍā dril/ mgon po'i skong ba ḍā dril/ zhing skyong skong ba ḍā dril/ dgug gzhug lan lngar dril gsil/ sngags rnams la dril gsil/ bkra shis tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil re dang mthar ḍā dril bya'o// de ltar phyag rgyun ma 'phyug pa las g.yas chung ci byung mi mdzad par zhu/// / ༈ dpal ye shes mgon po'i dgu gtor chen mo'i skabs kyi ḍā dril zin tho bzhugs// thog mar yi dam phag mo'i skabs ḍā dril mthong rgyun spyi 'gro rol mo dang bstun cing*/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal rnams la dril gsil dang*/ phyag rgya dmigs bsal nang mchod g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ rdor dril 'dzin bzhin 'khyud rgya mthar se gol/ mgon po'i srung 'khor nang gi 'gug gzhug 'dis mtshon bden stobs brjod sa gar yod la dril gsil rigs 'gre'o// mngon rtogs nas spyan 'dren rol mo rdul sprugs gsum la dril gsil bcas de nas ḍā dril/ mchod pa byin rlabs mthar ḍā dril/ gsang sngags nang gtor mtha'i bder gshegs 'dus pa'i dang*/ khor yug bcas pa'i sngags la dril gsil// shab+da la'ang dril gsil/ zhing skyong chen po tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ sngags bdag nang shab+da dril gsil/ mkhar nag shab+da dril gsil/ gsol ka dang*/ skong ba rol mo dang bstun ḍā dril/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i rdzas sogs dang*/ rang gi thugs ka sogs bsgral las skabs slob dpon rkyang pas rol mo 'bebs rnams la dril gsil/ thams cad gzigs dang*/ sras mchog rigs zhal bstab rnams la tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ 'gug gzhug skabs bla ma thams cad nas dril gsil dgos/ lhag ma'i mthar rol mo ḍā dril bcas/ 'phar ma rgyas pa 'don nyin khyad par ni/ skabs gsum grong sngags mthar rol mo sum brdung de bstun ḍā dril/ zhing skyong chen po'i tshig thams cad dril gsil che chung can bya/

lha mo'i gsol ka la'ang ḍā dril/ phag mo'i tshogs la dril gsil rnams dang*/ rol mo ḍā dril/ lhag gdangs skabs thog mthar rol mo dgu ba rdung bzhin pa'i ḍā dril dang bar mtshams la rnga tshig ltar ḍā dril/ mchod sngags mthar ḍā dril/ bstod par bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ yig brgya la dril gsil/ bkra shis la dril gsil mthar ḍā dril bcas bya'o// de ltar sngar gyi phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa 'di bzhin nyams su bstar ba las/ sngags bon grong chog mkhan gyi spyod 'gros nam yang mi 'tshal lo// shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ kar gling zhi khro tshogs skabs ḍā dril zin tho la/ dang po dkar gtor lam shab+da la ḍā dril/ lha klu sogs tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil dang*/ mthar ḍā dril bya/ 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas ṭā ki hūm̐ dza dril gsil/ shab+da ḍā dril/ nyon cig sogs bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ mthar dril gsil rol mo 'bebs dang bstun par bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs shab+da la ḍā dril/ spyan 'dren skabs rol chen rnga tshig rnams dang bsgrig nas ḍā dril der mthun dgos pa khyad par dang*/ gshegs su gsol gyi mthar yang ḍā dril/ sde bdun nang khram ltar bskyed la ḍā dril/ bshags ba'i mthar ga na tsakra sogs la ḍā dril/ tshogs kyi 'gug gzhug la dril gsil dang*/ chos sku zhi ba dang*/ bla ma kun bzang sogs tshig gsum mtshams dril gsil dang*/ rol zhabs dril gsil/ zhi skong rnam shes phung po sogs le tshan rnams kyang mthar ḍā dril/ drag skong mthar mchod rol dang bstun pa'i ḍā dril/ phur pa gdengs mthar rol mo 'bebs bstun ḍā dril bya/ gnas 'dren skabs 'gugs pa'i rgya dang bcas/ bden stobs gsum mthar dril gsil/ sangs rgyas mthu stobs nas 'gugs pa'i rgya bcas badz+ra sa twa sogs dril gsil/ gnas spar gyi dril gsil/ gzhan du dengs mthar dril gsil/ rang nyid lha yi bzhi mtshams dril gsil dang mthar dril gsil/

khrus dang dug bcom bzhi mtshams dril gsil dang*/ sngags rnams la'ang dril gsil/ byang phyag skabs kyang dril gsil/ gtor ma phyir phul skabs dril gsil/ dug bcom khrus dang sa bcad rnams so so'i sngags la dril gsil/ bum dbang sogs la'ang mtshams su dril gsil/ zas bsngo ba'i mtha' dril gsil/ gsur mchod skabs ḍā dril/ ting 'dzin shugs dang byang bsreg lam ston sogs la'ang tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ phaṭa nas mchod rol ḍā dril/ lhag ma bar mtshams 'gug gzhug skabs dril gsil/ bkra shis tshig gnyis mtshams dril gsil dang mthar ḍā dril bya'o// de ltar phyag rgyun mthong rgyun bzhin bkod pa sor gnas pa zhig las gang mos byung rgyal gyi spyod pa mi rigs pa nges par zhu/ sarba mad+ga lam/// / ༈ pad+ma badz+ra gyi ḍā dril la/ nyin dang po thig gdab dang rdul tshon byin rlabs mthar ḍā dril/ bgegs gtor la 'gugs pa'i rgya dang dril gsil gsum*/ a ba lo ki la mchod spyin rgya/ ga te bh+yo la phyag rgya spyi 'gro/ nyon cig tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ phyir dengs shig nas bzung rol mo 'bebs sngon ma ma rdzogs bar dril gsil/ steng gi lha bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ 'grub par mdzod nas sngags la'ang dril gsil/ rol mo sum 'phar la ḍā dril rol gdan mtshams nas bzhag /skyabs 'gro la thal sbyar/ yig brgya pa'i mthar rol mo 'bebs chen dang ḍā dril/ 'og min chos dbyings tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil dang mda' dar g.yab/ mthar ḍā dril/ mdun bskyed spyan 'dren sngags la dril gsil/ mthar rol mo dang ḍā dril/ mda' dar g.yab cing sngon bskal ma gdangs kyi skabs gnyis mtshams/ gdangs thung dang hrug 'don la bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ 'di rigs kun la dgos/ rab 'byams rgyal ba la'ang de bzhin dang*/ gdangs 'then skabs sngon bskal ma'i 'gor zhi khro'i spyan 'dren rol chen dang bstun ḍā dril 'ur brdung rjes ma'i mtha' bar bkrol/

mthar sngags dang tshig lhug la dril gsil/ slar rol chen skabs ḍā dril/ lar dbyangs gdangs rdzogs mtshams so so'i rol tshig la ḍā dril mi bya bar 'bebs kyi skabs nas dkrol dgos/ bzhugs gsol dgyes shing mi g.yo nas phyag rgya/ rje btsun pad+ma dang badz+ra gnyis la thal sbyar mchod sngags mthar ḍā dril/ bum dkyil spyan 'dren sngags la dril gsil dang*/ rol chen skabs ḍā dril/ he ru ka dpal nas bzhugs su gsol bar mda' dar dril gsil/ bdag dang mtha' yas mtshams gnyis thal sbyar/ thod dkyil spyan 'dren rol chen ḍā dril/ 'og min chos dbyings bzhugs su gsol bar mda' dar dril gsil/ bzhugs gsol phyag rgya/ phyag 'tshal bstod dang po la/ thal sbyar/ gsung dkyil de las 'od zer phyin mda' dar dril gsil/ bzhugs su gsol la dang po phyag rgya/ rten chos shig la thal sbyar/ sku dang thig le phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsum kar ḍā dril rol chen la rnga tshig dang bstun pa'i ḍā dril so sor dgos/ rigs kun khyab bdag yongs rdzogs la thal mo sbyar/ sgra'i mchod pa'i skabs su/ rkang gling sogs tshig rkang gsum la ḍā dril bkrol/ mngon gyur shog nas ḍā dril/ thugs rje brtse ba nas/ skye ba'i sgo chod cig bar thal sbyar/ bshags pa tshan gsum gar thal sbyar/ skong bshags kyi 'go rnams su ḍā dril dang*/ yongs rdzogs tshar mtshams su a bhi'i mthar ḍā dril/ tshogs kyi smon lam la thal sbyar/ bla ma rig 'dzin la thal sbyar dang sngags rnams dril gsil gyis kā ya a bhi sogs kyis bum pa gnas bzhir gtug cing bum chu btung*/ kā ya badz+ra sogs kyis sgrub dkyil po ti mgrin par gtug /kro ta rā dza nas tsakli rnams snying khar gtug /bkra shis mthar ḍā dril bya'o// gnas 'dren skabs tshogs kyi smon lam tshar mtshams su gsol 'debs chos dbyings rang byung ma thal sbyar/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ sogs 'gugs pa'i rgya dang dril gsil re/

nga ni pad+ma gnyis mtshams dril gsil/ dengs shig nas rol mo 'bebs bstun dril gsil/ yang nga ni pad+ma sogs gnyis mtshams dril gsil/ rdul du rlog nas dril gsil rol mo 'bebs bstun/ 'di ni pad+ma sogs gnyis mtshams dril gsil/ rdul du rlog nas dril gsil rol mo 'bebs bstun/ 'di ni pad+ma sogs la sngags gang yod la dril gsil/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ mthar yang dril gsil dang sngags brjod dgos/ gnas spar skabs tshig mtshams rnams dril gsil mthar zhi rol dang ḍā dril/ 'dod yon bsngo skabs grag stong sgra snyan mtha'i sangs rgyas shog la ḍā dril/ dbyer med shog nas kyang ḍā dril/ lam bstan skabs rdor dril 'dzin bzhin thal sbyar dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad phyin chad tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ tshe gcig gyur nas rol mo dkrol ḍā dril bya// byang bu bsreg tshe khyod kyi ma dag phyin la'ang bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ mthar sngags byin gsum so sor tshar gsum 'don tshe dril gsil dang bcas byang bur bsregs/ mthar ḍā dril rol mo dang bstun/ slob ma dbang bskur skong bshags tshar nas bla ma rig 'dzin gyis bdag 'jug len/ slob ma 'tshogs nas/ sngon 'gro tshan gnyis srung 'khor bcas rnga rol nyin ltar dang*/ sgo dbye ba'i skabs tshig bzhi mtshams dril gsil/ dkyil 'khor mtha'i mda' dar bzhi rim par g.yab cing len/ des na dpon slob mnyam 'don dgos/ spyan 'dren sngon bskal ma nas khengs par gyur bar rnga rol nyin ltar gyis mnyam 'don/ mnga' gsol skabs zhi rol ḍā dril/ bkra shis mnyam 'don mthar ḍā dril/ bar mtshams kyi dril gsil skabs bstun 'brel chags par bya'o// sarba mad+ga lam/// / ༈ ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje ber nag can gyi drag mdos dgra chos su grags pa'i mdos dkris kyi zin bris bzhugs// na moḥ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ srid pa'i drwa ba ye shes 'khor los gcod// sdang ba'i zug rngu byams pa'i sman gyis bcos// bdag cag rnams la ngur smrig gar rol ba// dpal ldan bla ma ma hā kā las skyongs// de la 'dir dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje ber nag po can gyi drag mdos dgra chos su grags pa dge 'dun zur ri'i lugs gyi phyag srol las byung ba mthong brgyud bar ma chad par kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed yab sras nas brgyud pa rnams rang blos ji ltar dpog pa reg zig tu dgod pa la gsum ste/

dang po ni stegs bu gru bzhi pa bang rim bzhi'i steng du/ gtor zhal gyi srog shing*/ 'og tu gtor stegs la 'dzugs rgyu phur bu mtho phyed do sogs ji ltar 'tshams yas dang*/ steng du 'khor shing cha phran gnyis tsam 'khor lo'i srab mthug dang bstun nas/ zhal brnyan gyi srog shing dngos la cha chen bcu gcig pa/

de rnams kyi sbu gu ni so so'i rtsibs drug tu 'gro ba las zur du sbu gu la cha chen gnyis bzhag dgos pa min/ mchan/ steng du sbu gu cha chen gnyis dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du gdugs che ba'i rtsibs la 'phred rgya cha chen brgyad dang ldan pa la rtsibs rnams kyi sner gdugs sham cha chen lnga dang cha chung gsum yod pa phyir gyed kyi rnam pa brgyad 'dzugs/ gdugs sham de rnams kyi 'phred rgya yang cha chen bcu gnyis dang cha phran gsum tsam 'byung*/ thod gdan cha chen gnyis re yod pa brgyad cung zad phyir gyed kyi rnam pas 'dzugs// de'i steng du tsit+ta la mas sne phud bu cha chen gnyis/ snal 'dus cha chung gnyis lhag tsam dang*/ yas sne yang snal 'dus cha chung gnyis tsam yod pa/ 'khor shing cha phran phyed gnyis tsam steng gi gdugs 'khor gyi lte ba'i srab mthug dang bstun dgos/ 'di la'ang sbu gu cha chen gcig dang cha phran gsum 'ong dgos/ de'i bar du tsit+ta dngos la cha chen brgyad yod pa la/ 'og nas cha chen gnyis dang cha phran gcig gzhal mtshams thur ma cha chen bzhi dang cha phran gcig gdugs gnyis ka'i rtsibs kyi 'phred rgya ni phyi mthar nas phyi mthar gzhal ba yin/ mchan/ yod pa brgyad 'dzug pa/ de'i steng du gdugs chung la rtsibs kyi 'phred rgya cha chen drug dang cha chung phyed gnyis cung med tsam/ gdugs sham cha chen gsum dang cha phran phyed tsam yod pa brgyad/ 'di'i gdugs sham dang tsit+ta gdugs 'og ma'i thod gdan rnams kyi sne mo bcas 'phred rgya mnyam pa zhig dgos/ de'i steng du khyung tshang la mas sner phud bu cha chen gcig dang cha phran gsum/ snal 'dus cha chung gnyis lhag tsam/ yas sner snal 'dus cha chung gnyis lhag tsam dang*/ de'i bar du khyung tshang dngos la cha chen bdun yod pa la/ cha phran bdun re'i mtshams na thur ma bzhi re 'dzug pas steng 'og rim gsum la khyon thur ma bcu gnyis 'byung*/ thur ma de rnams kyi sne mo'ang steng 'og gnyis po mtshams dang dbus ma phyogs su bstan dgos/

ring thung ni dbus ma'i thur ma bzhi la cha chen gsum cha phran gsum tsam dgos/ steng 'og gi thur ma brgyad po la de las cha phran lhag tsam thung na legs/ 'di la sbu gu cha chen gnyis nges par dgos/ de'i steng du dpal be'u la cha chen drug dang cha phran re yod pa'i thur ma drug re phan tshun bsnol ba la khyon thur ma bcu gnyis dgos/ de'i steng du zla ba la leb chags zla ba gam pa lta bu zhig la sne mo gnyis dang phyi nas rim bzhin rtsibs ji ltar 'tshams pa tshugs/ de'i steng du nyi ma dang nor bu mig gsum bcas pa lte ba zlum po leb chags la phyi nas thur ma brgyad re 'dzugs dgos dpal be'u/ khyung tshang*/ gdugs chung ba'i thod ra bcas 'phred rgya mnyam pa zhig 'ong*/ gnyis pa ni/ snal ma ji ltar dkri pa'i tshul bshad par bya'o// de la gdugs gnyis kyi lte ba ni rtsibs rnams cha gsum rer bgos pa'i lte ba'i phyir nas cha gnyis re'i mtshams bar rtsibs rnams re re bzhin snal mas dkyud rgyab nas sgor mor bskor nas 'gro dgos pas de shes sla/ de nas gdugs 'og ma'i phyi'i cha gcig lus pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'ong dgos pas/ de ni rtsibs gang yang rung ba zhig la rtsibs dang po zhes ngos 'dzin/ de nas gnyis nas brgyad pa'i bar ma nor bar byas/ rtsibs dang po la snal ma 'dogs nas/ rtsibs gnyis pa'i steng nas song*/ gsum pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ bzhi pa'i steng nas song*/ lnga pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ drug pa'i steng nas song*/ bdun pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ brgyad pa'i steng nas song*/ slar yang dang po la dkyud gcig rgyab/ gnyis pa la'ang dkyud gcig rgyab/ gsum pa'i steng nas song*/ bzhi pa la dkyud rgyab pa rigs 'gres nas/ brgyad pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ dang po'i steng nas song*/ gnyis pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ gsum pa la dkyud gcig rgyab/ bzhi pa'i steng nas song*/ lnga pa la dkyud rgyab pa rigs 'gres pas pad 'dab ji lta ba zhig 'ong*/

gdugs steng ma'i rtsibs rnams ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad yong dgos/ de yang snga ma ltar rtsibs gang yang rung ba/ dang por byas pa'i rtsibs dang po la snal ma 'dogs/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa'i steng nas song*/ bzhi pa la dkyud/ lnga pa dang drug pa'i steng nas song*/ bdun pa la dkyud/ brgyad pa dang dang po'i steng nas song*/ gnyis pa la dkyud rgyab pa song*/ mdor na pad 'dab ni snga ma dang steng ma'i sne 'phrad mtshams ma gtogs rtsibs re re bor ba'i sar dkyud dgos/ 'phrad mtshams rnams bor rgyu med/ 'khor lo ni rtsibs gnyis re bor nas dkyud pa mthar chags su 'gro chog /gdugs sham ni che chung gnyis ka 'dra bar/ rtsibs gang yang rung ba dang por byas pa'i/ brgyad pa'i bar ngos zin par bya/ de yang thur ma rnams ring thung snyoms par cha lnga re bgos pa'i bar rnams su mtshan ma byas pas rtags bzhi 'byung/ de nas thur ma dang po rtags dang po la snal ma 'dogs/ thur ma gnyis pa'i rtags gnyis par dkyud/ gsum pa'i gsum par dkyud/ bzhi pa'i rtags bzhi par dkyud pa'i bar gyen du yar 'gro/ lnga pa'i rtags bzhi pa'i steng nas song*/ drug pa'i rtags bzhi par dkyud/ bdun pa'i rtags gsum par dkyud/ brgyad pa'i rtags gnyis par dkyud/ dang po'i rtags dang por dkyud bar thur du mar song*/ de nas gnyis pa'i rtags dang por dkyud/ gsum pa'i gnyis pa nas/ lnga ba'i bzhi pa bar gyen du yar dkyud/ drug pa'i steng nas/ bdun pa'i bzhi pa nas mar gnyis pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ gsum pa'i dang po'i steng nas yar drug pa'i bzhi pa bar gyen du dkyud/ bdun pa'i bzhi steng nas song*/ brgyad pa'i bzhi pa nas mar/ gsum pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ bzhi pa'i dang po nas yar/ bdun pa'i bzhi pa bar gyen du dkyud/ brgyad pa'i bzhi steng nas/ dang po'i bzhi pa nas mar gsum pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ bzhi pa'i dang po nas yar/

brgyad pa'i bzhi pa bar gyen du dkyud/ dang po'i bzhi pa'i steng nas song*/ gnyis pa'i bzhi pa nas mar/ lnga pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ drug pa'i dang po nas yar/ dang po'i dang po bar gyen du dkyud/ gnyis pa'i bzhi steng nas song*/ gsum pa'i bzhi pa nas mar/ drug pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ bdun pa'i dang po nas yar/ gnyis pa'i bzhi pa bar gyen du dkyud/ gsum pa'i bzhi steng nas song*/ bzhi pa'i bzhi pa nas mar/ bdun pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ brgyad pa'i dang po nas yar/ gsum pa'i bzhi pa bar gyen du dkyud/ bzhi pa'i bzhi steng nas song*/ lnga pa'i bzhi pa nas mar/ brgyad pa'i dang po bar thur du dkyud/ dang po'i dang po dkyud pas snal ma rkyang 'ded kyi bskor ba gcig 'khor bas/ snga ma ltar dang po'i dang po nas gyen du 'gro ba sogs 'gro lugs gcig po des 'thus/ thod gdan ni/ rtsibs dang po la snal ma 'dogs/ phyi nas dkris skor gcig byas/ gnyis pa la dkyud/ yang dkris skor gcig byas/ gsum par dkyud/ yang dkris skor nas bzhi pas lnga bar dkyud par sogs rim gyis byas nas brgyad par dkyud pa'i sar song nas dkris bskor gyis dang por dkyud pa sogs snga ma ltar byas pas shes sla/ tsit+ta ni 'og gi snal 'dus kyi them la snal ma 'dogs nas/ rtsibs gang rung zhig dang por byas pa'i rtsibs dang po la dkyud gcig rgyab/ steng nas len/ rtsibs gnyis par dkyud/ 'og nas len/ yang dang por dkyud nas steng gi srog shing gi snal 'dus sar dkyud/ slar yang rtsibs dang po la dkyud nas 'og gi snal 'dus sar dkyud/ rtsibs gnyis par dkyud/ steng nas len/ gsum par dkyud/ 'og nas len/ yang gnyis par dkyud nas steng gi snal 'dus mtshams su dkyud/ slar yang gnyis par dkyud/ 'og gi snal 'dus mtshams su dkyud nas/ rtsibs gsum par dkyud nas steng du len sogs sngar gyi 'gros de ma nor bar rim gyis 'ded pas 'thus/

khyung tshang ni dbus ma'i rtsibs gang red cig shar phyogs kyi rtsibs su ngos 'dzin pa des lho nub byang bcas shes/ des steng 'og /rtsibs rnams shar lho phyogs mtshams su bstan pa yang ma nor bar brtags/ de nas 'og gi srog shing snal 'dus su snal ma 'dogs nas yar/ 'og gi shar lho rtsibs la dkyud gcig /de nas gyen du rim bzhin dbus ma'i shar gyi rtsibs las dkyud/ steng ma'i byang shar gyi rtsibs la dkyud gcig brgyab nas steng gi srog shing gi snal 'dus mtshams dkyud gcig nas phyir 'ong*/ steng gi byang shar gyi rtsibs la dkyud gcig /dbus ma'i shar rtsibs la dkyud gcig /'og ma'i shar lho rtsibs la dkyud nas 'og gi srog shing la phyi dkyud byas pa sogs don du ni dang po 'og nas gseg 'gros kyis gyen du song*/ slar sngon ma'i 'gros ltar thur du gseg 'gros kyis phyi nud byas pa yin/ de bzhin du byang shar/ 'og byang*/ dbus/ nub byang steng nas srog shing la dkyud de phyir 'gros kyis nub byang*/ byang*/ byang shar nas srog shing la phyi dkyud byas pa sogs rim bzhin gong gis rigs 'gres pas/ mthar 'og gi lho nub kyi rtsibs nas 'og gi srog shing la phyi dkyud byas pa zhig 'ong*/ yang 'og nas yar lho nub kyi rtsibs la dkyud pas bar ma'i nub kyi rtsibs la dkyud/ steng ma'i nub byang gi rtsibs la dkyud nas/ srog shing la dkyud de/ slar yang phyi 'gros byas pas/ 'og gi lho nub rtsibs nas mar srog shing la dkyud pa nas/ yang yar nub byang*/ byang shar nas steng gi srog shing la dkyud pa sogs snga mas rigs 'gres te/ mthar 'og gi shar lho nas mar srog shing la phyi dkyud byas pa zhig 'ong*/ yang yar 'og gi byang shar rtsibs la dkyud byas steng nas thad du/ nub byang*/ lho nub/ shar lho'i rtsibs rnams la dkyud re re byas pa/ yang byang shar gyi rtsibs la dkyud byas/

'og nas thad du/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ byang shar rtsibs re re bzhin dkyud nas slar gyen du song*/ bar ma'i shar gyi rtsibs la dkyud/ steng nas thad du/ byang*/ nub/ lho/ shar bang rim bzhin sngar ltar/ dkyud nas/ yang 'og tu thad nas/ lho/ nub byang*/ shar bar rtsibs re re bzhin sngar bzhin dkyud nas gyen du song/ steng ma'i shar lho rtsibs la dkyud/ steng nas/ thad du/ byang shar/ nub byang*/ lho nub/ shar lho'i bar rtsibs re re bzhin sngar bzhin dkyud/ 'og nas thad du/ byang shar/ nub byang*/ lho nub/ shar lho bar rtsibs re re bzhin dkyud nas gyen du song srog shing la dkyud gcig byas pas snal 'gros gcig rdzogs pa yin/ da ni snal 'gros snga ma rnams ltar ma nor bar 'ded shes par 'tshal/ dpal be'u ni phyag len mthong brgyud bzhin las re zhig 'dir bshad pa'i spros pa bskyungs/ ༈ nyi zla nor bu rnams ni/ 'khor lo lte ba'i rtsibs re re bzhin phyi nas dkyud rgyab pas phyi nang gnyis ka la 'gro dgos/ zla ba ni cha gang ba'i phyogs ma gtogs zad pa'i phyogs su dkri mi dgos/ snal ma de dag gi kha dog kyang*/ lte bar tshon gyis mdongs nas/ dmar/ sngo/ skya bor bshad kyang ci mdzes byas pas 'thus/ nyi ma dmar ser/ zla ba dkar po/ dpal be'u ni/ nang nas rim bzhin/ nag sngo/ dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ khyung tshang sngo/ nag dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ tsit+ta nang nas rim bzhin/ dkar po/ rtsa*/ nag khrag dmar/ sha ser/ tshil/ ljang bcas/ gdugs sham gnyis/ nag dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ gdugs che ba'i gong rtsibs/ ljang*/ nag dmar/ dkar/ ser/ gdugs chung ba'i gong rtsibs/ ser/ dkar/ dmar/ nag ljang*/ gdugs 'og ma'i pad+ma rtsibs/ ljang*/ dkar/ dmar/ ser/ ljang*/ gdugs steng ma'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyang de bzhin byed srol 'dug /zhar byung nam chung nyer dgu dgos pa/ gyen srid cha chen bzhi dang cha phran gnyis/ gsum gang bde/ 'phred du cha chen gnyis/ kha dog /shar zhi ba'i shel mig dkar po gsum/

lho rgyas pa'i gser mig ser po gsum/ nub dbang gi mtshal mig dmar po gsum/ byang drag po'i ljang mig ljang gu gsum/ dregs pa rkya gsum/ phyogs bcu mgon po rgyal chen bzhi sogs rang mdog /rtsang phur cha chen bzhi lhag yod pa/ pho gtsang nag po brgya brgyad/ mo gtsang dmar po brgya brgyad/ 'bul rtsang cha chen gsum tsam yod pa sum brgya lhag /zlog byang nang ngos bh+yo zlog /phyi khram ris can brgya brgyad/ mda'/ 'phang*/ rgyangs bu bcu gsum re dgos/ gsum pa la/ gtso bo gtor nag zur gsum pa zur gcig la zhal brnyan khros rngams dang ldan pa/ logs gsum la dregs pa rkya gsum gyi dmar gtor gsum/ phyi nas rim bzhin nag po yab yum brgyad la dmar gtor brgyad/ bang rim gnyis par phyogs bcu mgon po la dmar gtor bcu/ gsum par dregs pa don gnyis la dmar gtor che ba brgyad la/ 'khor brgyad res bskor ba/ bzhi par ma bdun sring bzhi sogs la khrag kong don gnyis/ rtsang ra'i nang du rgyal chen la dkar gtor bzhi/ dmag rgyal bzhi la khrag kong bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang mdos rdzas kyi gtor spar yod rigs dgra chos gzhung gi yig chung nas 'byung ba ltar bshams dgos/ de nas pho rtsang g.yas bskor dang*/ mo rtsang g.yon bskor gyis 'khor bar bya/ phyi nas mgo phreng dang*/ gcan gzig g.yang shun sogs phyag bzhes ltar dgod nas/ snal ma sngo dmar gyis dkris pa bcas zhib cha mthong rgyun ltar dang*/ gdugs rtsibs nas dpal be'u phyin gyi rtsibs rnams bya spus brgyan cing*/ gdugs sham gnyis kyi rtsibs kyi bar bar du dar sna lngas brgyan pa sogs phyag srol mthong brgyud bzhin du sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi rjes 'jug rnams la nye bar mkho ba mthong nas zla 11 tshes 28dge bar yang dben nas si tu ming gis zin thor btab pa 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/// /

༈ swa sti/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sdom pa gso zhing nyes ltung sbyong ba'i phyir// chos sgor zhugs rnams tshul 'dir 'bad par spro// de la 'dir nya stong sogs gso sbyong gi nyin stegs kyi khar ston pa mchog gi sku brnyan/ g.yas g.yon du gsung rab dang*/ mchod rten bshams pa'i mdun mchod pa sna lnga gtsos ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ rkang gsum la gzhi bdag gi dkar gtor bshams/ de nas mchod dpon gyis chos gos gyon/ thog mar gaṇ+ḍi la phyag gsum thang shad med 'bul/ gzan phab gaṇ+ḍi'i yu ba phrag par bkal nas/ brdung lugs shad tsha lan gsum dal bus bshad nas/ gcig nas bco brgyad bar je cher brdung ba dang*/ bcu dgu nas so drug bar je chung thog tu rgyud gcig dang*/ rob gsum zhes che brdeg bstud ma gsum gyis 'jog /sgra dang bstun dge slong rnams gding ba chos gos phrag tu 'phen/ snam sbyar bsnams te gtsug lag khang du 'dus nas/ bslab pa rgan pa rnams g.yas gral dang*/ gzhon pa rnams g.yon gral gyi gding ba che ba'i tshad can rnams khug pa rang gi g.yas dang rgyab tu ston/ mdun dang g.yon phyogs su bcad kha yod pa/ le'u kha g.yas su gyu ba byed nas bting*/ rgyun gding chung tshad can rnams khug pa dang le'u g.yas su ston nas bting/ chos gos gsol/ snam sbyar mdun du bzhag /pus mo sar btsugs/ gzan phab/ thal mo bsnol nas gus 'dud kyis bzhugs/ gso sbyong 'di la bzhugs tshul gyi kun spyod mthun pa tsam du ma zad/ thams cad nas bsam pa rnam par dag pa mthun dgos/ de las ldog na las mi chags pas sla chos mi mdzad pa gal che/ tshul phyag dang 'dud phyag gi khyad par yang*/ mdo rtsa bar so sor thar pa'i sdom pas mchog la rab tu byung bas phyag bya'o// mnyam na rgan pa la'o// zhes dang*/ khyim pas rab tu byung ba la'o// thams cad kyis sangs rgyas la'o// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar/

thams cad kyis dkon mchog la dmigs tshe phyag las thang shad gtan nas mi 'os shing*/ bslab pa rgan pas gzhon pa la thang shad dam tshul phyag las 'dud phyag mi thob/ gzhon pas rgan pa la 'dud phyag las tshul phyag mi 'os pas de ltar so sor ma 'dres pa las/ phyag dang thang shad chabs cig mdzad pa 'di gzhung dang 'gal tshul go dgos/ de nas thog mar byang 'dren pas bskul te so thar sdom rgyun/ zla bral thub dbang sogs/ nye bar 'khor ltar bag yod shog /ces chos khrims pas snam sbyar gsol nas phyag gsum btsal/ thang shad med mchan/ gzan phrag khyer/ 'greng 'dud thal sbyar bcas/ bstan pa rin po chen po'i sogs/ mkhan po bzhugs tshe/ mkhan po zhes brjod/ gzhan bslab pa bgres pa yin na/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pas gtso mdzad/ ces so sor skabs phyed pas mdo bskul 'phral/ 'dus pa thams cad bzhengs/ snam sbyar gsol/ gzan zlum khyer bcas thal sbyar gyi zhal sku gzugs la phyogs par/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin sogs dal bus bsdebs 'don du gsungs/ sh+tsau ka rer gzan sne 'babs pa'i gnas pa lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag re re 'tshal/ yan lag bdun pa'ang lhug 'don dal bus phyag 'os 'tshams su phul/ phyir bsngo'o// zhes sngar bzhin mar bzhugs nas/ dkon mchog rjes dran sogs nas/ bde ba thob par shog bar/ de nas thams cad kyis phyag g.yas pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon snying gar mtheb mdzub sprad pa'i skyabs sbyin mdzad de/ rang rang gi sogs se gol lag g.yas pa kho nas kha phyir bsgyur du brdeg /gnyug mar sogs/ khā hi nas sngar ltar thal mo bsnol/ dal bus 'jig rten bde zhing sogs kyi rjes/ chos khrims pas gang zhig mdo bskul nas rang gral du 'khod/ mkhan po'am/ gnas brtan pa khri thog tu gding ba bting nas pus mo sar phab/ zhal dge 'dun la phyogs nas gzan phab cing*/ thal mo bsnol nas gsung mgyogs dal 'tshams zhing gsal dag thon pas/

gang zhig sogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i skabs mkhan po sogs thams cad kyis phyag thal mo snying gar sbyar tsam mdzad/ slar thal mo bsnol/ 'di skad sogs mngon par bstod do// mkhan pos bskul te/ chos bshad pa sogs dal bus bsdebs 'don/ shog ces 'don par 'jog /de nas dge tshul gyi yongs 'bul ni/ phyogs 'dir dge slong las/ dge tshul dmigs bsal med pas cho ga'ang mi dgos la/ dge slong gi phyir bcos dang*/ byin rlabs la/ dang po bslab pa gzhon pas g.yon gral pa rnams bzhengs nas/ g.yas gral bgres pa rnams la gzan phab bcas phyag gsum phul/ thang shad med mchan/ gzan phrag khyer 'greng 'dud bcas bsdeb zhus kyis dge~X gso~Xl brjod/ de nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sar phabs/ rkang g.yon bab gzhol gyis btsugs pa'i pus steng du thal mo sbyar ba bsnol te sar bzhugs/ phyir bcos lan gsum bsdebs te gsungs/ mkhan po'am/ gnas brtan pa gcig pus mtho~Xng sdo~Xm lan gsum dang tha~Xbs le~Xgs bya/ yang phyag gsum 'greng 'dud

thang shad med mchan sogs gong ltar bzhengs bzhin/ bka' drin che zhu ba dang/ ltung ba byin rlabs kyi dge~X gso~Xl zhu/ de 'phral gong bzhin sar bzhugs nas/ byin rlabs lan gsum bsdeb zhus/ mkhan pos tha~Xbs le~Xgs bya/ de nas gzhon pa rnams rang gral du 'khod par/ mkhan po bcas g.yas gral dge slong rgan pa tshos tshul phyag gsum re 'dud phyag med mchan bcas kyi dge~X gso~Xl sogs snga ma ltar la/ gzhon pa rnams kyi gral 'go'i bslab pa bgres shos des/ mtho~Xng sdo~Xm dang tha~Xbs le~Xgs bya/ de nas mkhan po rang gral du bzhugs bzhin dge gsol sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ltung ba thun mong pa byin rlabs dang*/ gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las gyis gnas la blo mthun sogs/ de de bzhin tu 'dzin to// zhes dang*/ so so thar pa'i mdo la/ sogs nas gnas pa bde/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dbyar sogs zla ba brjod lugs gzhung gsal ltar bsgyur shes par byed/ tshe dang ldan pa dag dga' ba sogs brjod par bya'o bar/ skabs 'dir 'dun pa 'bul dgos yod tshe/ gso sbyong gi gong du dge slong 'dun pa len pa pos/ chos gos gding ba bcas/ mchil l+h+wam phud nas blangs zin pa yin bzhin de nyid kyis rang gral nas phyag gsum 'tshal thang shad med te/ gzan phrag khyer/ 'greng 'dud bcas 'dun pa 'bul ba'i sngags chog lan gcig gis 'thus/ 'dun pa dge slong gnyis gsum bzhi sogs 'bul mkhan yod tshe/ len pa pos bslab pa rgan gzhon rim bzhin so sor blangs/ 'bul pa pos kyang mchil l+h+wam phud/ gding ba chos gos bcas sngags chog dang*/ phyag bcas dgos shing*/ nad pa yin tshe gding chos sogs bsal ba'i brda tsam gyis chog 'dir 'bul dus gnas 'di'i nye 'khor na dge slong sogs nas/ zhes bgyi ba yang*/ bgyi ba dag bgyi ba rnams sogs/ skabs su gang bab par bsgyur shes dgos/ de nas mkhan pos/ shākya seng ge sogs nas/ 'dzin to dang*/ thos bsgrags bcas mthar/

so so thar pa bton pa sogs/ 'dus pa bcas bsdebs te gsung*/ ji bzhin no// zhes tshogs grol te/ de'ang gdeng ba bltebs te/ gra phyir slog phrag pa g.yon du bkal ba'i khug pa dpung par ston/ bcad kha lag par bstan le'u rgyab tu yod pa'i 'go mdun du yod pa dang*/ de steng chos gos bltebs te gra phyir slog khug pa dpung par ston/ bcad kha lag par phyogs te/ 'go mdun du yod pa byed la bzhag pa'i thog tu snam sbyar sgril tshal bcas 'jog nas kun spyod dge ba'i ngang nas rang gnas su bzhud do// de ltar gso sbyong gi phyag len nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di'ang sngon byon 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po dag gi lugs ltar las rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par/ si tu pa bstan 'dzin nyin byed kyis tha skar can gyi gral tshes dge bar thub bstan chos 'khor gyi yang dben du zin thor bkod pa rgyal bstan rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// /
